papers.title_zh: 基于模拟2 cm切缘球与邻近结构关系的三维空间分类可区分肺上段(T1a-bN0)腺癌亚段切除后的复发风险，关联主要由切缘距离介导
papers.title_en: Prognostic value of a three-dimensional spatial classification system for clinical T1a-bN0 non-small cell lung cancer in the superior segment.
papers.authors: Yang Y, Chadha AN, Gu Y, Gong R, Ren Q, Xu X, Wen W, Wang Z et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China.
papers.results: 5年RFS率：S6-I 96.9%、S6-II 95.3%、S6-III 81.5%、S6-IV 76.6%（log-rank P<0.001）。多因素分析（校正年龄、CTR、肿瘤大小）：S6-III vs S6-I HR=5.30，P<0.001；S6-IV vs S6-I HR=5.11，P<0.001。反事实中介分析：切缘距离中介比例 S6-III vs S6-I 为84.0%，S6-IV vs S6-I 为92.0%。S6-III亚组中S6-Comb较S6-Seg RFS更优（HR=0.23，95%CI 0.07-0.78，P=0.02），部分由切缘距离中介；S6-IV亚组手术方式与RFS无关联。
papers.authors_conclusion: 空间分类系统有效区分S6 NSCLC复发风险，其与复发的关联主要由手术切缘距离介导，但其主要价值在于术前风险预测；提出初步的解剖引导、假设生成算法：S6-I与S6-II行S6-Seg、S6-III行S6-Comb、S6-IV考虑肺叶切除，尚需前瞻性研究验证。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/需注意：①S6-Comb优于S6-Seg的证据仅来自S6-III亚组的探索性分析，CI宽（0.07-0.78），事件数未报告，且属亚组内比较，不足以直接支撑术式推荐；②提出的S6-IV考虑肺叶切除在本研究中无对应比较数据（S6-IV亚组手术方式无关联），属外推；③主要终点仅RFS，无OS，且916例、随访期内5年数据的成熟度未说明；④中介比例高达84%–92%依赖模型假设，切缘距离与空间分型高度共线可能使该估计偏倚；⑤同一队列内建型与验证，无外部验证或前瞻性确认；⑥摘要未报告分期构成、病理类型、辅助治疗等潜在混杂的校正情况。

pico.p: 接受胸腔镜亚段切除的临床T1a-bN0下肺上段(S6)非小细胞肺癌患者916例（2015年8月至2023年4月）
pico.ic: 按模拟2 cm切缘球与解剖结构关系分为S6-I至S6-IV四个空间分组；手术方式分为S6亚段切除(S6-Seg)与联合邻近亚段切除(S6-Comb)，主要终点为无复发生存(RFS)

papers.reason: 影响下肺上段早期NSCLC亚段切除的术式选择与切缘决策：为S6肿瘤是否需要联合邻近亚段或肺叶切除提供风险分层依据，同时其探索性亚组结论提示需要前瞻性验证，避免过度推广。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Recurrence after segmentectomy in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains a clinical challenge, particularly for tumors in the superior segment of the lower lobe (S6). We hypothesized that this was attributable to the unique spatial location of S6 tumors and the difficulty in achieving adequate surgical margins. Therefore, we developed a three-dimensional (3D) spatial classification system for S6 tumors and investigated its prognostic value. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 916 patients with clinical T1a-bN0 S6 NSCLC who underwent thoracoscopic segmentectomy from August 2015 to April 2023. Tumors were classified into four groups (S6-I to S6-IV) based on the relationship between a simulated 2-cm margin sphere and adjacent anatomical structures: S6-I (margin sphere located above the intersegmental plane), S6-II (margin sphere extended below the intersegmental plane but did not involve main subsegmental structures of the basal segments), S6-III (margin sphere extended below the intersegmental plane and involved main subsegmental structures of the basal segments), and S6-IV (margin sphere involved main trunks of the lower lobe). Surgical methods were categorized as S6 segmentectomy (S6-Seg; including isolated and extended S6 segmentectomy) or combined S6 subsegmentectomy (S6-Comb; combined resection of S6 or its subsegments plus adjacent subsegments, such as resection of S6+8a or S6b+8a). The primary endpoint was recurrence-free survival (RFS). Counterfactual mediation analysis was conducted to assess the mediating role of margin distance. RESULTS: The 5-year RFS rates were 96.9% for S6-I, 95.3% for S6-II, 81.5% for S6-III, and 76.6% for S6-IV (log-rank P<0.001). In multivariable analysisadjusted for age, consolidation-to-tumor ratio (CTR), and tumor size, spatial classification was independently associated with RFS [S6-III vs. S6-I: hazard ratio (HR) =5.30, P<0.001; S6-IV vs. S6-I: HR =5.11, P<0.001]. Counterfactual mediation analysis demonstrated that the association between spatial classification and RFS was largely mediated by margin distance [proportion mediated (PM), 84.0% and 92.0% for S6-III vs. S6-I and S6-IV vs. S6-I, respectively]. In the S6-III subgroup, S6-Comb was associated with superior RFS compared with S6-Seg [HR =0.23, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.07-0.78, P=0.02], an effect partly mediated by margin distance. In the S6-IV subgroup, surgical method was not associated with RFS. CONCLUSIONS: The spatial classification system effectively stratifies recurrence risk in S6 NSCLC. Its association with recurrence is largely mediated by surgical margin distance, but its primary strength lies in preoperative risk prediction. We propose a preliminary, anatomy-guided hypothesis-generating algorithm: S6-Seg for S6-I and S6-II tumors, S6-Comb for S6-III tumors, and consideration of lobectomy for S6-IV tumors,which requires validation in prospective studies.

papers.title_zh: I期（≤3cm）高危病理特征EGFR突变肺腺癌术后辅助EGFR-TKI与RFS改善相关但未见OS获益
papers.title_en: Association between adjuvant EGFR-TKI therapy and survival outcomes in completely resected stage I invasive lung adenocarcinoma (≤3 cm) with sensitizing EGFR mutations and pathological high-risk features.
papers.authors: Cao J, Huang Z, Qiu F, Chen N, Peng Z, Liu Z, Liao X, Zong X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.
papers.results: 357例合格患者中354例进入90天landmark分析（104例已启动辅助EGFR-TKI，250例未启动）。未加权landmark分析：RFS P=0.004，HR=0.27，95%CI 0.13-0.56；IPTW调整后RFS P=0.009，HR=0.28，95%CI 0.11-0.68。OS未见显著差异：未加权 P=0.91，HR=0.93，95%CI 0.33-2.63；IPTW加权 P=0.38，HR=1.34，95%CI 0.50-3.61。时间依赖分析：EGFR-TKI暴露与更低复发风险相关 P<0.001，HR=0.27，95%CI 0.14-0.52；与OS无关联 P=0.49，HR=1.14，95%CI 0.41-3.19。120天landmark敏感性分析结果一致。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在完全切除的I期浸润性肺腺癌（≤3cm）、敏感EGFR突变且伴病理高危特征的患者中，辅助EGFR-TKI治疗与改善的RFS相关，而未观察到与OS的显著关联。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未明确RFS与OS何者为主要终点，结论以RFS阳性为亮点而OS在所有分析（未加权、IPTW、时间依赖）均为阴性，存在以次要/替代终点支撑结论的倾向；RFS为替代终点，OS阴性可能受样本量与事件数不足影响，但IPTW后OS HR>1（1.34）而非<1，方向本身不支持OS获益。回顾性设计、治疗非随机分配，IPTW仅能控制已测混杂；landmark设计纳入者须存活且无复发至landmark，存在选择性问题。研究人群限定为“病理高危特征”亚组，外推至全部I期EGFR突变患者需谨慎。

pico.p: 完全切除的I期浸润性肺腺癌（≤3cm）、携带敏感EGFR突变（exon 19缺失或exon 21 L858R）且至少一项病理高危因素（脉管侵犯、脏层胸膜侵犯、气道播散、高级别组织学模式或低分化）的患者；357例合格，354例在90天landmark时存活且无复发（辅助EGFR-TKI组104例，未用组250例）
pico.ic: 辅助EGFR-TKI治疗 vs 未接受辅助EGFR-TKI（90天landmark设计，倾向评分稳定化IPTW加权；另设120天landmark敏感性分析）

papers.reason: 影响I期高危病理特征EGFR突变肺腺癌术后是否推荐辅助EGFR-TKI的临床决策，并为后续前瞻性研究（终点设定、样本量估算）提供RFS/OS效应量参考
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Adjuvant epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy improves prognosis in patients with resected EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer. However, evidence supporting its use in stage I disease with pathological high-risk features remains limited. We evaluated the association between adjuvant EGFR-TKI therapy and survival outcomes in patients with completely resected stage I invasive lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) (≤3 cm), sensitizing EGFR mutations, and pathological high-risk features. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients who underwent complete resection for stage I invasive LUAD (≤3 cm) between January 2011 and May 2024. Eligible patients had an EGFR exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R mutation and at least one pathological high-risk feature, including lymphovascular invasion, visceral pleural invasion, spread through air spaces, high-grade histologic patterns (micropapillary, solid, and complex glandular patterns), or poor differentiation. The study outcomes were relapse-free survival (RFS) and overall survival (OS). The primary analysis used a 90-day landmark design, with baseline differences addressed using stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW). Survival distributions were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared using the log-rank test. Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Simon-Makuch curves and time-dependent Cox regression analysis were additionally used to account for changes in treatment exposure over time. A 120-day landmark analysis was performed as a sensitivity analysis. RESULTS: Among 357 eligible patients, 354 remained alive and relapse-free at the 90-day landmark. Of these, 104 had initiated adjuvant EGFR-TKI therapy by the landmark, whereas 250 had not. In the unweighted landmark analysis, adjuvant EGFR-TKI therapy was associated with improved RFS (P=0.004; HR =0.27, 95% CI: 0.13-0.56). This association remained significant after IPTW adjustment (P=0.009; HR =0.28, 95% CI: 0.11-0.68). No significant difference in OS was observed in either the unweighted analysis (P=0.91; HR =0.93, 95% CI: 0.33-2.63) or the IPTW-weighted analysis (P=0.38; HR =1.34, 95% CI: 0.50-3.61). In the time-dependent analysis, EGFR-TKI exposure was associated with a lower hazard of relapse (P<0.001; HR =0.27, 95% CI: 0.14-0.52) but not with OS (P=0.49; HR =1.14, 95% CI: 0.41-3.19). The 120-day landmark sensitivity analysis yielded consistent results. CONCLUSIONS: In patients with completely resected stage I invasive LUAD (≤3 cm), sensitizing EGFR mutations, and pathological high-risk features, adjuvant EGFR-TKI therapy was associated with improved RFS, whereas no significant association with OS was observed.

papers.title_zh: 肺磨玻璃结节实性成分的定量CT阈值定义：基于像素级专家标注的开发与单中心内部验证
papers.title_en: Quantitative CT definition of solid components in pulmonary ground-glass nodules: a pixel-level annotation-based development and internal validation study.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Chen N, Ye Y, Zhang H, Xia W, Wu K, Luo N, Niu Z et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.
papers.results: 训练/验证队列病灶长径中位数分别为1.2和1.3 cm，标注实性成分比例中位数分别为0.324和0.319。GGO均值加比值法像素级AUC最高[AUC, 0.848; 95%CI: 0.841-0.856]，敏感度0.732，特异度0.815，F1/Dice 0.760。GGO均值加差值法病灶级R2最高[R2, 0.744; 95%CI: 0.499-0.889]；比值法RMSE最低0.105、MAE最低0.088。DeLong配对检验显示三种最优GGO参照方法间AUC差异无统计学意义。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在该单中心内部验证研究中，病灶自适应的GGO参照方法在像素级区分度与病灶级一致性上优于通用固定阈值或病灶摘要估计方法；这些规则应视为发展中的定量方法，在常规临床应用前需要跨CT平台与重建协议的多中心外部验证。
papers.ai_note: DeLong检验已明确三种最优GGO参照方法AUC无显著差异，但结论仍整体表述为GGO参照方法优于固定阈值，方法间优劣实为未定；以像素级AUC为主要强调指标，而临床更关心结灶级实性成分比例的准确度（该指标各方法差异小）；全部影像来自同一256排CT与单一DLIR重建，验证为同源内部验证，泛化性信息不足；人群限于已手术切除的I期患者，不能外推到随访未手术GGN。

pico.p: 170例患者、170个手术切除的I期肺腺癌谱系GGN（每例1个靶病灶），随机分为训练队列n=120与内部验证队列n=50
pico.ic: 干预：9种预设的病灶自适应GGO参照定量CT实性成分判定方法；对照：3种文献固定阈值及病灶层面摘要估计方法

papers.reason: 影响GGN随访与手术决策中实性成分/实性比例的定量测量标准选择，为个体化阈值方法与固定阈值的比较提供内部验证基线数据
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Solid-component assessment in pulmonary ground-glass nodules (GGNs) remains subjective, and no universally accepted computed tomography (CT) attenuation threshold exists. Fixed cutoffs may not account for inter-lesion variation in baseline ground-glass opacity (GGO) attenuation. We aimed to develop and internally validate lesion-adaptive quantitative CT definitions of the solid component using three-dimensional pixel-level expert annotations as the imaging reference standard. METHODS: This retrospective single-center methodological study included 170 unique patients with 170 surgically resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma-spectrum GGNs from March 2015 through July 2018 and each patient contributed one target lesion. All examinations were acquired on the same 256-row CT scanner, and venous-phase 1-mm images reconstructed with medium-strength deep learning image reconstruction were used for analysis. Each lesion was independently annotated by at least two experienced thoracic surgeons, with Dice-based adjudication and senior review. Patients were randomly allocated to training (n=120) and internal validation (n=50) cohorts. Nine prespecified study methods and three literature-based fixed thresholds were evaluated at pixel and lesion levels. RESULTS: The training and validation cohorts had median lesion sizes of 1.2 and 1.3 cm and median annotated solid-component proportions of 0.324 and 0.319, respectively. The GGO mean plus ratio method achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve [AUC, 0.848; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.841-0.856], with sensitivity of 0.732, specificity of 0.815, and F1/Dice of 0.760. The GGO mean plus difference method yielded the highest lesion-level coefficient of determination (R2, 0.744; 95% CI: 0.499-0.889), whereas the ratio method yielded the lowest root mean square error (RMSE, 0.105) and mean absolute error (MAE, 0.088). Pairwise DeLong testing showed no statistically significant AUC difference among the three top-performing GGO-referenced methods. CONCLUSIONS: In this single-center internal validation study, lesion-adaptive GGO-referenced methods showed more favorable overall pixel-level discrimination and lesion-level agreement than universal fixed thresholds or lesion-summary estimators. These rules should be considered developmental quantitative methods and require multicenter external validation across CT platforms and reconstruction protocols before routine clinical use.

papers.title_zh: SBRT联合免疫检查点抑制剂治疗NSCLC的系统评价与重建IPD荟萃分析：仅5项对比研究，OS/PFS/ORR均未见获益，DCR显著性在敏感性分析中丢失
papers.title_en: Efficacy and safety of stereotactic body radiotherapy combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors for non-small cell lung cancer: a systematic review and reconstructed individual patient data meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Ji P, Zhao Z, Tang X, Dai Z, Mi X, Xing Y, Xie Y, Liao W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery and Institute of Thoracic Oncology, West China Hospital of Sichuan University, Chengdu, C…
papers.authors_conclusion: The comparative pairwise meta-analysis does not demonstrate an OS, PFS, or ORR benefit from adding SBRT to ICI-based treatment. Although the primary DCR estimate was statistically significant, its sensitivity to individual studies and the low certainty of evidence preclude a firm efficacy conclusion. Setting-specific randomized trials with standardized radiation, outcome, and toxicity definitions are needed.
papers.ai_note: 21项研究中仅5项贡献配对比较终点，主要结论实为小样本、低确定性证据下的阴性；DCR为唯一显著的配对终点但依赖单项研究，摘要本身已承认，阅读时不应作为阳性信号外推。单臂中位OS 36.4个月等描述性数值无对照、受分期与选择偏倚影响，易被选择性引用为'疗效好'。疾病分期与治疗场景分析预设为基于未调整研究间比较的描述性分析，不能用于亚组疗效判断。检索截止'August 2026'日期与发表时间关系无法从摘要核实，信息不足。

pico.p: NSCLC患者，21项研究共1,096例，其中5项对比性研究贡献配对比对终点
pico.ic: SBRT+ICI vs 单纯ICI为基础的治疗（配对比较）；单臂描述性分析为SBRT+ICI

papers.reason: 影响是否在ICI基础上加用SBRT的临床决策：配对证据明确不支持OS/PFS/ORR获益，为'SBRT增敏免疫'的常见阳性宣传提供反证基线，同时提示DCR类次要终点与单臂数据的解读陷阱，可为后续RCT设计与系统评价再评价提供对照
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) may augment antitumor immunity when combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but clinical studies span markedly different disease stages and treatment intents and have produced inconsistent comparative results. We aimed to synthesize the evidence and evaluate efficacy and safety, separating pairwise outcomes from descriptive single-arm outcomes. METHODS: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from inception through August 2026. Pairwise outcomes were synthesized as risk ratios (RRs) or reconstructed survival hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence interval (CI). Single-arm outcomes of SBRT plus ICI were summarized as pooled proportions. Published Kaplan-Meier curves were digitized and reconstructed as individual patient data (IPD). Disease-stage and treatment-setting analyses were prespecified as descriptive because they were based on unadjusted between-study comparisons. RESULTS: Twenty-one studies enrolling 1,096 participants were included. Five comparative studies contributed to at least one pairwise outcome. SBRT plus ICI was not associated with statistically significant improvements in overall survival (OS) (HR 0.81, 95% CI: 0.52-1.25), progression-free survival (PFS) (HR 0.76, 95% CI: 0.53-1.10), or objective response rate (ORR) (RR 1.72, 95% CI: 0.85-3.51). Disease control rate (DCR) favored SBRT plus ICI (RR 1.20, 95% CI: 1.03-1.39), but significance was lost when either of two influential studies was omitted. Pairwise risks of any-grade and grade ≥3 adverse events (AEs) did not differ significantly. In descriptive single-arm analyses, median OS was 36.4 months (95% CI: 29.8-50.9) and median PFS was 14.6 months (95% CI: 11.6-17.2); pooled ORR was 49.4% (95% CI: 38.0-60.8%), DCR was 80.6% (95% CI: 70.9-87.7%), any-grade AE incidence was 74.2% (95% CI: 50.3-89.1%), and grade ≥3 AE incidence was 27.1% (95% CI: 17.1-40.2%). CONCLUSIONS: The comparative pairwise meta-analysis does not demonstrate an OS, PFS, or ORR benefit from adding SBRT to ICI-based treatment. Although the primary DCR estimate was statistically significant, its sensitivity to individual studies and the low certainty of evidence preclude a firm efficacy conclusion. Setting-specific randomized trials with standardized radiation, outcome, and toxicity definitions are needed.

papers.title_zh: 新辅助放化疗后机器人辅助与常规微创食管切除术比较的荟萃分析：失血量、住院时间与淋巴结获取有差异，但并发症与肿瘤学结局无显著差异
papers.title_en: Robotic-assisted versus conventional minimally invasive esophagectomy after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Bertch A, Douri D, Kosel L, Patel J, Pansegrau T
papers.affiliation_highlight: University of North Dakota School of Medicine & Health Sciences, 1301 N Columbia Rd, Grand Forks, ND, 58202-9037, USA.
papers.results: 7项研究2,395例（RAMIE 609例、CMIE 1,786例）：估计失血量更少（MD -26.44 mL，95% CI -34.36至-18.51，p < 0.001）；住院时间更短（MD -1.78天，95% CI -3.41至-0.15，p = 0.032）；淋巴结获取数更多（MD 2.60枚，95% CI 1.81-3.38，p < 0.001）。病理完全缓解、R0切除、术后总体并发症、吻合口漏、30天死亡率及90天死亡率均无显著差异。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在以nCRT为基础的新辅助治疗后行食管切除术的患者中，RAMIE与CMIE相比失血量更低、住院时间更短、淋巴结获取更多，而在肿瘤学结局、术后发病率和短期死亡率方面无显著差异；这些发现提示RAMIE在该人群中是一种安全有效的微创方法，尽管解释受限于纳入研究的观察性设计。
papers.ai_note: 结论由失血量、住院时间、淋巴结数等替代终点支撑，而并发症、死亡率、pCR、R0等关键终点均为阴性，存在以次要/替代终点为核心卖点的选择性强调；全部纳入研究为观察性设计，残余混杂（术者学习曲线、病例选择）未在摘要中处理，ROBINS-I具体分级与异质性（I²）、发表偏倚、GRADE证据质量均未报告；住院时间CI下限-0.15天接近无意义边界；标题虽为nCRT人群，实际纳入研究为‘predominantly nCRT-based’，人群限定有松动；信息不足：无法判断各研究nCRT比例与随访时长。

pico.p: 接受食管切除术且以nCRT为基础的新辅助治疗患者，7项研究共2,395例（RAMIE 609例，CMIE 1,786例）
pico.ic: 机器人辅助微创食管切除术（RAMIE）对比常规微创食管切除术（CMIE）

papers.reason: 影响新辅助放化疗后食管切除术入路（机器人 vs 胸腹腔镜）的术式选择与医患沟通，同时为后续头对头RCT的设计与终点选择提供现有证据基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Robotic-assisted minimally invasive esophagectomy (RAMIE) is increasingly used as an alternative to conventional minimally invasive esophagectomy (CMIE). However, many prior comparisons include mixed patient populations and variable neoadjuvant treatment strategies. Because neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) can make esophagectomy technically more difficult, the relative performance of RAMIE in this specific setting remains uncertain. METHODS: We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis using Nested Knowledge AutoLit to compare RAMIE and CMIE among patients undergoing esophagectomy after predominantly nCRT-based treatment. Eligible studies directly compared the two operative approaches and reported perioperative, surgical, or oncologic outcomes. Effect estimates were pooled with random-effects models. Odds ratios (ORs) were used for dichotomous outcomes, and mean differences (MDs) were used for continuous outcomes. Analyses were performed in R version 4.5.2 using the meta package. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I. RESULTS: Seven studies including 2,395 patients were analyzed; 609 patients underwent RAMIE and 1,786 underwent CMIE. Compared with CMIE, RAMIE was associated with lower estimated blood loss (MD -26.44 mL, 95% CI -34.36 to -18.51; p < 0.001), shorter hospital length of stay (MD -1.78 days, 95% CI -3.41 to -0.15; p = 0.032), and higher lymph node yield (MD 2.60 nodes, 95% CI 1.81-3.38; p < 0.001). No significant differences were identified for pathologic complete response, R0 resection, overall postoperative complications, anastomotic leak, 30-day mortality, or 90-day mortality. CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing esophagectomy after predominantly nCRT-based treatment, RAMIE was associated with lower blood loss, shorter hospital stay, and higher lymph node yield compared with CMIE, without significant differences in oncologic outcomes, postoperative morbidity, or short-term mortality. These findings suggest that RAMIE is a safe and effective minimally invasive approach in this population, although interpretation is limited by the observational design of the included studies.

papers.title_zh: 在CBCT增强透视引导的外周肺病变活检工作流中，机器人导管较手动预弯导管中心击中率更高但辐射剂量亦升高
papers.title_en: Cone-beam computed tomography augmented-fluoroscopy-guided center-strike targeting during peripheral bronchoscopy: robotic vs. manual catheters.
papers.authors: Bhadra K, Patel P, Mahajan AK, Hogarth DK, Wagh AA
papers.affiliation_highlight: Pulmonary, Allergy & Critical Care Medicine, Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, CA, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: CBCT AF引导的靶向工作流将实时针道向量对齐与采样前术中工具位置确认相结合；在该工作流内，机器人导管取得了更高的中心击中率和TIL率，并与改善的诊断表现相关；随着支气管镜向精准经支气管治疗演进，可靠的术中空间确认可能日益重要。
papers.ai_note: 回顾性非随机、单中心、按时间前后分组（先手动后机器人），存在学习曲线与时代混杂，术者经验、病灶大小/位置/深度等关键混杂因素未见报告，无法区分获益来自导管本身还是工作流与操作熟练度；'1年诊断准确率'的定义在摘要中不明确；次要终点（诊断率、1年准确率）与辐射剂量差异并存，机器人DAP更高提示获益伴随剂量代价，摘要未给出剂量-获益权衡的临床意义；气胸事件数仅2例，安全性比较信息不足。

pico.p: 单中心连续200例患者、219个活检的外周肺病变（PPL）；前100例（106个病灶）使用手动预弯导管，后100例（113个病灶）使用形状感知机器人导管
pico.ic: 形状感知机器人导管（Intuitive）对比手动预弯导管（Medtronic），两组均采用固定CBCT增强透视、屏气通气方案与术中工具位置确认的靶向工作流；主要终点为中心击中（center strike），次要终点为诊断率与1年诊断准确率

papers.reason: 为外周肺病变活检中机器人导管 vs 手动导管的技术与诊断获益提供量化的对照数据，影响机器人支气管镜设备选型与活检策略决策，并为CBCT-AF靶向工作流的队列设计提供中心击中率、诊断率与剂量基线；同时其非随机时序设计提示后续随机研究的必要性。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Computed tomography (CT)-to-body divergence and tool-tissue divergence (TTD) limit bronchoscopic access to peripheral pulmonary lesions (PPLs). Fixed cone-beam CT (CBCT) with augmented fluoroscopy (AF) enables intraprocedural target segmentation, live fluoroscopic overlay, and confirmation of tool position. We describe three CBCT AF-guided spatial targeting techniques as a targeting workflow and compare manual pre-curved and shape-sensing robotic catheters using center strike as the primary technical endpoint. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 200 consecutive patients with 219 biopsied PPLs. The first 100 patients underwent biopsy with manual pre-curved catheters (Medtronic; 106 lesions), followed by 100 patients who underwent biopsy using a shape-sensing robotic catheter (Intuitive; 113 lesions). All procedures used fixed CBCT-AF, a ventilation protocol with apneic breath-holding, needle targeting with traditional two-angle, slow-sweep, and/or center-datum techniques, and CBCT tool-position confirmation. Center strike was defined as needle position in the middle third of the lesion on axial, sagittal, and coronal CBCT images. The primary outcome was center-strike tool position; diagnostic yield and 1-year diagnostic accuracy were secondary outcomes. RESULTS: Robotic catheters achieved a higher center-strike rate, the primary endpoint, than manual catheters {66% [75/113; 95% confidence interval (CI): 57-74%] vs. 42% (45/106; 95% CI: 33-52%), P<0.001}, as well as a higher tool-in-lesion (TIL) rate [100% (113/113; 95% CI: 97-100%) vs. 91% (96/106; 95% CI: 83-95%), P<0.001]. Diagnostic yield was 91% (95% CI: 84-95%) vs. 80% (95% CI: 72-87%) (P=0.02), and 1-year diagnostic accuracy was 96% (95% CI: 91-99%) vs. 86% (95% CI: 78-91%) (P=0.01). Dose-area product (DAP) was higher with robotic catheters [median 13,251 [interquartile range (IQR), 8,683-18,264] vs. 11,114 (IQR, 6,336-15,199) µGy·m2, P=0.04], without significant differences in fluoroscopy time or number of CBCT spins. Two pneumothoraces occurred in the robotic cohort, one requiring chest tube placement. CONCLUSIONS: A CBCT AF-guided targeting workflow combines real-time needle-vector alignment with intraprocedural confirmation of tool position before tissue sampling. Within this workflow, robotic catheters achieved higher center-strike and TIL rates and were associated with improved diagnostic performance. Reliable intraprocedural spatial confirmation may become increasingly important as bronchoscopy evolves toward precision transbronchial therapies.

papers.title_zh: 灌洗液cfDNA液体活检指导的可切除EGFR突变NSCLC新辅助lazertinib：前瞻性II期单臂研究，报告诊断准确性与影像学缓解但无对照且未报告pCR
papers.title_en: Bronchoalveolar lavage fluid cfDNA liquid biopsy-guided neoadjuvant lazertinib in resectable EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: a prospective phase II study.
papers.authors: Kim IA, Kim H, Hur JY, Kim WS, Kim YW, Lee SA, Hwang JJ, Lee KY et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Precision Medicine Lung Cancer Center, Konkuk University Medical Center, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
papers.results: BALiquid EGFR基因分型敏感度74%，特异度97.0%，阳性预测值97.4%，阴性预测值71.7%，与手术组织基因分型一致率83.3%；全分析集ORR 57.5%（23/40；95%CI 40.9-73.0%）；符合方案集ORR 67.6%（23/34；95%CI 49.5-82.6%）；34例中33例实现R0切除；病理降期55.9%；6/34（17.6%）达到主要病理缓解；4/40（10.0%）发生≥3级治疗相关不良事件
papers.authors_conclusion: BALiquid may serve as a complemental preoperative EGFR genotyping approach to provide genetic information when tissue is unavailable or insufficient. BALiquid-guided neoadjuvant lazertinib demonstrated meaningful antitumor activity, favorable surgical outcomes, and an acceptable safety profile in patients with potentially resectable EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
papers.ai_note: 单臂无对照，无法将ORR/病理缓解归因于lazertinib（无新辅助化疗或组织活检指导的历史/同期对照）；摘要以符合方案集ORR 67.6%为主要展示、全分析集为57.5%，存在人群限定松动的取向；诊断准确性参照标准（手术组织分型）仅存在于最终接受手术的患者，BALiquid假阴性（NPV 71.7%、敏感度74%）病例的后续结局与是否漏治未报告，信息不足；未报告pCR（新辅助关键终点），仅报mPR 17.6%；样本量小、无独立影像盲评与病理盲评说明；信息不足：无对照下'meaningful antitumor activity'的判定依据

pico.p: 128例CT提示潜在可切除肺癌的患者接受支气管镜BAL，其中48例BALiquid检出EGFR突变，40例入组，34例完成新辅助lazertinib并手术
pico.ic: 干预：9周新辅助lazertinib后手术切除；无平行对照（单臂）；诊断准确性以手术组织基因分型为参照

papers.reason: 影响可切除EGFR突变NSCLC新辅助治疗方案选择与术前基因检测路径决策：为组织不足时用BALF cfDNA替代组织分型提供诊断性能数据（敏感度74%偏低），并提供新辅助lazertinib的初步疗效/安全性基线，可作为后续对照组设计与样本量估算的参照
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Reliable preoperative molecular testing is increasingly important in resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), particularly when tissue biopsy is not feasible or yields insufficient material. We evaluated the feasibility of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid cell-free DNA liquid biopsy (BALiquid) as a preoperative epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) genotyping platform and assessed the clinical efficacy of neoadjuvant lazertinib in patients with potentially resectable EGFR-mutant NSCLC. METHODS: A total of 128 patients with computed tomography (CT) findings suggestive of potentially resectable lung cancer underwent bronchoscopy with bronchoalveolar lavage near the target lesion. EGFR genotyping was performed using polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based BALF cfDNA analysis. Patients with sensitizing EGFR mutations detected by BALiquid received neoadjuvant lazertinib for 9 weeks followed by surgical resection. Diagnostic performance, radiologic response, surgical outcomes, pathologic response, and safety were evaluated. RESULTS: Among 48 patients with BALiquid-detected EGFR mutations, 40 were enrolled and 34 completed neoadjuvant lazertinib followed by surgery. BALiquid EGFR genotyping demonstrated a sensitivity of 74%, a specificity of 97.0%, a positive predictive value of 97.4%, a negative predictive value of 71.7% and 83.3% of concordance rate compared with surgical tissue genotyping. The all-treated objective response rate (ORR) was 57.5% [23/40; 95% confidence interval (CI): 40.9-73.0%], and the ORR in the per-protocol population was 67.6% (23/34; 95% CI: 49.5-82.6%). R0 resection was achieved in 33 of 34 patients. Pathologic downstaging occurred in 55.9% of patients, and major pathologic response was achieved in 6 of 34 patients (17.6%). Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events occurred in 4/40 patients (10.0%). CONCLUSIONS: BALiquid may serve as a complemental preoperative EGFR genotyping approach to provide genetic information when tissue is unavailable or insufficient. BALiquid-guided neoadjuvant lazertinib demonstrated meaningful antitumor activity, favorable surgical outcomes, and an acceptable safety profile in patients with potentially resectable EGFR-mutant NSCLC.

papers.title_zh: TP53在重复组织NGS中的纵向动态：经分子谱系判定与序贯可信度验证后，表观翻转多为异时多原发或检测限噪声，且未见EGFR偏好或MET关联
papers.title_en: Longitudinal TP53 dynamics in repeated tissue-based next-generation sequencing in non-small cell lung cancer: a real-world study with molecular lineage adjudication and sequential credibility verification.
papers.authors: Zhao D, Xie D, Li K, Zhang N, Liu Z, Che N
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology, Beijing Chest Hospital, Capital Medical University & Beijing Tuberculosis and Thoracic Tumor Re…
papers.results: TP53状态稳定824例（86.9%）；124例（13.1%）出现表观获得（n=75）或丢失（n=49）。谱系判定排除54例（占1,002例合格者的5.4%）驱动谱完全不一致者，其表观翻转率为一致者的三倍（29.6% vs 9.6%）。序贯验证识别出92个高置信事件（64个获得、28个丢失），未见驱动基因富集（EGFR 65.2% vs 队列65.4%，P>0.99）。MET扩增在各轨迹间无差异（高置信获得 vs 持续阴性：8.9% vs 6.3%，P=0.52）。
papers.authors_conclusion: TP53改变在纵向监测中总体稳定。许多表观翻转反映异时多原发肿瘤或接近检测限的噪声，可通过一个简单的序贯框架加以识别。在控制伪影后，TP53动态未显示EGFR偏好，既往提示的MET关联在统一采集条件下未获证实。
papers.ai_note: 分母不一致：摘要称纳入948例患者，但谱系判定排除的54例表述为“占1,002例合格者的5.4%”，两个分母的关系信息不足，无法核对翻转率分层是否基于同一人群。VAF≥5%阈值为经验锚定且依赖平台再检出特征，摘要未提供正交方法（如ddPCR/独立复测）验证，也无预先设定的样本量或效能评估。EGFR“无偏好”结论基于高置信获得事件与全队列横断面比例的比较（65.2% vs 65.4%），并非与翻转阴性对照的前瞻比较；MET P=0.52 未报告效能，属信息不足的阴性结果。驱动背景与MET扩增均明确为探索性结局，摘要未强调这一点。

pico.p: 接受至少两次间隔≥120天组织NGS检测（所有标本肿瘤细胞含量≥20%）的非小细胞肺癌患者，948例（谱系判定环节以1,002例合格标本为分母）
pico.ic: 干预：对表观TP53获得/丢失事件实施两步序贯验证（先比较序贯标本完整驱动基因谱进行分子谱系判定，再采用平台再检出特征锚定的VAF≥5%经验阈值）；对照/比较组：驱动谱一致 vs 不一致患者、高置信获得事件 vs 持续阴性患者、全队列驱动基因背景（驱动基因与MET扩增为探索性结局）

papers.reason: 影响对重复NGS中TP53状态变化的临床解读——避免把技术噪声或异时多原发误判为克隆演化，并为TP53-EGFR/TP53-MET共突变关联假设的取舍及纵向分子监测框架设计提供实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Apparent TP53 gain or loss in repeated next-generation sequencing (NGS) may reflect technical noise, spatial heterogeneity, metachronous multiple primary tumors, or true clonal evolution. This study aimed to characterize TP53 longitudinal dynamics using a transparent verification framework. METHODS: We analyzed 948 patients with non-small cell lung cancer undergoing at least two tissue-based NGS tests separated by ≥120 days (all specimens ≥20% tumor-cell content). Apparent TP53 flip events underwent two-step sequential verification: molecular lineage adjudication comparing complete variant spectra of sequential specimens, followed by an empirically anchored variant allele frequency (VAF) threshold (≥5%) derived from platform re-detection characteristics. Driver background and MET amplification were exploratory outcomes. RESULTS: TP53 status remained stable in 824 patients (86.9%); 124 (13.1%) showed apparent gain (n=75) or loss (n=49). Lineage adjudication excluded 54 patients (5.4% of 1,002 eligible) with fully discordant driver spectra, whose apparent flip rate was three-fold higher than concordant patients (29.6% vs. 9.6%). Sequential verification identified 92 high-confidence events (64 acquisitions, 28 losses), showing no driver enrichment (EGFR 65.2% vs. 65.4% in the cohort; P>0.99). MET amplification did not differ across trajectories (high-confidence acquired vs. persistent negative: 8.9% vs. 6.3%; P=0.52). CONCLUSIONS: TP53 alterations are largely stable during longitudinal monitoring. Many apparent flips reflect metachronous multiple primaries or near-detection-limit noise and are identifiable by a simple sequential framework. After artifact control, TP53 dynamics show no EGFR preference, and previously suggested MET associations were not confirmed under uniform ascertainment.

papers.title_zh: 单孔VATS肺叶切除术后20-Fr与24-Fr胸管随机比较：小口径胸管显著减轻术后疼痛，大口径胸管早期影像学胸膜控制更优
papers.title_en: A matter of size: 20-Fr vs. 24-Fr chest drainage after uniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomy for non-small cell lung cancer-a randomized trial.
papers.authors: Longo F, Sarubbi A, Nibid L, Frasca L, Suriano I, Sarubbi D, Panichelli A, Palladino C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Campus Bio-Medico, Rome, Italy.
papers.authors_conclusion: After uVATS lobectomy, 24-Fr chest tubes were associated with better early radiographic pleural control but greater postoperative pain. These findings highlight a trade-off between drainage efficiency and patient comfort and support an individualized approach to chest tube selection.
papers.ai_note: 结果段首先呈现探索性影像学结局（PNX、PE），而非主要终点疼痛，存在选择性强调倾向；主要终点（24h NRS）明确支持20-Fr更优，但结论以"trade-off"并列呈现，弱化了主要终点的单向优势。PNX与PE为探索性终点，未经多重比较校正，不能等同于临床结局获益。PAL差异接近显著但未达标（P=0.07），摘要报告该阴性结果表述规范。单中心、n=80样本量较小，主要终点虽达显著但效应量有限（NRS差值约1分）。

pico.p: 接受单孔胸腔镜肺叶切除术的非小细胞肺癌患者，共80例（每组40例）
pico.ic: 干预组：20-Fr胸管；对照组：24-Fr胸管，按1:1随机分配

papers.reason: 为胸外科术后胸管口径选择提供随机对照证据，直接影响单孔VATS肺叶切除术后引流管型号决策；同时为该领域后续多中心试验提供样本量与终点设计参考。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chest drains are routinely used after pulmonary lobectomy to evacuate air and pleural fluid and promote lung re-expansion. However, the optimal chest tube caliber remains controversial, particularly in the context of minimally invasive surgery. Smaller-bore drains may reduce discomfort, whereas larger drains may provide more effective evacuation of air and fluid. The aim of this study was to compare 20-Fr and 24-Fr chest tubes after uniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (uVATS) lobectomy for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with particular focus on postoperative pain, pleural drainage-related outcomes, and recovery. METHODS: This single-center prospective randomized study included 80 patients undergoing uVATS lobectomy for NSCLC, who were allocated 1:1 to receive either a 20-Fr or 24-Fr chest tube (n=40 per group). The primary outcome was postoperative pain at 24 hours, assessed using the Numeric Rating Scale (NRS). Secondary outcomes included NRS pain at 12 and 48 hours, prolonged air leak (PAL), chest tube duration, subcutaneous emphysema, analgesic requirements, respiratory physiokinesitherapy outcomes, and length of stay (LOS). Pneumothorax (PNX) and pleural effusion (PE) were evaluated as exploratory radiographic outcomes. RESULTS: The 24-Fr group showed significantly lower rates of PNX on postoperative day (POD) 3 (27.5% vs. 60.0%, P=0.003) and PE on POD2 (50.0% vs. 77.5%, P=0.01). Conversely, patients with 24-Fr drains reported significantly higher NRS pain scores at 12 hours [4.0 (3.0-5.0) vs. 2.0 (2.0-4.0), P=0.001], 24 hours [5.0 (4.0-6.0) vs. 4.0 (3.0-5.0), P=0.002], and 48 hours [5.5 (4.8-6.2) vs. 4.5 (3.0-6.0), P=0.02]. No significant differences were observed in PAL (27.5% vs. 47.5%, P=0.07), chest tube duration, subcutaneous emphysema, analgesic requirements, or LOS. CONCLUSIONS: After uVATS lobectomy, 24-Fr chest tubes were associated with better early radiographic pleural control but greater postoperative pain. These findings highlight a trade-off between drainage efficiency and patient comfort and support an individualized approach to chest tube selection. TRIAL REGISTRATION: The trial was registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07827885).

papers.title_zh: 完全切除pN1/2 NSCLC中定量淋巴结负荷（转移淋巴结数与转移淋巴结站数）对预后的独立预测价值：多中心回顾性队列
papers.title_en: Prognostic value of quantitative nodal burden after complete resection for pN1/2 non-small cell lung cancer: a multicenter retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Ishikawa Y, Toyoda M, Kaburaki Y, Yasuura Y, Shigeta N, Isaka T, Arai H, Kameda Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Yokosuka Kyosai Hospital, Yokosuka, Japan.
papers.results: 共97例OS事件、142例RFS事件。转移淋巴结数独立预测OS（HR, 1.086; 95%CI: 1.012-1.166; P=0.02）和RFS（HR, 1.098; 95%CI: 1.042-1.157; P<0.001）。转移淋巴结站总数独立预测OS（HR, 1.335; 95%CI: 1.140-1.563; P<0.001）和RFS（HR, 1.262; 95%CI: 1.118-1.426; P<0.001）。按转移淋巴结站总数的5年OS率：1站68.6%、2站57.9%、≥3站46.9%；对应5年RFS率：57.0%、25.6%、13.3%。亚组分析中淋巴结负荷的预后影响在pN2病变中更明显，转移N1站负荷与复发关系尤为突出。
papers.authors_conclusion: In a contemporary multicenter cohort of completely resected pN1/2 NSCLC that included segmentectomy cases, quantitative nodal burden was associated with prognosis beyond anatomical pN classification. The total number of metastatic nodal stations may be a practical metric for postoperative risk stratification, and metastatic N1-station burden may help identify a higher-risk subset among patients with pN2 disease. However, these findings should be considered exploratory and require external validation.
papers.ai_note: 作者在结论中自认属探索性、需外部验证；亚组结论（pN2中更明显、N1站负荷与复发）未给出具体HR/CI/P值，信息不足。多变量模型仅校正年龄、性别、术后辅助治疗和病理N分期，未提及清扫淋巴结总数/检出淋巴结数、辅助治疗方案与周期、PET分期等潜在混杂；定量淋巴结负荷指标对清扫与病理检出强度高度依赖，可能存在检出偏倚。未见外部验证集或内部验证（如C-index、校准）数据，信息不足。

pico.p: 2017年1月—2018年12月12家机构1,793例肺癌手术中完全切除的pN1/2 NSCLC患者258例（排除术后30天内死亡3例）；叶切234例、段切15例、全肺切9例；腺癌165例、鳞癌71例、其他22例
pico.ic: 按转移淋巴结数、转移淋巴结站总数、转移N1站数与转移N2站数分组比较（多变量Cox校正年龄、性别、术后辅助治疗、病理N分期）

papers.reason: 为完全切除淋巴结阳性NSCLC的术后风险分层提供候选定量指标（转移站数），影响辅助治疗强度与随访密度的决策假设，并为后续验证性队列设计提供效应量基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Anatomical pN classification does not fully capture prognostic heterogeneity in completely resected node-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). We evaluated whether quantitative nodal burden metrics could improve postoperative risk stratification. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study included 258 patients with completely resected pN1/2 NSCLC selected from 1,793 lung cancer operations performed at 12 institutions between January 2017 and December 2018 after exclusion of 3 patients who died within 30 days after surgery. Procedures were lobectomy in 234 patients, segmentectomy in 15, and pneumonectomy in 9. Histology was adenocarcinoma in 165 patients, squamous cell carcinoma in 71, and other histological types in 22. Overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) were analyzed according to the number of metastatic lymph nodes, total number of metastatic nodal stations, and numbers of metastatic N1 and N2 stations. Multivariable Cox models were adjusted for age, sex, postoperative adjuvant therapy, and pathological nodal category. RESULTS: There were 97 OS events and 142 RFS events. The number of metastatic lymph nodes independently predicted OS [hazard ratio (HR), 1.086; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.012-1.166; P=0.02] and RFS (HR, 1.098; 95% CI: 1.042-1.157; P<0.001). The total number of metastatic nodal stations also independently predicted OS (HR, 1.335; 95% CI: 1.140-1.563; P<0.001) and RFS (HR, 1.262; 95% CI: 1.118-1.426; P<0.001). Five-year OS rates according to the total number of metastatic nodal stations were 68.6% for 1 station, 57.9% for 2 stations, and 46.9% for ≥3 stations; the corresponding 5-year RFS rates were 57.0%, 25.6%, and 13.3%, respectively. In subgroup analyses, the prognostic impact of nodal burden was more evident in pN2 disease, and metastatic N1-station burden was particularly associated with recurrence. CONCLUSIONS: In a contemporary multicenter cohort of completely resected pN1/2 NSCLC that included segmentectomy cases, quantitative nodal burden was associated with prognosis beyond anatomical pN classification. The total number of metastatic nodal stations may be a practical metric for postoperative risk stratification, and metastatic N1-station burden may help identify a higher-risk subset among patients with pN2 disease. However, these findings should be considered exploratory and require external validation.

papers.results: 狭窄发生率36/111（32.4%）；独立预测因素为浸润深度（<M2 vs ≥M2）、纵向长度（<3.75 vs ≥3.75 cm）、环周范围（<0.5、0.5-0.75、≥0.75）及CAR（<0.03 vs ≥0.03）；列线图AUC 0.866（95%CI: 0.800-0.931）；最佳截点下敏感度73.2%（95%CI: 56.9-85.4）、特异度83.1%（95%CI: 72.5-90.4）、Brier评分0.122、校正后（optimism-corrected）AUC 0.889；校准曲线与决策曲线分析显示良好校准与净获益
papers.authors_conclusion: CAR可独立预测ESD术后狭窄；该列线图是一种有前景的初步风险分层工具，但在常规临床应用前仍需外部验证
papers.ai_note: 校正后AUC（0.889）反而高于表观AUC（0.866），与bootstrap乐观校正通常使AUC下降的预期方向相反，数值口径信息不足；连续变量（浸润深度、长度、环周范围、CAR）均按数据驱动截点二分类，可能高估判别力；单中心回顾性设计、111例仅36个事件、4个预测因子，且排除了合并症/多发病灶等人群，外部推广性受限；未报告列线图与既有解剖学模型的增量价值比较（如C-statistic提升、NRI），CAR的独立增益证据不足

pico.p: 2015-2024年单中心连续接受ESD的早期食管肿瘤患者111例（排除附加治疗、多发病灶、合并症、近期感染、激素使用及失访者），其中36例（32.4%）发生术后狭窄

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) for early esophageal neoplasia may cause strictures that impair eating and quality of life. Existing models rely on anatomical factors; the value of inflammatory-nutritional markers like the C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) remains unclear. We aimed to develop and internally validate a CAR-based nomogram for post-ESD stricture. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study (2015-2024) included consecutive ESD patients with early esophageal neoplasia, excluding those with additional therapy, multiple lesions, comorbidities, recent infections, steroids, or loss to follow-up. Stricture: dysphagia or inability to pass a 9.8-mm scope within 12 months. CAR = preoperative C-reactive protein / albumin. The model was developed on the full cohort and internally validated via 1,000 bootstrap resamples (optimism-corrected). Logistic regression built the nomogram. Performance: area under the curve (AUC), sensitivity/specificity, calibration (Brier), and decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: Of 111 patients, 36 (32.4%) developed stricture. Independent predictors were infiltration depth (< M2 vs. ≥ M2), longitudinal length (<3.75 vs. ≥3.75 cm), circumferential extent (<0.5, 0.5-0.75, ≥0.75), and CAR (<0.03 vs. ≥0.03). The nomogram achieved an AUC of 0.866 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.800-0.931]. At the optimal cutoff, the sensitivity was 73.2% (95% CI: 56.9-85.4), specificity 83.1% (95% CI: 72.5-90.4), Brier score 0.122, and optimism-corrected AUC 0.889. Calibration and decision curves showed good performance and net benefit. CONCLUSIONS: CAR independently predicts post-ESD stricture. The nomogram is a promising preliminary risk-stratification tool, but requires external validation before its routine clinical use.

papers.title_zh: 亚肺叶切除T1a/bN0M0非小细胞肺癌中鳞癌OS较腺癌更差，但差异由非癌死亡驱动、肺癌特异性生存无显著差别
papers.title_en: Comparison of oncological outcomes between adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma after sublobar resection for T1a/bN0M0 non-small cell lung cancer: a propensity score-matched SEER study.
papers.authors: Wang Q, Shen H, Li D, Zheng Y, Wang M, She X, Cao L, Fu C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Taizhou Fourth People's Hospital, Taizhou, China.
papers.results: 匹配后每组1,129例，基线均衡。鳞癌OS更差：校正HR 1.34（95%CI 1.20-1.51，P<0.001），两个肿瘤大小亚组方向一致。LCSS校正后无显著差异：校正HR 0.95（95%CI 0.79-1.15，P=0.62），两个大小亚组内亦无差异。CIF分析：肺癌特异性死亡（LCSD）无显著差异（Gray's P=0.10），其他原因死亡（OCD）在鳞癌中显著更高（Gray's P<0.001）。Fine-Gray回归：鳞癌与LCSD无显著关联（校正sHR 0.85，95%CI 0.71-1.02，P=0.09），与OCD更高相关（校正sHR 1.66，95%CI 1.44-1.91，P<0.001）；上述竞争风险模式在两个肿瘤大小亚组一致。探索性分析显示两种组织学亚型内SEG相对WR均无一致的校正后生存优势。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在接受亚肺叶切除的T1a/bN0M0 NSCLC患者中，鳞癌与更差的OS相关，且在各肿瘤大小亚组一致；相反，鳞癌的LCSS和LCSD均未显著更差，而OCD发生率更高。因此鳞癌相关的较差总预后应在竞争性死亡而非肺癌特异性死亡的背景下解读。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未说明预先设定的主要终点（OS与LCSS并列报告），也未说明是否校正吸烟状态、合并症等竞争死亡的关键混杂因素；鳞癌OS差异完全由OCD驱动，若吸烟相关合并症未被充分调整，OS的组织学效应可能被高估——信息不足。回顾性SEER缺少复发/无病生存与疾病特异性复发数据，无法回答鳞癌复发风险问题。SEG vs WR的探索性比较未报告效能或匹配方法，结论偏弱。

pico.p: 2004-2022年SEER中接受肺段切除或楔形切除的单发T1a/bN0M0 NSCLC患者4,198例（腺癌3,066例，鳞癌1,132例）；1:1倾向评分匹配后每组1,129例
pico.ic: 组织学类型比较：鳞状细胞癌 vs 腺癌；另在各组织学亚型内探索性比较肺段切除（SEG） vs 楔形切除（WR）

papers.reason: 影响亚肺叶切除早期NSCLC患者的术后随访策略与合并症管理侧重：提示鳞癌患者需更积极管理非肿瘤死亡风险，而非加强肿瘤随访；同时为组织学亚型是否应改变手术范围（SEG vs WR）提供阴性证据
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Sublobar resection is increasingly used for selected patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, whether adenocarcinoma (ADC) and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) have comparable survival outcomes after sublobar resection remains uncertain, particularly when competing causes of death are considered. This study aimed to compare survival outcomes between ADC and SCC after sublobar resection, incorporating tumor size stratification and competing-risk analyses. METHODS: Patients with one primary T1a/bN0M0 NSCLC who underwent segmentectomy (SEG) or wedge resection (WR) between 2004 and 2022 were identified from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database. Overall survival (OS) and lung cancer-specific survival (LCSS) were compared between ADC and SCC using propensity score matching (PSM), Kaplan-Meier analysis, and Cox regression, with hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) reported. Tumor size-stratified analyses were also performed. Cumulative incidence functions (CIFs), Gray's test, and Fine-Gray regression were used to evaluate lung cancer-specific death (LCSD) and other-cause death (OCD) as competing events, with subdistribution hazard ratios (sHRs) reported. Exploratory comparisons of SEG and WR were conducted within each histologic subtype. RESULTS: Among 4,198 patients (3,066 ADC and 1,132 SCC), 1,129 patients remained in each group after 1:1 PSM with well-balanced baseline characteristics. SCC was independently associated with poorer OS than ADC (adjusted HR, 1.34; 95% CI, 1.20-1.51; P<0.001), with consistent associations in both tumor size subgroups. LCSS did not differ significantly after adjustment (adjusted HR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.79-1.15; P=0.62) or within either size subgroup. CIF analysis showed no significant difference in LCSD (Gray's P=0.10), whereas the CIF of OCD was significantly higher in SCC (Gray's P<0.001). Fine-Gray regression yielded consistent findings: SCC was not significantly associated with LCSD (adjusted sHR, 0.85; 95% CI, 0.71-1.02; P=0.09) but was associated with a higher subdistribution hazard of OCD (adjusted sHR, 1.66; 95% CI, 1.44-1.91; P<0.001). These competing-risk patterns were consistent in both tumor size subgroups. Exploratory analyses showed no consistent adjusted survival advantage of SEG over WR within either histologic subtype. CONCLUSIONS: Among patients with T1a/bN0M0 NSCLC undergoing sublobar resection, SCC was associated with poorer OS than ADC, consistently across tumor size subgroups. In contrast, neither LCSS nor LCSD was significantly worse in SCC, whereas the incidence of OCD was higher; these patterns were also consistent across tumor size subgroups. The poorer overall prognosis associated with SCC should therefore be interpreted in the context of competing mortality rather than lung cancer-specific mortality alone.

papers.title_zh: 中央型NSCLC新辅助化疗免疫治疗后手术降级：PSM后主要终点无获益且局部复发风险升高
papers.title_en: Surgical de-escalation strategies for non-small cell lung cancer following neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy: a propensity score-matched analysis.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Hui B, Wang X, Lin G, Wang X, Li X
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Peking University People's Hospital, Beijing, China.
papers.results: 中位随访33.9个月。未匹配队列：3年EFS 75.2% vs 63.4%（HR=0.56, P=0.04），3年RFS 73.6% vs 64.3%（HR=0.51, P=0.03）。PSM后EFS、RFS、OS均相当（all P>0.05）；但modified组局部复发风险显著升高（HR=5.39, 95%CI: 1.18-24.61, P=0.03）。围手术期并发症及术后呼吸困难发生率在匹配前后均更低（all P<0.05）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 对于精心选择的中央型NSCLC患者，NACI后手术降级与更低的术后呼吸困难评分相关，且获得了相当的肿瘤学结局。鉴于局部复发风险升高，需严密监测。
papers.ai_note: 主要终点EFS在PSM后无统计学差异（P>0.05），作者以'相当'表述替代等效性论证，同时突出次要终点（并发症、呼吸困难）的改善；PSM后局部复发HR=5.39但CI极宽（1.18-24.61），提示样本量不足、估计不稳定。未匹配队列的生存获益在匹配后消失，提示原始差异主要由混杂驱动。回顾性设计、单对匹配样本量有限，无法排除未测量混杂。信息不足：各组具体例数、降级手术的具体术式定义及化疗免疫方案均未在摘要中报告。

pico.p: 166例局部晚期中央型NSCLC，接受新辅助化疗免疫治疗（NACI）后行根治性手术切除
pico.ic: 手术降级（modified组）vs 标准手术（unmodified组），倾向性评分匹配

papers.reason: 影响中央型NSCLC新辅助化疗免疫治疗后的手术范围决策，提示降级手术在降低围手术期负担的同时可能以局部复发为代价，为临床权衡手术范围与肿瘤学安全提供参考
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Surgical de-escalation holds promise for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) following neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy (NACI), but evidence remains scarce. We aimed to assess the safety and clinical outcomes of surgical de-escalation following NACI in central NSCLC. METHODS: A dual-center retrospective cohort study included 166 patients with locally advanced central NSCLC who received NACI followed by curative surgical resection. Patients were stratified into modified (surgical de-escalation) and unmodified groups. Propensity score matching (PSM) was performed to balance baseline covariates, with standardized mean difference ≤0.1 indicating optimal balance. Primary endpoint comprised event-free survival (EFS), and Secondary endpoints included overall survival (OS), recurrence-free survival (RFS), local recurrence-free survival (LRFS), and health-related quality of life (HRQoL). Survival outcomes were analyzed using the Kaplan-Meier method and Cox proportional hazards regression to estimate hazard ratios (HR) and confidence intervals (CIs). RESULTS: At a median follow-up of 33.9 months, the modified surgery group showed superior 3-year EFS (75.2% vs. 63.4%, HR =0.56, P=0.04) and RFS (73.6% vs. 64.3%, HR =0.51, P=0.03) in the unmatched cohort. After PSM, EFS, RFS, and OS were comparable (all P>0.05); nevertheless, the modified surgery group demonstrated a significantly higher risk of local recurrence (HR =5.39, 95% CI: 1.18-24.61, P=0.03). The incidences of perioperative complications and postoperative dyspnea were consistently lower in the modified group before and after PSM (all P<0.05). CONCLUSIONS: For carefully selected central NSCLC patients, surgical de-escalation following NACI was associated with lower postoperative dyspnea scores and yielded comparable oncological outcomes. Rigorous surveillance is warranted due to the heightened risk of local recurrence.

papers.title_zh: 整合基线特征与术后早期生物标志物的食管切除术后吻合口漏预测列线图：单中心回顾性队列开发与内部验证（AUC 0.873、bootstrap校正0.859，尚无外部验证）
papers.title_en: Development and validation of a nomogram for predicting anastomotic leakage after esophagectomy: integrating baseline characteristics and early postoperative biomarkers.
papers.authors: Chong Z, Zhou L, Ma Z, Zhang A
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China.
papers.results: 吻合口漏发生38例（12.8%）。多因素分析识别5个独立预测因子：BMI、COPD、吻合口部位、术后第2天（POD 2）血清乳酸、POD 3中性粒细胞/淋巴细胞比值（NLR）。列线图AUC为0.873，bootstrap校正AUC为0.859（1,000次重抽样）。DCA显示模型在广泛阈值概率范围内提供优越的临床净获益（摘要未给出具体净获益数值）。模型在POD 3即可识别高危患者，而吻合口漏临床诊断中位时间为POD 8。
papers.authors_conclusion: 整合静态基线因素与动态生理反馈可产生高度准确的吻合口漏预测工具；该模型目前仅有内部验证。通过在POD 3即进行风险分层，该列线图提供了针对干预的关键5天窗口，但其更广泛的临床应用严格需要独立队列的确认。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/疑点：①仅单中心内部验证，无任何外部或时间外验证，作者亦承认需独立队列确认，AUC 0.873可能存在乐观偏倚；298例中38个事件对5个预测变量，EPV约7.6，属偏紧，过拟合风险未报告（无校准曲线、无CCI/校正统计量）；②DCA仅以'优越净获益'定性表述，摘要未提供任何净获益数值或参照模型对比，无法核实；③用POD 3的NLR预测吻合口漏存在时序问题——若部分漏在POD 3前发生或需该时点前手术/数据缺失，纳入人群与预测时点可能被隐性限定，摘要未交代此类事件处理；④'PPC驱动AL发生率'的表述与所列五预测因子（仅COPD、无PPC）不一致，属选择性强调；⑤'5天干预窗口'为基于中位诊断时间的推算，非前瞻性验证的临床结局获益。

pico.p: 2020年1月至2025年12月接受食管切除术的食管癌患者298例（回顾性队列），其中吻合口漏38例（12.8%）
pico.ic: 无干预与对照；为预测模型研究，比较模型判别力与临床净获益（AUC、bootstrap校正AUC、DCA）

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leakage (AL) is a devastating complication following esophagectomy. Current predictive models relying solely on static preoperative factors fail to capture the evolving postoperative physiological stressors. This study aimed to develop and validate a multidimensional nomogram integrating baseline vulnerability with early dynamic biomarkers to predict AL. METHODS: A retrospective cohort of 298 esophageal cancer patients who underwent esophagectomy between January 2020 and December 2025 was analyzed. Independent risk factors were identified using multivariate logistic regression. A predictive nomogram was constructed, evaluated using the area under the curve (AUC), internally validated via 1,000 bootstrap resamplings, and assessed for clinical utility using decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: AL occurred in 38 patients (12.8%). Multivariate analysis identified five independent predictors: body mass index (BMI), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), anastomosis site, postoperative day (POD) 2 serum lactate, and POD 3 neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR). The nomogram demonstrated excellent discrimination with an AUC of 0.873 and a bootstrap-corrected AUC of 0.859. Furthermore, DCA confirmed that the model provided superior clinical net benefit across a wide range of threshold probabilities. Notably, preexisting COPD and postoperative pulmonary complications (PPCs) drove AL incidence. The model accurately identified high-risk patients by POD 3, well before the median clinical AL diagnosis on POD 8. CONCLUSIONS: Integrating static baseline factors with dynamic physiological feedback yields a highly accurate AL prediction tool. However, this model is currently only internally validated. By stratifying risk as early as POD 3, this nomogram provides a critical 5-day window for targeted interventions, though its broader clinical implementation strictly requires confirmation in independent cohorts.

papers.title_zh: 基于术前CT影像组学与临床特征的列线图预测临床I期肺腺癌术后3年复发：两中心回顾性开发与外部验证（验证队列联合模型AUC 0.850，校准斜率0.763）
papers.title_en: Development and validation of an interpretable clinical-radiomics model for predicting 3-year postoperative recurrence in clinical stage I lung adenocarcinoma: a multicentre study.
papers.authors: Su Q, Wang B, Nie P, Xu W
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiology, The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University, Qingdao, China.
papers.results: 总人群333例中63例（18.9%）发生术后3年内复发。验证队列中临床模型、影像组学模型、联合模型的AUC分别为0.674（95%CI: 0.550-0.799）、0.781（95%CI: 0.668-0.893）、0.850（95%CI: 0.752-0.948），对应灵敏度/特异度分别为0.880/0.385、0.920/0.532、0.840/0.798。联合模型判别力显著优于临床模型（DeLong P=0.02）。验证队列中联合模型校准 intercept=-0.157、slope=0.763、Brier score=0.114。DCA提示两个队列中联合模型在一系列阈值概率范围内具有潜在净获益。
papers.authors_conclusion: 基于术前CT和临床特征的联合临床-影像组学模型在临床I期肺腺癌患者术后3年复发风险分层中显示出潜力；在临床应用前需要在更大规模的前瞻性队列中进一步验证。
papers.ai_note: 方法学疑点：①仅63个复发事件支撑临床+影像组学多特征联合模型，事件数/预测参数比偏低，且特征经ANOVA+LASSO在同一数据内筛选，验证队列仅134例，存在过拟合风险（校准斜率0.763<1亦提示预测偏乐观）；②将3年复发作二分类结局，未采用时间-事件方法处理删失，非复发者要求≥3年随访，可能存在随访完整性与选择偏倚；③仅报告联合模型对比临床模型的DeLong P=0.02，未报告与影像组学模型（AUC 0.781 vs 0.850）的比较检验，二者差异是否显著信息不足；④摘要未报告影像组学特征的重复性/鲁棒性验证、缺失数据处理、样本量/EPV估算及TRIPOD报告规范遵循情况，信息不足；⑤两个中心均来自单一国家，外部可推广性有限。

pico.ic: 干预：基于术前CT影像组学特征+临床特征的联合预测模型；对照：单纯临床模型与单纯影像组学模型（同一队列内横向比较，无治疗干预）

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Although surgical resection is the standard curative treatment for clinical stage I lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), a clinically meaningful proportion of patients still experience postoperative recurrence. Conventional clinical and computed tomography (CT) imaging features have limited ability to provide individualized preoperative risk stratification. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an interpretable CT-based clinical-radiomics model for predicting recurrence within 3 years after surgery in patients with clinical stage I LUAD. METHODS: This multicentre retrospective prediction model development and validation study included 333 patients with pathologically confirmed clinical stage I LUAD who underwent surgical resection between January 2020 and December 2021. Patients from Center 1 (The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University) (n=199) constituted the training cohort, and those from Center 2 (The Fourth Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine) (n=134) served as the validation cohort. The outcome was recurrence within 3 years after surgery (determined by imaging findings, clinical follow-up records, and pathological confirmation when available). Patients without recurrence were required to have at least 3 years of follow-up. Radiomics features were extracted from preoperative CT images and selected using analysis of variance (ANOVA) and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, while clinical predictors were identified using univariable and multivariable logistic regression. Radiomics, clinical, and combined models were evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, calibration, and decision curve analysis (DCA). SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was used to interpret the optimal model. RESULTS: Overall, 63 of 333 patients (18.9%) experienced recurrence within 3 years after surgery. In the validation cohort, the clinical, radiomics, and combined models achieved the areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.674 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.550-0.799], 0.781 (95% CI: 0.668-0.893), and 0.850 (95% CI: 0.752-0.948), respectively, with corresponding sensitivities/specificities of 0.880/0.385, 0.920/0.532, and 0.840/0.798. The combined model showed significantly better discrimination than the clinical model (DeLong P=0.02). The combined model showed acceptable calibration in the validation cohort, with the calibration intercept, calibration slope, and Brier score were -0.157, 0.763, and 0.114, respectively. DCA suggested a potential net benefit of the combined model across a range of threshold probabilities in both cohorts, while SHAP analysis provided individualized interpretation of model predictions. CONCLUSIONS: The combined clinical-radiomics model based on preoperative CT and clinical characteristics showed potential for stratifying the risk of recurrence within 3 years after surgery in patients with clinical stage I LUAD. Further validation in larger, prospective cohorts is warranted before clinical implementation.

papers.authors: Dai S, Zuo W, Yu B

papers.results: 主要终点TIL（导航成功率）100%（30/30）；中心击中率66.7%（20/30）；总体诊断率90%（27/30）；恶性诊断敏感度90.9%（20/22）；平均CTBD 13.4 mm；病灶平均直径14.0±4.3 mm，距最近支气管中位距离18 mm；气胸2例（6.7%），轻微出血7例（23.3%），无严重不良事件

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Bronchus-unconnected peripheral pulmonary lesions (PPLs) pose diagnostic challenges due to lack of direct airway access and computed tomography (CT)-to-body divergence (CTBD). We evaluated robotic-assisted bronchoscopy (RAB) combined with the intraprocedural CT-guided navigation with ventilatory strategy for atelectasis (ICNVA) strategy. METHODS: This prospective, single-arm study enrolled patients (18-75 years) with pulmonary nodules (6-30 mm) lacking a bronchus sign. All underwent RAB with the ICNVA strategy, integrating preoperative mapping, intraprocedural breath-holds to minimize atelectasis, and real-time CT confirmation. The primary endpoint was tool-in-lesion (TIL) rate. Secondary endpoints included diagnostic yield, center strike rate, CTBD, and safety. RESULTS: Thirty patients were enrolled (mean age 55.6±10.7 years). Lesions had a mean diameter of 14.0±4.3 mm and a median distance to the nearest bronchus of 18 mm. The ICNVA strategy resulted in a mean CTBD of 13.4 mm. We achieved a 100% (30/30) navigational success rate (TIL) and a 66.7% (20/30) center strike rate. The overall diagnostic yield was 90% (27/30), with 90.9% (20/22) sensitivity for malignancy. Pneumothorax occurred in 2 patients (6.7%) and mild hemorrhage in 7 (23.3%), with no severe adverse events occurred. CONCLUSIONS: RAB combined with the ICNVA strategy demonstrates high diagnostic yield and safety for bronchus-unconnected PPLs. This approach effectively mitigates CTBD, enabling precise localization and sampling of lesions traditionally considered difficult to access.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Despite complete surgical resection, stage I lung adenocarcinoma exhibits a postoperative recurrence rate of 15-27%, exposing the prognostic limitations of the current Tumor Node Metastasis (TNM) staging system. While the 2020 International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer (IASLC) three-tier grading system significantly improves risk stratification based on high-grade morphological components, it does not incorporate tumor spread through air spaces (STAS), a recognized independent adverse prognostic factor. This review aims to systematically examine the incremental prognostic value of STAS within the framework of the new IASLC grading system and explore its clinical implications. METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was conducted using the PubMed database to retrieve relevant English-language studies. The review synthesized evidence focusing on the distribution of STAS across histological subtypes, its dose-response relationship with high-grade components, its impact on surgical decision-making, and the critical diagnostic distinction between true STAS and ex vivo artifacts. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: Current evidence reveals a significant dose-response relationship between STAS and high-grade patterns; notably, the presence of even 5% high-grade components substantially elevates the risk of STAS. Retrospective cohorts consistently demonstrate that STAS strongly predicts disease-free survival and is a critical risk factor for local recurrence following sublobar resection. Crucially, STAS-positive IASLC Grade 2 tumors exhibit recurrence risks overlapping with those of Grade 3, supporting an "upstaging hypothesis" that warrants prospective validation. Furthermore, the clinical translation of STAS remains constrained by the high false-negative rates of intraoperative frozen sections and the ongoing debate regarding artifactual floaters. CONCLUSIONS: Integrating STAS status as a collaborative parameter with the IASLC grading system constitutes a conceptual synthesis rather than an established clinical framework for stage I lung adenocarcinoma without necessitating additional molecular testing. Because the current evidence is based predominantly on retrospective data, prospective randomized controlled trial (RCT) validation is required before this approach can be regarded as best clinical practice.

papers.title_zh: 完全切除的I期肺腺癌中罕见EGFR突变的突变谱、临床病理特征与预后：真实世界研究
papers.title_en: Rare epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations in completely resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma: a real-world study of mutation spectrum, clinicopathological features, and prognosis.
papers.authors: Man L, Xia L, Li C, Hao X, Zhang X, Cui R, Guo C, Xie Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery and Institute of Thoracic Oncology, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, Chi…
papers.results: 1357例EGFR阳性I期LUAD中176例纳入罕见突变队列；最常见亚组G719X（n=104）、L861Q（n=71）、S768I（n=24）；5年OS 95.8%，5年RFS 93.5%；微乳头成分与更短RFS相关（HR=4.062，95%CI: 1.134-14.544，P=0.03，多变量主模型）；病理高危特征数量与RFS相关（global log-rank P=0.039）；IB期辅助系统治疗与RFS无显著关联；复合罕见突变状态与RFS无显著关联；PSM后罕见突变组OS相似、复发风险低于经典突变组（摘要未给出具体HR/CI/P值）
papers.authors_conclusion: 排除孤立T790M和单纯外显子20插入后，完全切除的I期LUAD伴罕见EGFR突变显示出良好的长期预后。与经典突变相比，罕见突变在治疗均衡匹配后与更低的复发风险和相似的OS相关。病理特征（尤其是微乳头成分）可能有助于识别复发高危患者。
papers.ai_note: 罕见突变定义为研究自定（排除孤立T790M、exon20ins-only及主要驱动共突变），与国际共识分类可能不完全一致，人群限定存在松动风险；微乳头成分HR的95%CI极宽（1.134-14.544），提示亚组样本量小、估计不精确；PSM后罕见突变组复发风险低于经典突变组，但摘要未提供具体HR/CI/P值，无法验证；IB期辅助治疗阴性结论可能受样本量不足影响，信息不足；单中心回顾性设计存在选择偏倚可能。

pico.p: 华西医院2011-2024年R0切除病理I期LUAD且术后EGFR检测阳性者共1357例，其中罕见突变队列176例
pico.ic: 罕见EGFR突变（排除孤立T790M、单纯外显子20插入及主要驱动基因共突变）vs 经典EGFR突变（1:2 PSM后比较）；IB期辅助治疗与非辅助治疗比较

papers.reason: 为I期肺腺癌术后EGFR罕见突变患者的随访强度和辅助治疗决策提供真实世界预后基线数据；微乳头成分作为复发高危标志物的发现可辅助术后风险分层
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Rare epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations are heterogeneous, and their significance after complete resection of stage I lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains unclear. We evaluated the mutation spectrum, clinicopathological correlates, postoperative recurrence patterns, and survival outcomes of a study-defined primary rare EGFR mutation cohort after predefined exclusion of isolated T790M, exon 20 insertion-only disease, and major driver co-alterations. METHODS: Consecutive patients who underwent R0 resection for pathological stage I LUAD with postoperative EGFR testing at West China Hospital between 2011 and 2024 were retrospectively identified. Rare mutation subtypes, compound mutation patterns, recurrence-free survival (RFS), and overall survival (OS) were assessed. Prognostic factors were evaluated using Cox regression, and outcomes were compared with classical EGFR mutations using 1:2 propensity score matching (PSM). RESULTS: Among 1,357 EGFR-positive stage I LUADs, 176 patients formed the primary rare-mutation cohort. The most frequent rare mutation groups were G719X (n=104), L861Q (n=71), and S768I (n=24), with distinct compound mutation patterns. Five-year OS and RFS were 95.8% and 93.5%, respectively. A micropapillary component was associated with shorter RFS in the primary multivariable model [hazard ratio (HR) =4.062, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.134-14.544; P=0.03]. The unweighted number of pathological high-risk features was associated with RFS (global log-rank P=0.039), whereas adjuvant systemic therapy among stage IB patients and compound rare mutation status were not significantly associated with RFS. After PSM under comparable observed postoperative management, the rare-mutation group had similar OS and a lower recurrence risk than the classical-mutation group. CONCLUSIONS: After exclusion of isolated T790M and exon 20 insertion-only disease, completely resected stage I LUAD with rare EGFR mutations showed favorable long-term outcomes. Compared with classical mutations, rare mutations were associated with lower recurrence risk and similar OS after treatment-balanced matching. Pathological features, particularly a micropapillary component, may help identify patients at higher risk of recurrence.

papers.title_zh: 多模态深度学习模型（CT+临床+病理）预测非特异性良性肺穿刺活检假阴性：双中心内部验证 AUC 0.825，但与影像-临床模型相比未显显著增益
papers.title_en: Development and internal validation of a multimodal deep learning model integrating imaging, clinical and pathological features to predict false-negatives in non-specific benign lung biopsies: a dual-center study.
papers.authors: Yuan J, Li W, Liu C, He L, Yang Q, Mao R, Huang X, Zhang W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiology, Daping Hospital, Army Medical University, Chongqing, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: This multimodal model shows promising discriminative performance for predicting false-negative PTNB results. Since performance metrics and the 0.225 threshold were obtained from internal random hold out validation, external independent-cohort validation and threshold optimization are mandatory prior to clinical decision-support application.
papers.ai_note: 选择性强调：核心卖点为“多模态（含病理）”，但组合模型与仅省去病理的影像-临床模型差异无统计学意义（P=0.26），病理特征的增量价值未被证实，摘要仍以多模态模型为主标题结论。信息不足/方法学疑点：阈值0.225与全部性能指标均在同一随机留出测试集上获得（阈值选择与评估未分离，存在乐观偏倚）；测试集仅19例事件，CI宽；与放射科医师的比较无统计检验，且以准确率为主而该测试集75.6%为真阴性，类别不平衡下准确率易被高估；摘要未报告校准度、决策曲线或外部验证；参考标准含“≥2年影像稳定或缓解”，可能将缓慢生长的恶性病变误归为良性；背景称假阴性率高达49%，而本队列为22.3%，人群选择差异未说明。

pico.p: 两家三级医院2020年1月-2022年12月连续收治的非特异性良性PTNB结果患者，共403例纳入（平均年龄57.19±10.2岁，男性289例）；随机80%/20%分为训练集与测试集，测试集n=78，其中假阴性恶性19例
pico.ic: 干预：多模态组合模型（CT影像特征+临床变量+四项病理描述）；对照：仅影像模型（CT）、影像-临床模型（CT+临床）、以及4名胸部放射科医师（4-15年经验）的判读准确率

papers.reason: 影响非特异性良性肺穿刺活检后患者是否需重复活检/手术或延长随访的决策，同时为胸部AI影像模型的转化评估提供内部验证基线与阈值取值的偏倚警示。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Computed tomography (CT)-guided percutaneous transthoracic needle biopsy (PTNB) is widely used for lung lesion evaluation. Non-specific benign PTNB results create important clinical challenges. These outcomes carry a considerable risk of false-negative malignancy, with reported rates as high as 49%. Missed cancer diagnoses may delay curative-intent treatment. This study developed and internally validated a multimodal deep learning model. The model combines CT imaging, clinical variables, and pathological features. Its goal was to distinguish false-negative malignancy from non-specific benign PTNB results. METHODS: In this dual-center retrospective study, consecutive patients with non-specific benign PTNB results from two tertiary hospitals (January 2020-December 2022) were screened, and 403 patients (mean age, 57.19±10.2 years; 289 male patients) with complete clinical, imaging, and follow-up data were included. The reference standard for the final diagnosis combined at least 2 years of imaging stability or resolution, surgical pathology, repeat biopsy, or documented clinical progression. Candidate predictors included CT imaging features, clinical variables (demographics, smoking status, tumor markers), and four pathological descriptors. Three models were developed: an imaging model (CT only), an imaging-clinical model (CT and clinical data), and a combined model (CT, clinical data, and pathological features). Patients were randomly split into training (80%) and test (20%) sets. Model performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis and compared using the DeLong test. Diagnostic accuracy was also compared with that of the four thoracic radiologists (4-15 years of experience). RESULTS: Overall, 90 patients (22.3%) had false-negative malignancy, with 19 events in the test set (n=78). The combined model achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.825 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.710, 0.923], significantly outperforming the imaging model (AUC 0.655, 95% CI: 0.507, 0.794; P=0.04). It was numerically superior to the imaging-clinical model (AUC, 0.789; 95% CI: 0.667, 0.892; P=0.26), with no statistically significant difference observed between the two models. At the optimal threshold of 0.225, the combined model showed an accuracy of 0.782 (95% CI: 0.678, 0.859), a sensitivity of 0.842 (95% CI: 0.624, 0.945), and a specificity of 0.763 (95% CI: 0.640, 0.853), noting that 75.6% of test cases were true negatives. The combined model's accuracy exceeded that of the four radiologists (range, 58.97-73.08%), although this comparison was descriptive without formal statistical testing. CONCLUSIONS: This multimodal model shows promising discriminative performance for predicting false-negative PTNB results. Since performance metrics and the 0.225 threshold were obtained from internal random hold out validation, external independent-cohort validation and threshold optimization are mandatory prior to clinical decision-support application.

papers.title_zh: 可解释机器学习预测可切除NSCLC新辅助化免治疗≥3级治疗相关不良事件：外部验证判别力中等且主要反映血液学毒性
papers.title_en: Explainable machine learning for predicting grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events in resectable non-small cell lung cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy: predominant contribution of hematologic toxicity.
papers.authors: Zhi FH, Zhang Y, Ge T, Yang L, Dong Y, Wen J, Si H, Chen J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, School of Medicine, Tongji University, Shanghai, China.
papers.results: Grade ≥3 TRAEs 发生于 1,096 例患者中的 496 例（45.3%）；464 例（42.3%）发生 grade ≥3 血液学毒性；446 例（占 grade ≥3 TRAE 患者的 89.9%）仅因血液学事件达到复合终点。含 12 个治疗前预测因子的最终随机森林模型在内部测试集与外部验证集的 AUC 分别为 0.782 和 0.742。将锁定的总体-TRAE模型应用于毒性亚型时，对 grade ≥3 血液学毒性的判别力维持（AUC 分别为 0.764 和 0.732），但对 grade ≥3 非血液学毒性明显较弱（0.638 和 0.631），对任何级别 irAEs 为 0.435 和 0.535。血液学毒性特异性模型在内部测试集与外部验证集的 AUC 分别为 0.777 和 0.711。摘要未报告置信区间与P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: The pretreatment random forest model showed moderate external discrimination for overall grade ≥3 TRAEs, primarily reflecting hematologic toxicity.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未给出任何AUC的95%CI、校准度量化指标或DCA净获益数值，也未报告内部与外部性能差异的统计检验，模型稳定性信息不足。次要终点（血液学、非血液学、irAE）分析中，锁定模型对任何级别irAE的AUC为0.435和0.535，接近甚至低于随机水平，提示该模型对irAE基本无判别力，而摘要结论仅强调总体与血液学终点的中等表现，存在选择性强调。复合终点89.9%由血液学事件驱动，使“总体TRAE预测”在很大程度等同于血液学毒性预测，对临床真正关切的非血液学严重毒性与irAE预警价值有限。外部验证队列仅143例，样本量偏小；全部为回顾性数据，无前瞻性验证。

pico.p: 接受新辅助化免治疗的可切除NSCLC患者：发现队列953例（训练集668例、内部测试集285例），独立外部验证队列143例，共1,096例
pico.ic: 基于12项治疗前预测因子的随机森林模型（经Boruta变量筛选+VIF评估、10-fold交叉验证调优的8种机器学习算法中选出）；比较对象为内部测试集与独立外部验证集的判别表现，并对血液学/非血液学/irAE亚型终点做次要分析

papers.reason: 影响接受新辅助化免治疗的可切除NSCLC患者术前毒性风险分层与随访强度安排的参考，同时提示现有治疗前ML模型主要捕捉血液学毒性、难以预警非血液学及irAE，为后续毒性预测模型研究的终点选择与验证设计提供对照基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy improves outcomes for resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but can cause severe treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs). Pretreatment models for predicting grade ≥3 TRAEs during neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy remain limited. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an explainable machine learning model for predicting grade ≥3 TRAEs in patients with resectable NSCLC receiving neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study included a discovery cohort (n=953) and an independent external validation cohort (n=143). The discovery cohort was stratified into training (n=668) and internal test (n=285) sets. Pretreatment candidates included routine clinical and laboratory variables and first-cycle treatment characteristics. Stability-oriented Boruta selection was used for variable selection, followed by variance inflation factor (VIF) assessment. Eight machine learning (ML) algorithms were tuned using 10-fold cross-validation in the training set. Discrimination, calibration, decision curve analysis (DCA), and explanations based on SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were evaluated. Secondary analyses assessed hematologic, nonhematologic, and immune-related adverse event (irAE) endpoints. RESULTS: Grade ≥3 TRAEs occurred in 496 of 1,096 patients (45.3%); 464 patients (42.3%) experienced grade ≥3 hematologic toxicity, and 446 (89.9% of patients with grade ≥3 TRAEs) reached the composite endpoint exclusively because of hematologic events. The final random forest model incorporating 12 pretreatment predictors achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 0.782 and 0.742 in the internal test and external validation cohorts, respectively. When the locked overall-TRAE model was applied to toxicity subtypes, discrimination was maintained for grade ≥3 hematologic toxicity (AUCs, 0.764 and 0.732) but was substantially weaker for grade ≥3 nonhematologic toxicity (0.638 and 0.631) and any-grade irAEs (0.435 and 0.535). The hematologic toxicity-specific model achieved AUCs of 0.777 and 0.711 in the internal test and external validation cohorts, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: The pretreatment random forest model showed moderate external discrimination for overall grade ≥3 TRAEs, primarily reflecting hematologic toxicity.

papers.title_zh: 伴恶性胸腔积液肺癌患者的一线治疗模式与生存：27中心回顾性队列中化疗联合贝伐珠单抗组OS显著更长而PFS未达显著
papers.title_en: First-line systemic treatment patterns and outcomes in lung cancer patients with malignant pleural effusion: a retrospective multicenter study.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Wang R, Xiang Y, Wei H, Cao Y, Peng L, Li C, Song H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, State Key Laboratory of Respiratory Health and Multimorbidity, Preci…
papers.results: 全队列中位OS 26.1个月；全身治疗对比未行全身治疗中位OS 28.1 vs 12.7个月，P<0.001；驱动基因阳性NSCLC对比阴性中位OS 34.1 vs 22.6个月，P<0.001；SCLC两种方案间PFS与OS差异均无统计学意义；驱动基因阳性NSCLC靶向联合对比单药校正后PFS HR 0.74，P=0.09，OS HR 0.67，P=0.10（均未达显著）；驱动基因阴性NSCLC化疗+贝伐珠单抗对比单纯化疗中位OS 41.8 vs 21.4个月，P=0.04，OS HR 0.59，95%CI 0.38–0.90，P=0.02，PFS HR 0.72，95%CI 0.51–1.01，P=0.055（未达显著），≥3级TRAE 14.8%；治疗模式分布：SCLC单纯化疗50.8%（62/122）、化疗+免疫47.5%（58/122），驱动基因阳性NSCLC靶向治疗91.4%（415/454），驱动基因阴性NSCLC单纯化疗27.8%（126/453）、化疗+免疫15.9%（72/453）、化疗+贝伐珠单抗17.9%（81/453）
papers.authors_conclusion: First-line systemic therapy was associated with improved survival in lung cancer patients with MPE, though outcomes differed according to histologic and molecular subtypes. The addition of bevacizumab to chemotherapy was independently associated with longer OS among patients with driver gene-negative NSCLC with MPE.
papers.ai_note: 核心发现为贝伐珠单抗组：OS阳性而主要终点之一的PFS未达显著（HR 0.72，95%CI 0.51–1.01，P=0.055），摘要结论只强调OS独立相关，存在以次要/单终点替代主要终点的倾向。靶向联合对比单药PFS与OS均未达显著却以'非显著趋势'表述。回顾性设计、非随机分组，化疗+贝伐珠单抗组仅81/453例，易受适应证混杂（PS较好、无出血/脑转移倾向者更可能用贝伐）影响；未报告倾向评分匹配或多因素校正变量清单，也未报告MPE处理方式（引流/胸膜固定）与免疫治疗在驱动基因阴性NSCLC中的比较结果。'全身治疗对比未治疗'的12.6%未治人群基线差异大，OS获益解读需谨慎。信息不足：各亚组PFS数值、随访时长、贝伐珠单抗剂量与联合方案细节

pico.p: 中国27个中心的肺癌伴恶性胸腔积液患者1,029例（NSCLC 88.1%，SCLC 11.9%；87.4%接受一线全身治疗）
pico.ic: 一线全身治疗（靶向治疗、化疗、化疗+免疫、化疗+贝伐珠单抗）对比未行全身治疗；驱动基因阳性NSCLC中靶向联合对比单药；驱动基因阴性NSCLC中化疗+贝伐珠单抗对比单纯化疗；SCLC中化疗对比化疗+免疫

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Malignant pleural effusion (MPE) is a frequent complication of advanced lung cancer with poor prognosis. The optimal first-line systemic treatment for these patients remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate first-line systemic treatment patterns and outcomes in lung cancer patients with MPE. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study across 27 centers in China evaluated the efficacy and safety of first-line systemic therapy in lung cancer patients with MPE from 2013 to 2024. The primary endpoints were progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). RESULTS: Of 1,029 patients included, 88.1% had non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and 11.9% had small cell lung cancer (SCLC); 87.4% received first-line systemic therapy. SCLC patients received chemotherapy alone (50.8%; 62/122) or combined with immunotherapy (47.5%; 58/122). Most driver gene-positive NSCLC patients received targeted therapy (91.4%; 415/454). Driver gene-negative NSCLC patients primarily received chemotherapy alone (27.8%; 126/453), chemotherapy plus immunotherapy (15.9%; 72/453), or chemotherapy plus bevacizumab (17.9%; 81/453). Median OS for the overall cohort was 26.1 months. Systemic therapy significantly extended median OS compared to no systemic therapy (28.1 vs. 12.7 months; P<0.001). Driver gene-positive NSCLC had longer OS than driver gene-negative patients (34.1 vs. 22.6 months; P<0.001). In SCLC, no significant PFS or OS difference was observed between the two regimens. After adjustment, targeted combination therapy versus monotherapy showed non-significant trends for PFS [hazard ratio (HR), 0.74; P=0.09] and OS (HR, 0.67; P=0.10) among driver gene-positive NSCLC. Among driver gene-negative NSCLC, chemotherapy plus bevacizumab significantly improved median OS versus chemotherapy alone (41.8 vs. 21.4 months; P=0.04) and was an independent predictor of favorable OS [HR, 0.59; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.38-0.90; P=0.02], despite no significant PFS improvement (HR, 0.72; 95% CI: 0.51-1.01; P=0.055), with a manageable safety profile [grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs): 14.8%]. CONCLUSIONS: First-line systemic therapy was associated with improved survival in lung cancer patients with MPE, though outcomes differed according to histologic and molecular subtypes. The addition of bevacizumab to chemotherapy was independently associated with longer OS among patients with driver gene-negative NSCLC with MPE.
