papers.title_zh: 不可切除局部晚期鳞癌根治性放化疗的14年真实世界生存曲线与预后分层：10年OS约35%，PFS1≥12个月被报告为最强保护因素（HR=2.70）
papers.title_en: Long-term survival patterns and prognostic stratification in patients with unresectable locally advanced squamous cell lung cancer receiving definitive chemoradiotherapy: a 14-year single-center real-world cohort.
papers.authors: Jia Z, Huo J, Yang J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiation Oncology, The Fourth Hospital of Hebei Medical University & Hebei Clinical Research Center for R…
papers.results: 10年OS率35.0%；OS曲线呈三阶段：前3年高危期约占全部事件的一半，3至10年下降减速，10年后进入平台期，10年与14年OS率均约35%。首次疾病进展发生于86.0%的患者，其中32.0%为寡转移（≤5个转移灶、局限于有限解剖部位）；接受积极局部挽救治疗者14年PFS2率48.0%。诊断至放疗启动≤3个月对比>3个月的ORR为73.0% vs 57.0%，P<0.05。多因素Cox分析（enter法）中年龄<65岁、外周型肿瘤、无放射性肺炎、一线治疗客观缓解、PFS1≥12个月为OS独立保护因素，其中PFS1≥12个月效应最强（HR=2.70，P<0.001）。首次进展后数据截止2026年6月1日，最大随访超过14年。
papers.authors_conclusion: 不可切除局部晚期鳞癌患者经根治性放化疗后10年生存率可达35%，10年里程碑后复发与全因死亡风险显著降低；PFS1≥12个月是简单而稳健的长期生存预后生物标志物，对寡转移灶的积极局部挽救治疗可实现持久疾病控制；监测日程与巩固策略可依据患者12个月时的无进展状态进行个体化调整。
papers.ai_note: HR方向存疑：摘要将PFS1≥12个月列为保护因素却报告HR=2.70（>1），未说明参照组方向，信息不足。放射性肺炎被列为保护因素与常见报告方向相反，可能存在适应证/治疗强度混杂。ORR的放疗时机比较（73.0% vs 57.0%）似为未校正的单因素比较，P仅给<P<0.05且无CI。寡转移挽救治疗的PFS2=48.0%为选择性接受治疗者的条件性结果，无未治疗对照，存在明显选择偏倚与永生时间偏倚风险。结论中监测与巩固策略个体化建议超出该回顾性设计可支持的证据强度；单中心中国人群外部可推广性有限，无独立验证队列。

pico.p: 2012-2019年单中心260例IIIA-IIIC期不可切除鳞状细胞肺癌（SqCLC）患者，接受根治性放化疗
pico.ic: 摘要未设干预对照组；内部比较包括诊断至放疗启动≤3个月 vs >3个月、PFS1≥12个月 vs <12个月、接受积极局部挽救治疗 vs 未接受

papers.reason: 为不可切除局部晚期鳞癌根治性放化疗后的长期生存预期提供10-14年真实世界基线，直接影响随访强度与12个月无进展状态下的分层管理决策，同时提示寡转移挽救治疗这一研究方向的对照设计需求
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Real-world data with more than 10 years of follow-up among Chinese patients with unresectable locally advanced squamous cell lung cancer (SqCLC) treated with definitive chemoradiotherapy are scarce. This single-center cohort with complete 14-year longitudinal surveillance was constructed to map long-term survival kinetics, screen independent prognostic markers, and depict full disease trajectories, so as to facilitate stratified surveillance and personalized therapeutic management. METHODS: This retrospective single-center real-world cohort enrolled 260 stage IIIA-IIIC unresectable SqCLC patients receiving definitive chemoradiotherapy between 2012-2019. Kaplan-Meier curves were used to estimate overall survival (OS), first progression-free survival (PFS1), and post-salvage second progression-free survival (PFS2); the log-rank test was applied for inter-group comparison. Multivariable Cox proportional-hazards regression (enter method) was utilized to screen independent prognostic factors, and a clinically-oriented 12-month PFS1 cutoff was used for risk stratification. RESULTS: With maximum follow-up exceeding 14 years (data cut-off June 1, 2026), the 10-year OS rate was 35.0%. The survival curve exhibited a distinct three-phase trajectory: a high-risk phase during the first 3 years accounting for approximately half of all events, a decelerating decline from year 3 to 10, and a stable plateau beyond 10 years, with OS rates at 10 and 14 years both approximating 35%. Multivariable analysis identified age <65 years, peripherally located tumors, absence of radiation pneumonitis, objective response to first-line therapy, and PFS1 ≥12 months as independent protective factors for OS, among which PFS1 ≥12 months yielded the strongest effect [hazard ratio (HR) =2.70, P<0.001]. First disease progression occurred in 86.0% of patients, of whom 32.0% presented with oligometastatic lesions (defined as ≤5 metastatic lesions confined to limited anatomic sites without widespread disseminated disease); those receiving active local salvage therapy achieved a 14-year PFS2 rate of 48.0%. An interval of ≤3 months from diagnosis to radiotherapy initiation was associated with a significantly higher objective response rate (ORR) compared with >3 months (73.0% vs. 57.0%, P<0.05). CONCLUSIONS: A 10-year survival rate of 35% is achievable in patients with locally advanced unresectable SqCLC after definitive chemoradiotherapy, with substantially reduced risks of recurrence and all-cause mortality beyond the 10-year landmark. A PFS1 ≥12 months serves as a simple and robust prognostic biomarker for long-term survival, and active local salvage of oligometastatic lesions enables durable disease control. Surveillance schedules and consolidation strategies may be tailored according to patients' progression-free status at 12 months.

papers.title_zh: 解剖性肺切除术前风险分层与患者选择的现状梳理：2025 ERS/ESTS指南与AATS共识后仍存的阈值争议
papers.title_en: Patient selection and risk stratification for lung resection: a narrative review.
papers.authors: Lauricella LL, Terra RM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Thoracic Surgery, Instituto do Câncer do Estado de São Paulo (ICESP), Hospital das Clínicas HCFMUSP, Faculda…
papers.results: 2025 ERS/ESTS指南运动试验算法按三个风险层级设定：peak VO₂ ≥15、12–15、<12 mL/kg/min；VE/VCO₂ slope <35、35–40、>40。该分级建议本身仅限于CPET的应用，不背书任何特定参数或界值，仅将 peak VO₂ <12 mL/kg/min 或 VE/VCO₂ slope >40 提示为高手术风险。
papers.authors_conclusion: Contemporary risk stratification integrates cardiopulmonary physiology, ventilatory efficiency, frailty and nutrition with the configuration of the operation itself. Threshold calibration in the minimally invasive era, the optimal VE/VCO2 slope threshold and standardised frailty measurement remain unresolved.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，检索仅限英文文献且未描述系统筛选/质量评价流程，存在选择性纳入与发表偏倚风险；摘要中出现的 peak VO₂ 与 VE/VCO₂ slope 数值均为引用的指南分层区间，非本研究产生的数据，易被误读为经过本综述验证的阈值——而作者同时明确指出该分级建议并未背书任何特定参数或界值，两者存在张力；结论未给出任何新证据下的定量推荐，属信息不足；'所有数值经原文核对'为方法学声明，不能替代证据分级。

pico.p: 早期非小细胞肺癌接受解剖性肺切除的患者（叙述性综述，无具体样本量）
pico.ic: 术前风险分层策略：传统顺序评估（心脏评估→肺功能→选择性CPET）与2025 ERS/ESTS指南（新增衰弱与营养状态评估、预康复、将风险预测模型定位为基准比较工具）及2021 AATS共识（衰弱与功能状态优先于实际年龄）的对照；无头对头比较

papers.reason: 为可切除NSCLC患者术前麻醉/手术风险评估与切除范围决策提供最新指南口径（CPET阈值、衰弱与营养、预康复），并明确指出微创时代阈值再校准与VE/VCO₂ slope最优界值尚未解决，可作为围手术期风险分层课题的选题依据与基线对照。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Anatomical lung resection remains the cornerstone of curative treatment for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer, and patient selection is a major determinant of postoperative outcome. For more than a decade, preoperative assessment relied on three guidelines-American College of Chest Physicians (ACCP) (2013), European Respiratory Society/European Society of Thoracic Surgeons (ERS/ESTS) (2009) and British Thoracic Society/Society for Cardiothoracic Surgery (BTS/SCTS) (2010)-sharing a sequential approach of cardiac assessment, pulmonary function testing and, in selected patients, cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET). Since then, minimally invasive surgery became standard, randomised trials validated sublobar resection, and evidence accumulated for new predictors, particularly the minute ventilation-to-carbon dioxide output (VE/VCO2) slope, frailty and sarcopenia. This review synthesises current preoperative risk stratification in light of the 2025 ERS/ESTS guideline and the 2021 American Association for Thoracic Surgery (AATS) expert consensus. METHODS: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE for English-language literature on preoperative risk stratification and patient selection for anatomical lung resection, supplemented by hand-searching of reference lists and prioritising guidelines, randomised trials, systematic reviews and multicentre cohort studies. All numerical data were verified against the original publications. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: The 2025 ERS/ESTS guideline introduces formal assessment of frailty and nutritional status, endorses prehabilitation, and repositions risk-prediction models as tools for benchmarking rather than individual selection. Its exercise-testing algorithm considers peak oxygen consumption and the VE/VCO₂ slope together in three risk categories (peak VO2 ≥15, 12-15 and <12 mL/kg/min; slope <35, 35-40 and >40). The graded recommendation itself is confined to the use of CPET and does not endorse any specific parameter or cut-off, identifying only a peak VO₂ below 12 mL/kg/min or a VE/VCO2 slope above 40 as suggestive of high surgical risk. The AATS consensus independently ranks frailty and functional status above chronological age. Together, these developments support a shift from a binary judgement of operability to a structured process that also determines how to operate, adapting the extent of resection and the surgical approach to the patient's physiological reserve. CONCLUSIONS: Contemporary risk stratification integrates cardiopulmonary physiology, ventilatory efficiency, frailty and nutrition with the configuration of the operation itself. Threshold calibration in the minimally invasive era, the optimal VE/VCO2 slope threshold and standardised frailty measurement remain unresolved.

papers.title_zh: 中国IB-IIIC期NSCLC真实世界治疗模式：10中心1000例回顾性描述分析，无疗效结局
papers.title_en: Real-world treatment patterns in stage IB-IIIC non-small cell lung cancer in China: the KEY-RAISE study.
papers.authors: Zhong H, Yan S, Zeng J, Ba Y, Mei J, Sun D, Fu X, Liang W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, Shanghai Chest Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of M…
papers.results: 总人群n=1,000，男性69.6%，平均年龄60.4岁，当前/既往吸烟52.9%，非鳞癌64.0%，临床III期54.8%。281例接受EGFR检测（其中185例在手术期间），EGFR突变174例（exon 21 L858R 47.7%；exon 19 del 33.3%）。手术761例（R0切除96.2%；肺叶切除83.6%），其中手术+全身治疗74.0%，辅助治疗为主（79.6%）。未手术239例中，78.2%单纯全身治疗，21.8%放疗+全身治疗（cCRT 25.5%；sCRT 74.5%；免疫巩固26.9%）。手术+全身治疗600例中，仅新辅助9.7%、仅辅助79.7%、围手术期治疗10.6%，rwToT中位分别为2.1、8.5、10.1个月。
papers.authors_conclusion: This study provides a reference for real-world treatment patterns for stage IB-IIIC NSCLC during the early immunotherapy period of treatment landscape change in China.
papers.ai_note: 描述性研究无任何疗效或生存终点，rwToT仅为治疗时长，不能推断方案优劣；三组rwToT差异存在明显适应证混杂。EGFR检测仅281/1000例（28%），检测人群选择性偏倚，其突变率不可外推至全人群。样本量1000例但分层后各亚组（如围手术期治疗仅60例）较小，摘要未给CI/P值。信息不足：无分期别治疗模式明细、无随访结局。

pico.p: 2019年1月1日至2021年12月31日中国10家中心新诊断的IB-IIIC期NSCLC成人患者，n=1,000（手术761例，未手术239例）
pico.ic: 无干预与对照；按初始治疗方式分层描述治疗模式（手术±全身治疗、非手术全身治疗±放疗）

papers.reason: 为IB-IIIC期NSCLC围手术期与非手术治疗的实际落地模式提供中国基线数据，可作为新辅助/辅助免疫治疗真实世界采用率的对照参照；但不回答任何疗效或时机选择问题
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths in China. Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is the most common type of lung cancer. The treatment landscape for early and locally advanced NSCLC changed considerably between 2019 and 2021. However, there are currently limited data available to inform optimal timing, sequencing, and combinations of different treatment modalities for early-stage NSCLC in China. Therefore, we conducted a real-world study of patients with stage IB-IIIC NSCLC in China to characterize treatment patterns and identify practice gaps. METHODS: This retrospective, observational study was conducted at 10 sites across China in adults with newly diagnosed stage IB-IIIC NSCLC between January 01, 2019, and December 31, 2021 (identification period). The observation period was from treatment initiation to June 30, 2023. The primary outcomes included descriptions of treatment patterns by initial treatment modalities. RESULTS: Patients (n=1,000) were mostly male (69.6%) with a mean age of 60.4 years, current/former smokers (52.9%), had non-squamous cell carcinoma (64.0%), and clinical stage III disease (54.8%). Among the 281 patients who received epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) testing, including 185 during surgery, EGFR mutations were identified in 174 cases (exon 21 L858R 47.7%; exon 19 deletion 33.3%). Of the 761 patients who underwent surgery (R0 resection 96.2%; lobectomy 83.6%), most received surgery plus systemic therapy (74.0%), primarily adjuvant treatment (79.6%). The rate of non-surgical treatments increased with initial clinical stage. Of the 239 patients not undergoing surgery, 78.2% received systemic therapy alone and 21.8% radiotherapy plus systemic therapy [concurrent chemoradiotherapy (cCRT): 25.5%; sequential chemoradiotherapy (sCRT): 74.5%; immunotherapy consolidation: 26.9%]. Among the 600 patients who underwent surgery plus systemic therapy, 9.7% received neoadjuvant only, 79.7% adjuvant only, and 10.6% perioperative treatment, and the median real-world time on treatment (rwToT) was 2.1, 8.5, and 10.1 months, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides a reference for real-world treatment patterns for stage IB-IIIC NSCLC during the early immunotherapy period of treatment landscape change in China.

papers.title_en: An integrated baseline CT model for predicting growth heterogeneity in solid lung cancer with transcriptomic annotation.
papers.authors: Chen J, Qi L, Liu J, Li F, Cui S, Cheng S, Tan W, Wang J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Diagnostic Radiology, National Cancer Center/National Clinical Research Center for Cancer/Cancer Hospital,…
papers.results: 全部入组结节VDT为410.0 [IQR 206.0-828.0]天，随访间隔中位数173.0 (IQR 80.0-481.0)天；训练集409例（快199 vs 慢210）、测试集176例（快87 vs 慢89）、前瞻时间验证集42例（快21 vs 慢21）。Clinical-Intra-Peri模型训练集AUC 0.754、内部测试集AUC 0.770；Bootstrap内部验证乐观校正后AUC 0.750；前瞻时间验证队列AUC 0.825。转录组注释显示MYC targets V2与未折叠蛋白反应通路，leading-edge基因为H2AX和MCM4。
papers.authors_conclusion: The baseline Clinical-Intra-Peri CT model showed potential for predicting growth heterogeneity in solid lung cancer. Exploratory transcriptomic annotation suggested that model-defined risk was associated with growth-related transcriptional programs.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足之处：摘要未报告任何置信区间、P值、校准度、决策曲线或与单一临床模型的增量比较，无法判断影像组学特征相对临床特征的净增益；AUC仅0.75左右属中等判别力，但作者仅以'potential'表述。时间验证队列仅42例且快速/慢速恰为21:21完全均衡，样本极小、AUC 0.825高于内部验证，估计不稳。前瞻队列招募期为2026年1-6月，晚于回顾性队列截止时间，属设计安排但时间跨度仅6个月，VDT以首末两次体积测量计算而非连续随访，400天阈值的生物学与临床依据未说明。转录组仅54例肺腺癌、无对照组与统计检验，通路关联为探索性提示而非验证结论。

pico.p: 2011年3月至2025年12月回顾性收集的手术切除实性肺结节585例（训练409例、内部测试176例），2026年1月至6月前瞻入组42例作时间验证；转录组子集为质控合格的54例肺腺癌结节
pico.ic: 基线CT提取的临床形态+瘤内+瘤周影像组学特征构建的Clinical-Intra-Peri模型（另构建3个评分系统与7个模型）对照：以首末次体积倍增时间（VDT）>400天为快速生长、≤400天为慢速生长的二分类结局

papers.reason: 为实性肺结节随访间隔与手术时机决策提供基线CT预测工具的判别力基线数据（中等AUC），并为影像组学-转录组多组学关联研究的队列设计与样本量估算提供参照；其温和的判别效能亦提示纯影像组学预测生长速度的天花板。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Solid nodular lung cancer exhibits significant heterogeneity in growth behavior, and the speed of growth is significantly correlated with prognosis. This study aimed to develop and validate an integrated baseline model for predicting growth heterogeneity in solid lung cancer and to provide exploratory transcriptomic annotation. METHODS: This study included 585 retrospectively collected surgically resected solid lung cancer nodules from March 2011 to December 2025, randomly divided into training and internal test cohorts at a 7:3 ratio. Forty-two nodules prospectively enrolled from January 2026 to June 2026 were used for prospective time validation. Fast and slow growth were defined by first-to-last volume doubling time (VDT), with a threshold of 400 days. Clinical, computer tomography (CT) morphological, intratumoral and peritumoral radiomics features were extracted from baseline CT. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) logistic regression was used for feature selection, and three score systems and seven predictive models were constructed. Whole transcriptome sequencing was performed in a quality-controlled subset of 54 lung adenocarcinoma nodules. RESULTS: The VDT of all enrolled nodules was 410.0 [interquartile range (IQR), 206.0-828.0] days, with a median follow-up interval of 173.0 (IQR, 80.0-481.0) days. The training, testing, and prospective time validation cohorts consisted of 409 (rapid vs. slow: 199 vs. 210), 176 (rapid vs. slow: 87 vs. 89), and 42 nodules (rapid vs. slow: 21 vs. 21), respectively. The Clinical-Intra-Peri model achieved the highest area under the curve (AUC) in the training and internal test cohorts, with AUCs of 0.754 and 0.770, respectively. Bootstrap internal validation yielded an optimism-corrected AUC of 0.750. In the prospective temporal validation cohort, the AUC was 0.825. Transcriptomic annotation showed that MYC targets V2 and unfolded protein response pathways, with leading-edge genes H2AX and MCM4, suggesting potential links between model-derived risk and growth-related transcriptomic activity. CONCLUSIONS: The baseline Clinical-Intra-Peri CT model showed potential for predicting growth heterogeneity in solid lung cancer. Exploratory transcriptomic annotation suggested that model-defined risk was associated with growth-related transcriptional programs.

papers.title_en: Simplified synchronous division of pulmonary vessels and the horizontal fissure during thoracoscopic right upper lobectomy for lung cancer with incomplete fissure: a propensity score-matched study.
papers.authors: Xiao J, Wang Y, Liu B, Qiu M, Li X, Xie J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, First Affiliated Hospital of Fujian Medical University, National Regional Medical Center…
papers.results: 匹配后手术时间 60±5 比 74±18 min，均数差 -13 min，95%CI -19至-8，P<0.001（主要终点）；钉仓使用量 3.8±0.6 比 5.6±1.1，均数差 -1.8，95%CI -2.1至-1.5，P<0.001（主要终点）；总住院费用 32,487±850 比 36,145±945 CNY，均数差 -3,658 CNY，95%CI -4,022至-3,294，P<0.001（主要终点）；延长漏气 2例(4.0%) 比 6例(12.0%)，RR 0.33，95%CI 0.07-1.58，P=0.27（主要终点）；出血量、术后住院天数、淋巴结获取数组间相似；18个月随访两组均无术后出血、中转开胸、复发或死亡。
papers.authors_conclusion: In this matched retrospective cohort, SSDPVH was associated with shorter operations, fewer stapler reloads, and lower hospitalization cost during thoracoscopic right upper lobectomy for lung cancer with incomplete fissure. The study was not powered to determine differences in postoperative complications or long-term oncologic outcomes.
papers.ai_note: 四个主要终点（手术时间、钉仓数、漏气、费用）并列而摘要未报告多重比较校正；其中漏气这一安全性主要终点为阴性（P=0.27，CI跨1），结论仅强调显著的时间、耗材与费用终点，存在主要终点部分阴性下的选择性强调。回顾性单中心PSM设计，残余混杂无法排除；样本量按围术期效率指标估算，并发症与肿瘤学结局信息不足（18个月随访过短且无事件数），作者亦自述无把握度。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Incomplete horizontal fissure increases the technical difficulty of thoracoscopic right upper lobectomy and may increase parenchymal injury and stapler use. We evaluated a simplified synchronous disconnection of pulmonary vessels and the horizontal fissure (SSDPVH) for right upper lobe non-small cell lung cancer with incomplete fissure. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort included 140 consecutive patients who underwent thoracoscopic right upper lobectomy, including 60 treated with SSDPVH and 80 treated with conventional video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (cVATS). Patients with incomplete or absent horizontal fissure were identified on preoperative high-resolution computed tomography (CT), with final intraoperative confirmation of anatomical suitability. Propensity score matching generated 50 well-balanced pairs. The primary endpoints were operative time, stapler cartridge use, postoperative air leak, and hospitalization cost, reported in Chinese yuan (CNY). Secondary endpoints included blood loss, postoperative stay, nodal yield, perioperative complications, and 18-month follow-up. RESULTS: After matching, SSDPVH was associated with shorter operative time [60±5 vs. 74±18 min; mean difference -13 min, 95% confidence interval (CI): -19 to -8; P<0.001] and fewer stapler cartridges (3.8±0.6 vs. 5.6±1.1; mean difference -1.8, 95% CI: -2.1 to -1.5; P<0.001). Total hospitalization cost was lower in the SSDPVH group (32,487±850 vs. 36,145±945 CNY; mean difference -3,658 CNY, 95% CI: -4,022 to -3,294; P<0.001). Prolonged air leak occurred in 2 patients (4.0%) after SSDPVH and 6 patients (12.0%) after cVATS (risk ratio 0.33, 95% CI: 0.07-1.58; P=0.27). Blood loss, postoperative stay, and lymph node harvest were similar between groups. No postoperative bleeding, conversion to open thoracotomy, recurrence, or death was observed in either matched cohort during 18 months of follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: In this matched retrospective cohort, SSDPVH was associated with shorter operations, fewer stapler reloads, and lower hospitalization cost during thoracoscopic right upper lobectomy for lung cancer with incomplete fissure. The study was not powered to determine differences in postoperative complications or long-term oncologic outcomes.

papers.title_zh: McKeown食管切除术食管鳞癌患者淋巴结转移分布模式与总生存分析：单中心909例回顾性队列
papers.title_en: Lymph node metastasis patterns and survival in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma undergoing McKeown esophagectomy: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Liu H, Zhang W, Zhang A, Zhang L, Huang Z, Nie S, Wei X, Liu J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anesthesiology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University, Guangzhou, China.
papers.results: 878例可评估淋巴结状态者中326例淋巴结阳性（37.1%）；区域淋巴结受累随肿瘤部位不同而变化。895例有可靠生存数据，347例死亡，中位随访51个月。淋巴结状态分析纳入864例、60个月内320例死亡；淋巴结阳性与更差生存相关[未校正HR 3.054，95%CI 2.446-3.821]；记录肿瘤长度>3.79 cm同样与更差生存相关[未校正HR 2.693，95%CI 2.162-3.372]；两者P值均<0.001。探索性校正分析中，ABO与总生存的总体关联显著（P=0.01），与淋巴结阳性则不显著（P=0.21）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 淋巴结受累随肿瘤部位而变化。淋巴结阳性和较大的记录肿瘤长度在单变量分析中与更差生存相关。这些发现并不确立改变淋巴结清扫范围的获益。
papers.ai_note: 主要生存结论仅基于单变量Cox模型（HR均为unadjusted），未对分期、年龄、辅助治疗等混杂因素校正，淋巴结阳性与肿瘤长度的HR可能被高显著性放大；文中提及的'分层/校正'模型仅用于探索性ABO分析，而非主要暴露。不同分析采用各自排除标准（909/878/895/864例），样本量口径不一致，存在选择性偏倚可能。摘要未报告按肿瘤部位的淋巴结转移具体百分比数值，'随部位变化'缺乏可核查数字。ABO分析为探索性，其生存显著（P=0.01）而淋巴结阳性不显著（P=0.21）的结果与研究主题关联弱，存在选择性强调次要/探索性终点之嫌。信息不足：未见多因素生存模型、淋巴结清扫数目与生存的关系、以及各部位淋巴结转移率的具体数值。

pico.p: 909例接受McKeown食管切除术的食管鳞癌患者（可评估淋巴结状态者878例，可靠生存数据895例；男535例58.9%，记录年龄的904例平均64.2±7.2岁；上/中/下胸段食管肿瘤200/603/106例，pT3期407例）
pico.ic: 按肿瘤部位分层比较区域淋巴结转移分布；按淋巴结阳性/阴性及记录肿瘤长度（>3.79 cm）分组比较总生存；探索性比较ABO血型与淋巴结阳性及总生存的关联（对照为阴性组/其他血型）

papers.reason: 为McKeown入路下ESCC淋巴结转移的部位分布提供真实世界基线（37.1%阳性率），并为'是否需要按肿瘤部位调整淋巴结清扫范围'这一手术决策问题提供证据边界——作者明确结论是不确立改变清扫范围的获益，可作为胸外科评估清扫范围争议时的对照性阴性/中性参考
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The distribution of lymph node metastases in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) varies with tumor location. We examined nodal metastasis patterns and factors associated with overall survival in patients undergoing McKeown esophagectomy. METHODS: This single-center retrospective study analyzed hospital records of 909 patients with ESCC who underwent McKeown esophagectomy between December 2011 and July 2019, including total minimally invasive and hybrid procedures. Nodal involvement was summarized using node-based metastatic percentages and patient-level positivity among patients with evaluable regional records. Survival was analyzed using Kaplan-Meier methods and separate univariable Cox models for nodal status and recorded tumor length. Exploratory ABO analyses used Firth logistic regression for nodal positivity and a multivariable Cox model stratified by tumor location for overall survival. Analysis-specific exclusions were applied to missing or unresolved data. RESULTS: The cohort included 535 men (58.9%), and the mean age was 64.2±7.2 years among 904 patients with recorded age. Tumors were located in the upper, middle, and lower thoracic esophagus in 200, 603, and 106 patients, respectively; 407 patients had pT3 disease. Nodal positivity was identified in 326 of 878 patients with evaluable nodal status (37.1%). Regional nodal involvement varied by tumor location. Reliable survival data were available for 895 patients, with 347 deaths and a median follow-up of 51 months. The nodal-status analysis included 864 patients and 320 deaths within 60 months; nodal positivity was associated with poorer survival [unadjusted hazard ratio (HR), 3.054; 95% confidence interval (CI): 2.446-3.821]. Recorded tumor length >3.79 cm was also associated with poorer survival (unadjusted HR, 2.693; 95% CI: 2.162-3.372). Both P values were <0.001. In exploratory adjusted analyses, the overall ABO association was significant for survival (P=0.01), but not for nodal positivity (P=0.21). CONCLUSIONS: Nodal involvement varied by tumor location. Nodal positivity and greater recorded tumor length were associated with poorer survival in univariable analyses. These findings do not establish the benefit of changing the extent of lymphadenectomy.

papers.title_en: Bleomycin-Induced Pulmonary Toxicity: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Incidence and Risk Factors.
papers.authors: Tolstrup M, Lonkvist CK, Gehl J, Lauritsen J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Clinical Oncology and Palliative Care, Zealand University Hospital, Roskilde, Denmark; Department of Clini…
papers.results: 65项研究共7601例，BIP合并发生率18%（95% CI 15-21%），研究间异质性I²=87.3%；按诊断定义报道的发生率从影像学基础研究的42%到症状学复合定义研究的16%不等；诊断定义解释了研究间异质性的相当部分（R²=28%）；BIP报告发生率与年龄、性别、发表年份、博来霉素总累积剂量、粒细胞集落刺激因子使用、吸烟史及肺转移均未发现显著的研究水平关联。
papers.authors_conclusion: Reported BIP incidence varies widely, largely due to differences in diagnostic definitions. Standardized, clinically meaningful diagnostic criteria are needed to improve comparability between studies and support evidence-based clinical decision-making.
papers.ai_note: ①危险因素分析均为研究水平（ecological）Meta回归，存在生态学谬误，不能推断个体水平风险；'无显著关联'亦可能源于研究水平功效不足而非确证无效应。②检索截止时间写作'May 2026'，属未来日期，时间信息存疑。③PROSPERO注册号显示为占位符'CRDxxxxxxxxxx'，未报告真实注册号，可重复性与预注册真实性无法核验。④I²=87.3%异质性极高，合并发生率18%的外推性有限，且42%与16%的亚组值未给出各自的CI或P值。⑤主要目标之一的危险因素分析为阴性结果，摘要未将其与发生率主结果区分强调层级。

pico.p: 接受静脉博来霉素治疗、年龄≥15岁的患者；共纳入65项研究、7601例患者
pico.ic: 无干预对照（发生率Meta分析）；按诊断定义、患者特征与治疗相关因素进行预设亚组分析与Meta回归

papers.reason: 为博来霉素相关肺毒性（涉及生殖细胞瘤、霍奇金淋巴瘤及电化学化疗）的临床监测频率与医患风险沟通提供发生率基线，同时提示既往视为危险因素的累积剂量、吸烟史等缺乏研究水平证据，影响肺毒性筛查强度与随访策略的判断；亦为肺毒性研究的终点定义标准化提供方法学参照。
papers.abstract_en: UNLABELLED: Bleomycin remains an important component of curative regimens for malignancies such as germ cell tumors, Hodgkin lymphoma, and in the local treatment modality electrochemotherapy. A limiting toxicity is bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity (BIP), with considerable variance in reported incidence across studies. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the incidence of BIP after intravenous bleomycin treatment and investigate the influence of diagnostic definitions, patient characteristics, and treatment-related factors on reported incidence. METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted according to PRISMA 2020. MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane Library were searched through May 2026. Studies including patients aged ≥15 years treated with intravenous bleomycin were eligible. Risk of bias was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Checklist for Prevalence Studies. Random-effects meta-analysis and prespecified subgroup analyses were performed. RESULTS: A total of 65 studies comprising 7601 patients were included. The pooled incidence of BIP was 18% (95% CI 15-21%) with substantial between-study heterogeneity (I2 = 87.3%). Reported incidence varied by diagnostic definition, ranging from 42% in imaging-based studies to 16% in studies using symptom-based composite definitions. Diagnostic definition explained a substantial proportion of between-study heterogeneity (R2=28%). No significant study-level associations were found between reported BIP incidence and age, sex, year of publication, overall cumulative bleomycin dose, use of granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, smoking history, or lung metastases. CONCLUSIONS: Reported BIP incidence varies widely, largely due to differences in diagnostic definitions. Standardized, clinically meaningful diagnostic criteria are needed to improve comparability between studies and support evidence-based clinical decision-making. REGISTRATION: PROSPERO (CRDxxxxxxxxxx).

papers.title_zh: 胸膜间皮瘤铂类+培美曲塞再挑战的真实世界疗效：铂类空窗期≥6个月者生存更长，但回顾性比较存在选择偏倚
papers.title_en: Outcomes of Platinum plus /Pemetrexed Rechallenge in Pleural Mesothelioma: The Role of Platinum-Free Interval in a Multicenter Real-World Analysis.
papers.authors: Shah R, Reck M, Grohé C, Faehling M, Christoph DC, Saalfeld FC, Buchmeier EL, Kopp HG et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Oncology, Thoraxklinik, Heidelberg University Hospital and National Center for Tumor Diseases (NC…
papers.results: 375例（61%）接受二线治疗者 rw-mOS 11.6个月、rw-mPFS 4.7个月；PP再挑战组（n=78）中位OS 20.5个月、rw中位PFS 6.8个月、疾病控制率88%；按PFI分层再挑战组 rw-mOS 铂敏感21.4个月 vs 铂耐药11.9个月（p=0.007）；纳武利尤单抗+伊匹木单抗组（n=29）rw-mOS 22.8个月、rw-mPFS 8.0个月，治疗空窗期（TFI）铂敏感组中位OS 32个月 vs 铂耐药组18.1个月（p=0.03）；单药培美曲塞（n=32）rw-mOS 11.6个月，单药化疗 rw-mOS 8.0个月
papers.authors_conclusion: In conclusion, PP rechallenge has favorable outcomes and remains a viable alternative in patients with platinum sensitivity with PM, whereas nivolumab plus ipilimumab may be considered in both TFI categories, particularly in platinum-resistant disease, in which PP rechallenge offers limited benefit. A PFI or TFI-guided approach to second-line treatment selection is supported, although prospective validation is warranted.
papers.ai_note: 回顾性、非随机、未报告任何风险比/CI或多变量校正，组间生存差异无法排除适应证与选择偏倚：铂敏感者（PFI≥6个月）本身肿瘤生物学更好，再挑战组21.4 vs 11.9个月的差异可能主要由疾病敏感性而非再挑战疗效驱动；PP再挑战（n=78）与nivo+ipi（n=29）'comparable'的判断基于基线不可比的小样本非调整比较；未说明PFS/OS分析集、PD后交叉治疗及后续治疗对OS的影响；DCR 88%的影像评估标准未交代；rw-PFS评估一致性未知；PFI/TFI为事后两分类切点，未报告连续变量或最优切点验证。信息不足：各组基线特征、HR及置信区间均未在摘要中给出。

pico.p: 接受一线铂类+培美曲塞（PP）治疗的胸膜间皮瘤患者612例（2010–2023年，12个中心），其中375例（61%）接受二线治疗；PP再挑战78例，纳武利尤单抗+伊匹木单抗29例，单药培美曲塞32例
pico.ic: 二线方案比较：PP再挑战 vs 纳武利尤单抗+伊匹木单抗 vs 单药培美曲塞 vs 单药化疗；按铂类空窗期（PFI）两分类（≥6个月铂敏感、<6个月铂耐药）分层，非随机对照

papers.reason: 影响胸膜间皮瘤二线治疗中再挑战与免疫联合方案的选择，尤其是按铂类空窗期分层的决策；同时作为真实世界对照数据，为后续前瞻性验证研究的效应量估计与队列设计提供基线参考。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Real-world (rw) practice of rechallenge with platinum plus pemetrexed (PP) in pleural mesothelioma (PM) has been recommended in international guidelines, but the evidence is scarce and based on a few very small retrospective studies. METHODS: In total, 612 patients with PM treated with first-line PP between 2010 and 2023 across 12 centers were retrospectively identified. Outcomes and treatment patterns were analyzed across second-line regimens, with a particular focus on PP rechallenge. The platinum-free interval (PFI) was evaluated using a two-tier classification (platinum-sensitive ≥6 mo and platinum-resistant <6 mo) as a selection criterion. RESULTS: Among 375 patients (61%) receiving second-line therapy, the rw median overall survival (rw-mOS) and rw median progression-free survival (rw-mPFS) were 11.6 months and 4.7 months, respectively. Patients with PP rechallenge (n = 78) had a median OS of 20.5 months, a median rwPFS of 6.8 months, and a disease control rate of 88%. Patients with platinum sensitivity derived greater benefit from rechallenge, with rw-mOS differing across PFI categories (platinum-sensitive: 21.4 mo versus platinum-resistant: 11.9 mo; p = 0.007). Outcomes with nivolumab plus ipilimumab (n = 29) were comparable to those observed with PP rechallenge (rw-mOS = 22.8 mo, rw-mPFS = 8.0 mo), with treatment-free interval (TFI) associated with improved median OS in the platinum-sensitive group compared with the platinum-resistant group (32 mo versus 18.1 mo, p = 0.03). Single-agent pemetrexed (n = 32) and single-agent chemotherapy were associated with substantially shorter rw-mOS of 11.6 and 8.0 months, respectively. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, PP rechallenge has favorable outcomes and remains a viable alternative in patients with platinum sensitivity with PM, whereas nivolumab plus ipilimumab may be considered in both TFI categories, particularly in platinum-resistant disease, in which PP rechallenge offers limited benefit. A PFI or TFI-guided approach to second-line treatment selection is supported, although prospective validation is warranted.

papers.title_zh: VATS肺楔形切除术后未达早期拔管标准高危状态的六因素列线图预测模型开发与内部验证（单中心680例回顾性队列）
papers.title_en: Development and internal validation of a nomogram for predicting high-risk postoperative status after thoracoscopic pulmonary wedge resection: a single-center retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Zhang N, Lv Y, Chen T, Xu C, Li X, Jiang H, Ye B
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Shanghai Chest Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, Shanghai, Chi…
papers.results: 六个独立预测因素：年龄 OR=1.042，95%CI 1.019-1.066，P<0.001；FEV1% predicted降低 OR=0.907，95%CI 0.883-0.928，P<0.001；新辅助化疗 OR=2.794，95%CI 1.244-6.340，P=0.013；手术时长 OR=1.033，95%CI 1.018-1.049，P<0.001；切割缝合器钉仓使用数量 OR=1.173，95%CI 1.106-1.258，P=0.041；胸膜粘连程度 OR=3.649，95%CI 1.340-13.351，P=0.023。判别力：训练集AUC=0.865，验证集AUC=0.835；校准：bootstrap校准曲线、Hosmer-Lemeshow P=0.62；DCA示在10%-40%阈值概率范围内有临床净获益；训练集与验证集AUC差异无统计学意义（ΔAUC=0.030，P=0.433）
papers.authors_conclusion: A six-variable nomogram incorporating age, FEV1% predicted, neoadjuvant chemotherapy, operative duration, number of stapler cartridges used, and pleural adhesion degree was developed to predict failure to meet early chest tube removal criteria after VATS wedge resection. This tool may assist in individualized risk stratification to inform clinical decision-making regarding chest tube management.
papers.ai_note: 钉仓数量 OR=1.173 的95%CI（1.106-1.258）与所报 P=0.041 内部不匹配（该CI宽度通常对应远小于0.041的P值），数值存疑；胸膜粘连程度OR的CI极宽（1.340-13.351）提示该类别事件数少、估计不稳；摘要未报告高危结局总事件数、各变量EPV与样本量/事件数依据，也未给出训练集与验证集的具体例数；仅单中心内部验证，无外部验证，泛化能力未知；70/30随机划分而非全样本bootstrap会损失建模效率；复合终点含影像学气胸等主观判定成分，未报告各组成终点的贡献；DCA仅称'10%-40%阈值范围内有临床utility'，未给出具体净获益数值；'训练与验证AUC无差异（P=0.433）'更可能是检验效能不足，不能证明等效；数据时间窗2023-2025，随访期短。整体为开发性研究，证据级别不足以直接改变临床实践。

pico.p: 2023年1月至2025年12月单中心接受VATS肺楔形切除术的680例患者，随机分为训练集（70%）与内部验证集（30%）
pico.ic: 无干预对照；构建包含6个变量的列线图预测模型（单因素/多因素logistic回归筛选），训练集建模、内部验证集与bootstrap 500次重抽样验证，以AUC、校准曲线、DCA评估

papers.reason: 为VATS肺楔形切除术后早期拔管/胸管管理的风险分层提供候选工具，可作为快速康复胸管路径设计的参考基线；同时提示新辅助化疗、胸膜粘连等与术后恢复不良相关，供临床决策与后续外部验证研究对照。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Routine placement of a chest tube after thoracoscopic pulmonary wedge resection may cause postoperative pain and delay recovery, yet safe implementation requires accurate identification of patients at low risk for significant drainage, air leak, and pneumothorax. This study aimed to identify independent risk factors for failure to meet early chest tube removal criteria after video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) pulmonary wedge resection, and to establish a validated nomogram for individualized risk stratification to inform postoperative chest tube management decisions. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 680 patients who underwent VATS wedge resection between January 2023 and December 2025. Low-risk status was defined as chest tube drainage ≤200 mL within 24 hours, absence of air leak on coughing, and no significant pneumothorax on chest radiography. The cohort was randomly divided into a training set (70%) and an internal validation set (30%). Univariate and multivariate logistic regression were used to identify independent predictors of high-risk status. A nomogram was developed and internally validated using bootstrap resampling (500 replicates). Model performance was assessed by discrimination (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUC), calibration, and decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: Six independent predictors were identified: age [odds ratio (OR) =1.042, 95%  confidence interval (CI): 1.019-1.066, P<0.001], lower forced expiratory volume in 1 second percentage (FEV1%) predicted (OR =0.907, 95% CI: 0.883-0.928, P<0.001), neoadjuvant chemotherapy (OR =2.794, 95% CI: 1.244-6.340, P=0.013), operative duration (OR =1.033, 95% CI: 1.018-1.049, P<0.001), number of stapler cartridges used (OR =1.173, 95% CI: 1.106-1.258, P=0.041), and pleural adhesion degree (OR =3.649, 95% CI: 1.340-13.351, P=0.023). The nomogram showed good discrimination (training AUC =0.865; validation AUC =0.835) and excellent calibration (bootstrap-corrected calibration curve; Hosmer-Lemeshow P=0.62). DCA confirmed its clinical utility across threshold probabilities of 10-40%. No significant difference was observed between training and validation AUCs (ΔAUC =0.030, P=0.433). CONCLUSIONS: A six-variable nomogram incorporating age, FEV1% predicted, neoadjuvant chemotherapy, operative duration, number of stapler cartridges used, and pleural adhesion degree was developed to predict failure to meet early chest tube removal criteria after VATS wedge resection. This tool may assist in individualized risk stratification to inform clinical decision-making regarding chest tube management.

papers.title_zh: 贝伐珠单抗经治非鳞NSCLC中安罗替尼的疗效：多中心回顾性队列显示单药PFS不优于其他治疗，联合方案PSM后PFS略长
papers.title_en: Efficacy and safety of anlotinib in bevacizumab-pretreated patients with non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (AN-BELIEF study): a multicenter retrospective study.
papers.authors: Wang J, Zhi X, Chen J, Zhang B, Lan H, Jiao F, Liu Y, Wu F et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medical Oncology, Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, School of Medicine, Tongji University, Shanghai, China.
papers.results: 主要终点PFS：贝伐珠单抗初治安罗替尼单药 vs 贝伐珠单抗经治安罗替尼单药 8.23 vs 5.90个月，HR 1.41，P=0.003；PSM后 6.43 vs 7.60个月，HR 1.14，P=0.33（差异不再显著）。贝伐珠单抗经治患者三组治疗在匹配前PFS差异无统计学意义（P=0.42）；PSM后安罗替尼单药 vs 其他治疗 5.90 vs 5.23个月，HR 0.96，P=0.77；安罗替尼联合治疗 vs 其他治疗 6.50 vs 5.23个月，HR 0.82，P=0.048。次要终点ORR、DCR及不良事件在摘要中未给出具体数值。
papers.authors_conclusion: Anlotinib showed clinical activity in this selected retrospective cohort of bevacizumab-pretreated patients with non-squamous NSCLC. Anlotinib-based combination therapy was associated with longer PFS than other subsequent therapies after adjustment for baseline differences; however, these findings require confirmation in larger prospective studies.
papers.ai_note: 未匹配时贝伐珠单抗初治与经治单药PFS差异显著（P=0.003），PSM后转为阴性（P=0.33），提示原差异主要由基线混杂驱动，结论对匹配方法敏感。联合治疗组HR 0.82、P=0.048处于显著性边缘，且为多组间多重比较中的一项，摘要未说明多重性校正；联合治疗与"其他治疗"的选择存在明显指征混杂（confounding by indication），PSM仅平衡观测协变量。"其他治疗"为异质对照组，摘要未拆分其构成。摘要未报告OS、ORR、DCR与不良事件的具体数值，安全性结论无数据支撑，信息不足。

pico.p: 经筛查1,256例、纳入746例非鳞NSCLC患者：贝伐珠单抗初治接受安罗替尼单药174例；贝伐珠单抗经治572例，分为安罗替尼单药108例、安罗替尼为基础的联合治疗345例、其他治疗119例（2018年1月至2024年5月，六家医院）
pico.ic: 贝伐珠单抗经治者中：安罗替尼单药 vs 安罗替尼为基础的联合治疗 vs 其他后续治疗；贝伐珠单抗初治者安罗替尼单药 vs 贝伐珠单抗经治安罗替尼单药；主要以倾向性评分匹配（PSM）平衡协变量后比较

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Given the growing population of patients with disease progression following bevacizumab-based regimens, effective post-bevacizumab antiangiogenic options remain an unmet need. We aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of anlotinib in this specific population of non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). METHODS: This multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled patients from six hospitals between January 2018 and May 2024. Eligible patients had non-squamous NSCLC and received bevacizumab-containing treatment, or received anlotinib monotherapy without prior bevacizumab exposure. Key exclusions included anlotinib initiation before bevacizumab treatment, the use of other antiangiogenic tyrosine kinase inhibitors after bevacizumab, or insufficient radiologic evaluation. Patients were grouped by prior bevacizumab exposure and subsequent treatment. Tumor response was assessed by investigators according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1, with progression-free survival (PFS) as the primary endpoint; secondary endpoints included the objective response rate (ORR) and disease control rate (DCR), and adverse events (AEs), with AEs assessed according to Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) version 5.0. RESULTS: Of 1,256 screened patients, 746 were included in the original cohort: 174 bevacizumab-naïve (bevacizumab-naïve) patients who received anlotinib monotherapy, and 572 bevacizumab-pretreated patients who were further divided into anlotinib monotherapy (n=108), anlotinib-based combination therapy (n=345), or other therapies (n=119). In the cohort, bevacizumab-naïve patients attained significantly longer PFS than bevacizumab-pretreated patients receiving anlotinib monotherapy [8.23 vs. 5.90 months; hazard ratio (HR), 1.41; P=0.003]. However, after propensity score matching (PSM) to balance covariates, this difference was no longer significant (6.43 vs. 7.60 months; HR 1.14, P=0.33). Among bevacizumab-pretreated patients, PFS did not differ significantly among the three treatment groups before matching (P=0.42); after PSM, anlotinib monotherapy and other therapies showed similar PFS (5.90 vs. 5.23 months; HR 0.96, P=0.77), whereas anlotinib combination therapy group was associated with a significantly longer PFS compared with other therapies (6.50 vs. 5.23 months; HR 0.82, P=0.048). CONCLUSIONS: Anlotinib showed clinical activity in this selected retrospective cohort of bevacizumab-pretreated patients with non-squamous NSCLC. Anlotinib-based combination therapy was associated with longer PFS than other subsequent therapies after adjustment for baseline differences; however, these findings require confirmation in larger prospective studies.

papers.title_zh: 年龄是否改变放疗与广泛期小细胞肺癌总生存的关联：SEER与单中心化免队列的探索性二次分析（大队列未见年龄交互，33例机构队列见交互信号）
papers.title_en: Age and the association of radiotherapy with survival in extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer: an exploratory secondary analysis of two observational cohorts.
papers.authors: Zhang S, Liu Y, Zhou X, Tan K, Lin N, Lin X, Yang X, Liang X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Biotherapy, Cancer Center and State Key Laboratory of Biotherapy, West China Hospital, Sichuan University,…
papers.results: SEER多变量模型中记录的first-course放疗与更低全因死亡相关[HR 0.75, 95%CI 0.72-0.78, P<0.001]；匹配队列估计相似(HR 0.72, 95%CI 0.69-0.75, P<0.001)。年龄与放疗无交互（每增加10岁HR之比1.02, 95%CI 0.98-1.06, 似然比P=0.36）。机构队列时变Cox分析中cTRT与更低死亡相关(HR 0.40, 95%CI 0.17-0.98, P=0.04)，此处交互明显（每增加10岁比值0.27, 95%CI 0.11-0.64, Wald P=0.003, 似然比P=0.01）；65岁时模型推算的cTRT HR为0.35(95%CI 0.16-0.78, P=0.01)。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在SEER队列中记录的first-course放疗与总生存相关，与年龄的交互无统计学显著性。在四川队列中，时变模型给出cTRT总HR 0.40及显著的连续年龄×cTRT交互；但该模型仅依赖33个完整病例，且协变量经结局筛选选出，其中2个在治疗开始后才测量。这些发现既未确立经验证的年龄阈值，也未确立因果性的年龄特异性治疗效应。
papers.ai_note: 两队列交互结论相反（SEER大样本阴性 vs 机构33例阳性），而作者在结果叙述中突出机构队列的显著交互，属选择性强调的探索性信号。暴露定义跨队列不一致（SEER的first-course放疗并非巩固性胸部放疗cTRT），削弱可比性与临床可解释性。机构模型仅33例完整病例、协变量经结局筛选且含2个治疗后测量变量，存在过拟合与偏倚风险，作者已自认。摘要未提供年龄分层的生存率、绝对获益或可操作阈值；机构队列人群与治疗时代（化免背景）细节信息不足。

pico.p: SEER 2010-2015年远处转移ES-SCLC患者13,676例（PSM后4,116对）；四川多中心队列接受一线化免治疗的171例患者（时变模型完整病例33例、33例死亡）
pico.ic: 放疗暴露（SEER记录的first-course放疗 vs 非放疗；机构队列巩固性胸部放疗cTRT vs 未接受cTRT，时变处理），年龄为连续变量，检验治疗×年龄交互

papers.reason: 回答ES-SCLC巩固性胸部放疗是否需按年龄选择这一放疗科/肿瘤内科决策问题；大样本阴性交互提示不应按年龄否定放疗获益，同时其方法学缺陷为评估观察性放疗真实世界证据质量提供反面教材
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Thoracic radiotherapy is an option for some patients with extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC), but it is unclear how it should be used after first-line chemoimmunotherapy and whether its value differs with age. In two observational datasets that defined radiotherapy exposure differently, we asked whether age changed the association between radiotherapy and overall survival (OS). METHODS: We studied a historical Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) cohort diagnosed in 2010-2015 and re-analyzed a previously published multicenter cohort of 171 patients given first-line chemoimmunotherapy in Sichuan. In SEER the exposure was recorded first-course radiotherapy, which is not the same as consolidative thoracic radiotherapy (cTRT). The primary SEER cohort contained 13,676 patients with distant metastasis, and one global propensity-score match (PSM) produced 4,116 pairs. In the institutional cohort we fitted a time-varying Cox model for cTRT and OS; 33 patients with 33 deaths had complete data for the adjusted model. Age was treated as continuous, and we tested treatment-by-age interactions in both cohorts. RESULTS: In SEER, recorded first-course radiotherapy was associated with lower all-cause mortality in the multivariable model [hazard ratio (HR) 0.75, 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.72-0.78; P<0.001]; the matched cohort gave a similar estimate (HR 0.72, 95% CI: 0.69-0.75; P<0.001). Age did not interact with radiotherapy (ratio of HRs per 10-year increase 1.02, 95% CI: 0.98-1.06; likelihood-ratio P=0.36). In the institutional time-varying Cox analysis, cTRT was associated with lower mortality (HR 0.40, 95% CI: 0.17-0.98; P=0.04), and here the interaction was apparent (ratio 0.27 per 10-year increase, 95% CI: 0.11-0.64; Wald P=0.003; likelihood-ratio P=0.01). At age 65 years, the model-derived cTRT HR was 0.35 (95% CI: 0.16-0.78; P=0.01). CONCLUSIONS: In the SEER cohort, recorded first-course radiotherapy was associated with OS, and the interaction with age was not statistically significant. In the Sichuan cohort, the time-varying model gave an overall cTRT HR of 0.40 and a significant continuous age-by-cTRT interaction. That model, however, rested on 33 complete cases and on covariates chosen by outcome screening, two of which were measured after treatment began. These findings establish neither a validated age threshold nor a causal age-specific treatment effect.

papers.title_zh: KRAS突变晚期NSCLC脑转移发生率与生存预后因素的单中心回顾性分析
papers.title_en: Genomic characteristics, survival, and prognostic analysis of advanced non-small cell lung cancer with KRAS mutations and brain metastases.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Yu X, Bao M, Yu X, Li Y, Sun J, Zhou L, Tong Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Medical Oncology, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine (HIM), Chinese Academy…
papers.results: 全组KRAS突变中脑转移发生率30.2%（91/301），初诊即脑转移18.9%（57/301）；各亚型脑转移发生率G12C 36.1%（39/108）、G12D 26.3%（10/38）、G12V 32.4%（12/37）、G12A 38.1%（8/21），亚型间差异无统计学意义。截至2026年3月5日随访截止，全组KRAS突变患者中位OS 23.5个月（95%CI: 21.6–29.2个月）；脑转移患者中位OS 18.6个月（95%CI: 15.9–23.9个月）。G12C与其他亚型OS差异无统计学意义（22.4 vs 17.4个月，P=0.18）。脑转移后TKI治疗与G12C患者OS获益无关（22.4 vs 23.9个月，P=0.71）。TP53共突变者OS显著长于无共突变者（31.9 vs 16.3个月，P=0.03）；免疫治疗组OS显著更长（22.3 vs 10.9个月，P<0.001）；脑SRS与更长生存相关（23.9 vs 13.7个月，P=0.02）。多因素分析示年龄、免疫治疗、脑SRS、ECOG PS为OS独立预测因子（均P<0.05）；主要终点为OS。
papers.authors_conclusion: BM is associated with an unfavorable prognosis in patients with KRAS-mutant NSCLC. TP53 co-mutations and higher diagnosis-specific graded prognostic assessment (DS-GPA) scores were associated with improved OS. Immunotherapy and brain SRS were significantly associated with prolonged survival.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/疑点：结论称TP53共突变与DS-GPA评分改善OS，但结果段多因素分析列出的独立预测因子仅为年龄、免疫治疗、脑SRS、ECOG PS，TP53与DS-GPA是否经多因素校正未交代，存在结论超出所报多因素结果的矛盾；结论称脑转移预后不良，但摘要未给出脑转移 vs 非脑转移的直接OS比较数据；主要终点定义为自脑转移诊断起算的OS，却同时报告全组301例（含无脑转移者）的中位OS，起算时点口径不一致；免疫治疗与脑SRS的生存获益来自非随机暴露分组，未提及时期偏倚/永生时间偏倚处理，易高估疗效；TKI组仅19例、结论为阴性，但检验效能不足，不足以证伪TKI价值；随访截止日期2026年3月5日相对研究入组期偏晚，随访完整性信息不足。

pico.p: 2017年1月–2024年12月浙江肿瘤医院住院的晚期NSCLC患者4,021例，其中KRAS突变301例（脑转移91例，初诊脑转移57例）
pico.ic: 免疫治疗（70例）vs 未免疫治疗；TKI（19例）vs 未TKI；脑SRS vs 无SRS；TP53共突变 vs 无共突变（均为非随机暴露分组）

papers.reason: 影响KRAS突变晚期NSCLC脑转移患者是否联合免疫治疗及是否行脑SRS的临床决策，同时提示脑转移后TKI获益证据有限；其预后因素结论的多因素支撑不完整，可作为KRAS脑转移队列设计与分析方法的反面参照
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The brain is a common site of metastasis in lung cancer. However, data on the incidence of brain metastases (BM) and survival outcomes among patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring KRAS mutations, particularly those receiving tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs), remain limited. This single-center retrospective study aimed to characterize the incidence of BM in patients with KRAS-mutant NSCLC and identify prognostic factors associated with survival. METHODS: A total of 4,021 patients with advanced NSCLC hospitalized at Zhejiang Cancer Hospital between January 2017 and December 2024 were screened. The primary endpoint was overall survival (OS), defined as the interval from BM diagnosis to death or the last follow-up. Survival curves were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared using the log-rank test. Prognostic factors associated with OS were evaluated using univariable and multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression analyses. RESULTS: Among 301 patients with KRAS-mutant NSCLC, 57 (18.9%) had BM at initial diagnosis, and 91 (30.2%) developed BM overall. The incidence of BM according to KRAS subtypes was 36.1% (39/108) for G12C, 26.3% (10/38) for G12D, 32.4% (12/37) for G12V, and 38.1% (8/21) for G12A; no statistically significant difference was observed among these subtypes. At the follow-up cutoff date of March 5, 2026, the median OS of all patients with KRAS-mutant NSCLC was 23.5 months [95% confidence interval (CI): 21.6-29.2 months]. Among patients with BM, the median OS was 18.6 months (95% CI: 15.9-23.9 months). No significant difference in OS was observed between patients with KRAS G12C and those with other KRAS subtypes (22.4 vs. 17.4 months, P=0.18). After BM diagnosis, 70 patients received immunotherapy and 19 received TKIs. TKI therapy was not associated with an OS benefit among patients with KRAS G12C mutations (22.4 vs. 23.9 months, P=0.71). Patients with TP53 co-mutations had significantly longer OS than those without TP53 co-mutations (31.9 vs. 16.3 months, P=0.03). Patients receiving immunotherapy also had significantly longer OS (22.3 vs. 10.9 months, P<0.001). In addition, brain stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) was associated with improved survival (23.9 vs. 13.7 months, P=0.02). Multivariate analysis identified age, immunotherapy, brain SRS, and Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) as independent predictors of OS (all P<0.05). CONCLUSIONS: BM is associated with an unfavorable prognosis in patients with KRAS-mutant NSCLC. TP53 co-mutations and higher diagnosis-specific graded prognostic assessment (DS-GPA) scores were associated with improved OS. Immunotherapy and brain SRS were significantly associated with prolonged survival.

papers.title_zh: 基于围手术期常规变量构建肺癌术后肺炎机器学习预测模型：单中心200例队列内部验证显示最佳模型AUROC仅0.701
papers.title_en: From risk factors to individualized prediction: development and internal validation of a machine learning model for early identification of postoperative pneumonia after lung cancer surgery.
papers.authors: Petrovic S, Gabršček T, Beovic B, Tomič V, Bitenc M, Rozman A, Malovrh MM, Dimitric V et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Surgery, Surgery Bitenc, Ljubljana, Slovenia.
papers.results: 术后肺炎发生47/200例（23.5%），无肺炎相关死亡；AUROC：LR 0.701±0.070、NB 0.698±0.103、RF 0.656±0.217、XGB 0.589±0.179；决策阈值25%时正确识别47例肺炎中的25例（53.2%）；阈值升至32.5%时假阳性由42例降至24例，代价是再多漏诊4例肺炎
papers.authors_conclusion: 基于常规围手术期变量的机器学习模型能够对肺癌术后肺炎进行早期个体化预测；LR在预测性能、稳定性与可解释性之间取得最佳平衡，可构建可解释的列线图用于个体化风险估计；模型有潜力支持风险分层的术后监测与更高效的医疗资源配置，但临床应用前需要外部验证
papers.ai_note: 最佳模型AUROC仅0.701，复杂模型（RF、XGB）不优于甚至差于逻辑回归，'机器学习'增益有限；预测变量含术后第1天胸片异常，而POP定义本身即依据新发影像学异常，存在纳入偏倚（预测因子与诊断标准重叠），且术后第1天方预测当日已开始的并发症，属同期识别而非真正的术前/早期预警；阈值性能分析基于同一开发数据，未报告校准度、Brier评分或与已发表临床评分的比较；单中心200例（47事件）内部验证，无外部验证，摘要未给置信区间仅给±标准差；POP定义为影像+需抗生素治疗的临床感染，异质性可能较大

pico.p: 接受肺切除术的非小细胞肺癌或肺类癌患者，筛查258例，最终纳入200例
pico.ic: 四种机器学习模型（LR、NB、RF、XGB）基于人口学、临床、实验室、手术及术后第1天影像学变量预测术后肺炎；互为比较，无外部对照

papers.reason: 为肺癌术后肺炎这一常见并发症的围手术期风险管理提供风险分层工具的初步证据，影响术后监测强度与随访资源配置的判断，同时其仅0.70的AUROC和纳入偏倚为同类预测模型研究设计提供方法学警示
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Postoperative pneumonia (POP) remains one of the most common infectious complications following lung cancer surgery and is associated with substantial morbidity. Although several risk factors for POP have been identified, clinically applicable approaches for early individualized risk stratification remain limited. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models for early prediction of POP using routinely available perioperative variables. METHODS: In this prospective single-center cohort study, 258 consecutive patients undergoing pulmonary resection for non-small cell lung cancer or pulmonary carcinoid tumors were screened, of whom 200 were included in the final study cohort. POP was defined by newly developed postoperative radiographic abnormalities accompanied by clinical signs of infection requiring antibiotic therapy. Machine learning models, including logistic regression (LR), Naïve Bayes (NB), random forest (RF), and XGBoost (XGB), were developed to predict POP using demographic, clinical, laboratory, surgical, and postoperative day 1 radiographic variables. Model performance was assessed using nested leave-one-out cross-validation and quantified by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). A nomogram was constructed from the best-performing model to facilitate individualized risk estimation. Different decision thresholds were explored to evaluate clinically relevant trade-offs between sensitivity and specificity. RESULTS: POP occurred in 47 of 200 patients (23.5%), while no POP-related mortality was observed. LR demonstrated the best predictive performance (AUROC 0.701±0.070), followed by NB (0.698±0.103), RF (0.656±0.217), and XGB (0.589±0.179). The most influential predictors included advanced age, perioperative changes in C-reactive protein concentration (ΔCRP), elevated preoperative CRP levels, prolonged operative duration, and abnormal postoperative day 1 chest radiographic findings. At a decision threshold of 25%, the model correctly identified 25 of 47 POP cases (53.2%), whereas increasing the threshold to 32.5% reduced false-positive classifications from 42 to 24 at the expense of missing an additional four POP cases. CONCLUSIONS: Machine learning models based on routinely available perioperative variables enabled early individualized prediction of POP following lung cancer surgery. LR provided the best balance between predictive performance, stability, and interpretability, allowing the development of an interpretable nomogram for individualized risk estimation. The model may have potential to support risk-adapted postoperative surveillance and more efficient allocation of healthcare resources; however, external validation is required before clinical implementation.

papers.title_zh: 基于CT的多模态2.5D深度学习模型鉴别HIV/AIDS患者肺马尔尼菲蓝状菌病与肺结核：单中心回顾性诊断准确性研究（联合模型AUC 0.931，但相对单纯深度模型增益未达统计学显著）
papers.title_en: Differential diagnosis of pulmonary Talaromyces marneffei infection and pulmonary tuberculosis in HIV/AIDS patients using a CT-based multimodal 2.5D deep learning approach.
papers.authors: Song C, Zhao CY, Lin XS, Huang ZT, Huang XW, Song SL, Xie ZH, Zhu QD et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Tuberculosis, The Fourth People's Hospital of Nanning, Nanning, Guangxi, China.
papers.results: 临床特征模型中Random Forest最优，测试集AUC 0.856；影像组学模型中XGBoost最高，AUC 0.866；2.5D深度学习模型中ResNet18在切片层面AUC 0.865，基于MIL的患者层面SVM模型AUC 0.885；整合临床、影像组学与深度学习特征的多模态联合模型AUC最高达0.931，特异度0.981。联合模型显著优于临床模型（P = 0.020）和影像组学模型（P = 0.008），但相对DL25D的提升无统计学意义（ΔAUC = 0.046；P = 0.116）。联合模型特异度0.981应与其敏感度0.717及所选决策阈值一并解读。
papers.authors_conclusion: 基于CT的多模态2.5D深度学习模型有效整合临床指标、影像组学特征与深度学习表征，并显著改善了HIV/AIDS患者中TSM与PTB的鉴别。
papers.ai_note: 选择性强调：结论称“显著改善鉴别”，但相对纯深度学习模型（DL25D）的增量增益未达统计学显著（ΔAUC = 0.046；P = 0.116），主要获益仅体现在相对临床/影像组学模型；高特异度0.981被突出，而敏感度仅0.717，阈值选择可能偏向特异度，实际漏诊率较高。方法学局限：单中心回顾性、仅内部留出验证、无外部验证队列，7:3随机划分未见交叉验证或重复采样稳定性报告；样本为单一疾病谱（仅TSM与PTB两分类），对混合感染或非典型病例的泛化性信息不足。

pico.p: 380例HIV/AIDS肺部感染患者（肺结核203例、马尔尼菲蓝状菌病177例），2018年1月至2025年8月南宁市第四人民医院收治，按7:3随机分为训练集与测试集
pico.ic: 临床特征模型、影像组学模型、2.5D深度学习模型分别建模并相互比较，另设整合三者的多模态联合模型

papers.reason: 为HIV/AIDS患者肺部感染性病变的CT人工智能辅助鉴别诊断提供模型性能基线，其联合模型相对单一深度模型无显著增益的结果，可用于校准对多模态融合策略边际价值的预期。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: To investigate the diagnostic value of a computed tomography (CT)-based multimodal 2.5-dimensional (2.5D) deep learning model for differentiating Talaromyces marneffei (TSM) from pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) in patients with human immunodeficiency virus infection/acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (HIV/AIDS). METHODS: A total of 380 HIV/AIDS patients with pulmonary infections who were admitted to the Fourth People's Hospital of Nanning from January 2018 to August 2025 were retrospectively enrolled, including 203 patients with PTB, 177 with TSM. The cohort was randomly divided into a training set and a test set at a ratio of 7:3. A clinical model, a radiomics model, and a 2.5D deep learning model were constructed separately. RESULTS: In the clinical feature model, Random Forest achieved the optimal performance, with a test set AUC of 0.856. In the radiomics model, XGBoost attained the highest AUC of 0.866. In the 2.5D deep learning model, ResNet18 performed best at the slice level with an AUC of 0.865, and the patient-level support vector machine (SVM) model based on MIL achieved an AUC of 0.885. The multimodal combined model integrating clinical, radiomics, and deep learning features achieved the highest AUC of 0.931 and a specificity of 0.981. It significantly outperformed the clinical model (P = 0.020) and the radiomics model (P = 0.008), but the improvement over DL25D was not statistically significant (ΔAUC = 0.046; P = 0.116). The high specificity of the combined model should be interpreted alongside its sensitivity (0.717) and the selected decision threshold. CONCLUSION: The CT-based multimodal 2.5D deep learning model effectively integrates clinical indicators, radiomics features, and deep learning representations, and substantially improves the differentiation of TSM from PTB in HIV/AIDS patients.

papers.title_zh: PET/CT影像组学预测肺腺癌组织学分级与病理危险因素：单体系开发与内部验证，仅中等区分度且多项终点表现有限
papers.title_en: PET/CT radiomics for noninvasive histologic risk stratification in resected lung adenocarcinoma: a single-system development and internal validation study.
papers.authors: Minamoto FEN, Lauricella LL, Lima LGCA, Duarte PS, Fernandes PMP, Terra RM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Thoracic Surgery Division, Instituto do Cancer do Estado de Sao Paulo, Hospital das Clinicas HCFMUSP, Faculdade de Medic…
papers.results: 低分化肿瘤识别（grade 3 vs. grade 1-2）：ROC-AUC 0.767 [95%CI 0.624-0.897]，PR-AUC 0.854 (95%CI 0.723-0.952)，Brier Score 0.170，Brier Skill Score 0.23；脏层胸膜侵犯（VPI）：ROC-AUC 0.691 (95%CI 0.518-0.841)；非黏液型亚型分类：balanced accuracy 0.614；黏液型表型、STAS、血管侵犯模型区分度有限；小肿瘤亚组VPI因阳性事件不足受限。300个候选影像组学变量（147个PET来源、153个CT来源），75%/25%分层训练-测试划分
papers.authors_conclusion: PET/CT影像组学支持肺腺癌的术前概率性风险分层，尤其在识别低分化肿瘤方面；这些结果支持影像组学作为有待外部验证的补充性术前工具
papers.ai_note: 标题与摘要均称三所影像机构，但明确承认测试集为同队列内部验证而非外部验证，泛化能力未知；255个肿瘤对300个候选特征存在过拟合风险，虽有特征筛选与交叉验证；结论重点强调表现最好的grade终点，而STAS、血管侵犯、黏液型表型等多项终点区分度有限，属选择性强调；非黏液型balanced accuracy 0.614接近随机；VPI的95%CI下限0.518紧贴0.5，统计意义边缘；PR-AUC 0.854可能受类别不平衡影响；小肿瘤亚组VPI阳性事件不足，信息不足

pico.p: 254例接受根治意图手术的原发性肺腺癌患者，共255个肿瘤（排除新辅助治疗、非腺癌组织学及罕见腺癌亚型）
pico.ic: 术前18F-FDG PET/CT及薄层CT影像组学模型（GLMNET、随机森林、XGBoost，ComBat harmonisation与分层交叉验证）；对照为单一位胸部病理医师按2021 WHO/IASLC分类的中心复核组织病理结果

papers.reason: 影响可切除肺腺癌术前风险评估与手术/随访决策的探索性证据：明确显示当前PET/CT影像组学对病理分级有中等预测价值但对其余病理危险因素不足，为是否将影像组学纳入术前评估流程及后续外部验证研究设计提供内部验证基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Preoperative histologic characterisation of lung adenocarcinoma is typically available only after resection. We evaluated whether fluorine-18 fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (18F-FDG PET/CT) radiomics could predict histologic patterns and pathologic risk features using a hierarchical modelling strategy. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients from three imaging facilities within a single academic health system. Radiomic features were extracted from preoperative PET/CT and CT segmentations; preprocessing included feature filtering, standardisation, redundancy reduction, and ComBat harmonisation. Penalised generalised linear model (GLMNET), random forest, and XGBoost models were trained with stratified cross-validation and evaluated in independent test sets. Outcomes included mucinous phenotype, non-mucinous histologic subtype, histologic grade, spread through air spaces (STAS), vascular invasion, and visceral pleural invasion (VPI). Eligible patients had primary lung adenocarcinoma treated by curative-intent resection, with preoperative PET/CT or thin-section CT and histopathologic review available; patients receiving neoadjuvant therapy, non-adenocarcinoma histology, or rare adenocarcinoma variants were excluded. The histologic reference standard was central review by a single thoracic pathologist per the 2021 WHO/IASLC (World Health Organization/International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer) classification, blinded to imaging and radiomic results. From 300 candidate radiomic variables (147 PET-derived, 153 CT-derived), models were developed using a 75%/25% stratified train-test split within the same single-institution cohort; the test set therefore represents internal, not external, validation. RESULTS: Among 254 patients, 255 tumours were analysed. Binary identification of poorly differentiated tumours (grade 3 vs. grade 1-2) achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) 0.767 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.624-0.897], area under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC) 0.854 (95% CI: 0.723-0.952), and satisfactory calibration [Brier Score 0.170; Brier Skill Score (BSS) 0.23]. VPI yielded a moderate global signal (ROC-AUC 0.691, 95% CI: 0.518-0.841). Non-mucinous subtype classification showed preserved probabilistic ranking despite limited categorical accuracy (balanced accuracy 0.614). Models for mucinous phenotype, STAS, and vascular invasion showed limited discrimination; VPI in the small-tumour subgroup was constrained by insufficient positive events. CONCLUSIONS: PET/CT radiomics supported probabilistic preoperative risk stratification of lung adenocarcinoma, particularly for identifying poorly differentiated tumours. These results support radiomics as a complementary preoperative tool pending external validation.

papers.title_zh: 无管胸腔镜肺叶切除术（自主通气麻醉）与机械通气VATS短期结局的倾向性评分匹配对照研究
papers.title_en: Evaluation of short term outcomes of tubeless thoracoscopic lobectomy.
papers.authors: Xing T, Yang C, Zeng Y, Li F, Liang W, He J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Southern Medical University and The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University, Guangzhou, China.
papers.results: 匹配后SVA组BMI较低（22.50 vs. 22.06 kg/m2）且肌松剂使用量较少（24.83 vs. 3.75 mg；P=0.001）。SV-VATS组手术时间更短（168.62 vs. 152.26 min；P=0.009），胸管留置时间更短（4.08 vs. 3.01 days；P=0.001），术中出血更少（69.91 vs. 38.74 mL；P=0.002），均优于MV-VATS组。摘要未报告并发症率、死亡率、住院时间等其他结局及匹配后样本量。
papers.authors_conclusion: Tubeless thoracoscopic is safe and feasible for lobectomy in thoracic surgery, and can result in good short-term outcomes, reduce the use of muscle relaxants, and accelerate postoperative recovery. In addition, it can shorten the chest tube and operation time.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告匹配后实际纳入的配对样本量、随机化/匹配协变量清单、并发症（如漏气、心律失常、再插管）与死亡率，故'安全'结论缺乏安全性终点数据支撑。方法学疑点：①为回顾性非随机分组，选择偏倚与术者学习曲线/病例选择未控制（自主通气组可能选取更简单病例）；②'tubeless'定义（无管vs少管）在摘要中不一致，干预异质；③BMI与肌松剂使用在匹配后仍存在组间差异（P=0.001），提示匹配不充分，却未作为混杂处理；④只报告短期流程指标，无OS/肿瘤学结局；⑤主要终点未预先设定，多个指标同时报告P值无多重比较校正。手术时间、出血量的组间差异的临床意义（绝对差值约16 min、31 mL）相对有限。

pico.p: 2012年1月至2017年9月接受肺叶切除术的肺肿瘤患者共498例（机械通气MV-VATS组280例，自主通气SV-VATS组218例），行1:1倾向性评分匹配
pico.ic: 自主通气麻醉无气管插管、无或尽量少引流的'tubeless'胸腔镜肺叶切除（SV-VATS）对照 机械通气胸腔镜肺叶切除（MV-VATS）

papers.reason: 为胸外科微创术式选择（自主通气无管技术能否在肺叶切除中推广）提供初步短期结局证据，同时其回顾性设计与安全性数据缺失可作为方法学教学案例；缺乏并发症与长期结局使其不足以改变实践。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The concept of a 'tubeless' technique has gradually attracted the attention of surgeons. The 'tubeless' technique that uses spontaneous ventilation anesthesia (SVA) without tracheal intubation and no or as little as possible drainage, has seldom been attempted. The purpose of the present study was to determine the efficacy of the 'tubeless' technique on the early outcomes of lung lobectomy. METHODS: All patients who underwent lobectomy for lung tumors between January 2012 and September 2017 were divided into two groups: the mechanical ventilation video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (MV-VATS) group and the spontaneous ventilation video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (SV-VATS) group. RESULTS: A total of 498 patients were enrolled. Two hundred and eighty patients were included in the mechanical ventilation group and 218 patients were included in the spontaneous ventilation group. After 1:1 propensity score matching. The body mass index (BMI) and use of a muscle relaxant in the SVA group (22.50 vs. 22.06 kg/m2; 24.83 vs. 3.75 mg; P=0.001) were lower. Both operation time (168.62 vs. 152.26 min; P=0.009) and chest tube (4.08 vs. 3.01 days; P=0.001) were shorter in the SV-VATS group. Furthermore, intraoperative bleeding (69.91 vs. 38.74 mL; P=0.002) was decreased in the SV-VATS group, compared with MV-VATS. CONCLUSIONS: Tubeless thoracoscopic is safe and feasible for lobectomy in thoracic surgery, and can result in good short-term outcomes, reduce the use of muscle relaxants, and accelerate postoperative recovery. In addition, it can shorten the chest tube and operation time.

papers.authors: Wang H, Lan J, Chen Y, Xiao Z, Tang K, Chen S, Chen F, Xie J et al.

papers.reason: 影响IA期实性肺腺癌术前分级评估与术后随访强度决策，同时为影像组学联合SUVmax模型的构建与验证提供对照基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The novel International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer (IASLC) grading system provides important prognostic information for lung adenocarcinoma; however, preoperative noninvasive prediction of this grading remains challenging. This study aimed to evaluate the predictive value of a combined intratumoral and peritumoral radiomics model based on computed tomography (CT) and maximum standard uptake value (SUVmax) for preoperative prediction of the novel IASLC grading and prognosis in stage I pure-solid invasive lung adenocarcinoma (LADC). METHODS: Patients with stage I pure-solid LADC from The First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University were retrospectively included and randomly assigned to a training set (n=207) and a testing set (n=89) in a 7:3 ratio. There were 851 radiomics features extracted from the gross tumor volume (GTV) and the GTV incorporating peritumoral 3, 6, and 9 mm regions (GPTV3, GPTV6, GPTV9). A combined model based on an individual radiomics signature, SUVmax, and clinical independent predictors was constructed. Recurrence-free survival (RFS) was analyzed using Kaplan-Meier survival method, while independent prognostic factors were identified through Cox proportional hazards models. RESULTS: The GPTV3 model demonstrated a higher area under the curve (AUC) compared to other individual radiomics models, with AUCs of 0.804 and 0.715 in the training and testing sets. Tumor size was identified as an independent predictor of high-grade IASLC grading in the clinical model. The combined model showed AUCs of 0.837 and 0.767 for the training and testing sets, respectively, which were higher than those of the individual GPTV3 and SUVmax models. The high-risk group was associated with poorer RFS (P<0.05). Pathological and predictive IASLC grade, smoking history, and tumor size were independent prognostic factors. CONCLUSIONS: The interpretable machine learning model can predict the novel IASLC grading and prognosis in stage I pure-solid LADC.

papers.title_zh: CT体成分特征对食管切除术后延长住院的预测增量有限（AUC增益+0.0094，P=0.44）
papers.title_en: Explainable machine-learning prediction of prolonged postoperative hospitalization after esophagectomy using clinical and CT-derived body-composition features.
papers.authors: Moleka MM, Yang F, Lu Z, Jia S, Jiang W
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University, Wuhan, China.
papers.results: 299例中70例发生术后延长住院（LOS>15天）。Clinical + CT LASSO模型内部验证AUC 0.6288，accuracy 0.6121，sensitivity 0.5207，specificity 0.6408，Brier score 0.0.2422（原文0.2422）；Clinical-only LASSO模型AUC 0.6194；CT-only LASSO模型AUC 0.5439。加入CT特征后AUC增量+0.0094，95%CI -0.1393至0.1403，P=0.44。SHAP分析显示XGBoost Clinical+CT模型中平均腰肌脂肪、白细胞计数、年龄、白蛋白、平均胸肌为最具影响特征。
papers.authors_conclusion: 使用常规临床变量与CT体成分特征的机器学习模型对食管切除术后延长住院表现出中等预测能力；CT特征单独判别力有限，且在主要LASSO比较中仅提供有限增量价值；但基于树模型的SHAP分析提示部分CT特征可能有助于非线性的个体化风险估计；鉴于中等判别力与相对较高的阴性预测值，这些模型应作为支持性风险分层工具而非临床判断的替代，其潜在作用在于识别不太可能发生延长住院的患者并支持围手术期规划，临床实施前仍需外部验证与前瞻性评估。
papers.ai_note: 主要LASSO比较（CT增量阴性，P=0.44）之后，结论转向强调SHAP探索性分析与'较高阴性预测值'这一摘要中未给出具体数值的指标，属于次要/探索性结果替代主要终点的乐观表述；核心模型AUC仅0.6288、灵敏度0.5207接近随机，却表述为'modest ability'；AUC增量的95%CI极宽（-0.1393至0.1403），提示样本量（299例/70事件）与特征数不匹配、估计不稳定；摘要未报告任何校准（Hosmer-Lemeshow/校准曲线斜率）、决策曲线的具体数值，也未给出阳性预测值与阴性预测值；仅内部bootstrap验证、无外部验证；其他三种算法（Logistic、随机森林、XGBoost）的性能数值信息不足。

pico.p: 2020年12月至2025年6月接受食管切除术的299例患者，其中70例术后住院时间>15天
pico.ic: 三种预设特征集模型对比：仅临床变量 vs 仅CT体成分 vs 临床+CT；模型算法包括Logistic回归、LASSO、随机森林、XGBoost（无外部对照组）

papers.reason: 否定CT体成分作为食管切除术后延长住院独立增量预测因子的假设，为胸部外科围手术期预测模型的特征选择与样本量估算提供对照基线；同时提示在低事件数下SHAP等可解释性输出易被过度解读。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Prolonged postoperative hospitalization after esophagectomy reflects delayed recovery, postoperative morbidity, nutritional difficulty, discharge readiness, and healthcare resource utilization. Computed tomography (CT)-derived body-composition features may provide additional information about physiologic reserve, but their incremental value for predicting prolonged length of stay (LOS) after esophagectomy remains uncertain. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine-learning models for predicting prolonged postoperative hospitalization after esophagectomy using routine clinical variables and CT-derived body-composition features. METHODS: This retrospective prediction-model development and internal-validation study included 299 patients who underwent esophagectomy between December 2020 and June 2025. The primary outcome was prolonged postoperative LOS, defined as LOS >15 days. Three prespecified feature sets were evaluated: Clinical-only, CT-only, and Clinical + CT. CT-derived variables included average thoracic muscle, average thoracic fat, average lumbar muscle, and average lumbar fat. Logistic regression, least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) logistic regression, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) models were developed. Internal validation was performed using 1,000 bootstrap resampling iterations with out-of-bag evaluation. Model performance was assessed using discrimination, calibration, decision-curve analysis, and supplemental performance metrics. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was performed using the XGBoost Clinical + CT model to explain individual-level predictions. RESULTS: Among 299 patients, 70 patients experienced prolonged postoperative LOS. The Clinical + CT LASSO model achieved the highest internally validated discrimination among the LASSO models, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.6288, accuracy of 0.6121, sensitivity of 0.5207, specificity of 0.6408, and Brier score of 0.2422. The Clinical-only LASSO model showed similar performance, with an AUC of 0.6194, whereas the CT-only LASSO model showed limited discrimination, with an AUC of 0.5439. The incremental improvement in AUC after adding CT-derived features to clinical variables was small and statistically non-significant [AUC difference +0.0094; 95% confidence interval (CI): -0.1393 to 0.1403; P=0.44]. SHAP analysis identified average lumbar fat, white blood cell count, age, albumin, and average thoracic muscle as the most influential features in the XGBoost Clinical + CT model. CONCLUSIONS: Machine-learning models using routine clinical variables and CT-derived body-composition features demonstrated modest ability to predict prolonged postoperative hospitalization after esophagectomy. CT-derived features alone showed limited discrimination and provided only limited incremental value beyond clinical variables in the primary LASSO comparison. However, SHAP analysis of the tree-based model suggested that selected CT-derived features may contribute to nonlinear, individual-level risk estimation. Given the moderate discrimination and relatively high negative predictive value observed, these models should be considered supportive risk-stratification tools rather than replacements for clinical judgment. Their potential role may be in identifying patients less likely to experience prolonged hospitalization and supporting perioperative planning, although external validation and prospective evaluation are required before clinical implementation.

papers.title_zh: III期不可切除NSCLC度伐利尤单抗进展后体能与营养状态与进展后生存的关系：5中心回顾性队列
papers.title_en: Functional decline at progression after durvalumab in stage III non-small cell lung cancer: prognostic impact and treatment patterns in a multicenter retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Lisik-Habib M, Smółka K, Stando R, Chmielewski G, Bilski M, Galwas K, Tworek D, Puskulluoglu M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Proliferative Diseases, Copernicus Memorial Hospital in Lodz Comprehensive Cancer Center and Traumatology,…
papers.authors_conclusion: cCRT及度伐利尤单抗后首次进展时，体能状态受损与进展后生存差相关；探索性、队列衍生的3%体重下降阈值和早期进展也可识别高危患者，但需外部验证；进展时系统性功能和营养再评估可能有助于个体化治疗计划、多学科支持治疗和现实的预后讨论
papers.ai_note: 样本量小（n=60、34事件）、回顾性设计，3%体重下降阈值为队列内衍生，存在过拟合与选择偏倚风险（作者已自认需外部验证）；ECOG与体重指标缺测（59/60可评估ECOG）且采用完整病例分析无插补；摘要未报告进展后治疗与OS关联的具体数值，虽测得78.3%接受后续治疗但未给出疗效性结论，信息不足

pico.p: 组织学确诊、接受根治性同步放化疗后度伐利尤单抗巩固治疗并首次进展的不可切除III期NSCLC患者，n=60（n=59可评估ECOG）
pico.ic: 无干预；按进展时ECOG（≥2 vs 0-1）、体重下降（≥3% vs <3%）、进展时间（度伐利尤单抗起始6个月内 vs 之后）及进展后治疗分组比较

papers.reason: 为度伐利尤单抗巩固后进展患者的再治疗决策与姑息/支持治疗时机提供预后分层参考，同时提示进展时营养再评估这一被忽视的评估维度，可作为后续前瞻研究的基线参考
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Disease progression after durvalumab consolidation is frequent in unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but the prognostic relevance of functional and nutritional status at first progression is insufficiently characterized. We evaluated their associations with post-progression overall survival (OS) and receipt of subsequent systemic therapy. METHODS: This five-center retrospective cohort study included patients with histologically confirmed unresectable stage III NSCLC who received definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy (cCRT) followed by durvalumab and developed first documented disease progression. Clinical data were extracted using standardized case report forms. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status at progression, longitudinal body weight change from chemotherapy initiation to the last durvalumab administration, and post-progression treatment were evaluated. OS was calculated from first progression. The multivariable Cox model used complete cases; no imputation was performed. RESULTS: Sixty patients were included, and 34 deaths occurred. ECOG performance status at progression was available for 59 patients; ECOG ≥2 was observed in 26 (44.1%) and was associated with shorter median OS (8.3 vs. 21.2 months; P=0.01). In the complete-case multivariable model (n=59; 33 deaths), ECOG ≥2 [hazard ratio (HR) 2.34, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.12-4.89; P=0.02], body weight loss ≥3% (HR 2.37, 95% CI: 1.10-5.07; P=0.03), and progression within 6 months of durvalumab initiation (HR 2.16, 95% CI: 1.07-4.35; P=0.03) were associated with worse OS. Forty-seven patients (78.3%) received subsequent systemic therapy. CONCLUSIONS: At first progression after cCRT and durvalumab, impaired performance status was associated with poor post-progression survival. An exploratory, cohort-derived 3% weight-loss threshold and early progression also identified higher-risk patients but require external validation. Systematic functional and nutritional reassessment at progression may support individualized treatment planning, multidisciplinary supportive care, and realistic discussion of prognosis.

papers.title_zh: 选择性RET抑制剂诱导治疗后挽救性手术治疗晚期RET融合阳性NSCLC：17例单中心回顾性病例系列的可行性与病理缓解
papers.title_en: Salvage surgery for advanced non-small cell lung cancer after induction therapy with selective RET inhibitors: safety and feasibility.
papers.authors: Deng HY, Li JH, Chen XL, Li L, Tang XJ, Zhou Q
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.
papers.results: 17例均完成挽救性切除，术后恢复顺利，无重大并发症，无30天死亡；8例（47.1%）达病理完全缓解（pCR），13例（76.5%）达主要病理缓解（MPR，含pCR）；中位随访26个月，挽救性手术后3年PFS率75%、3年OS率100%
papers.authors_conclusion: 挽救性手术在这一高度选择的队列中是可行的，并伴有良好的病理缓解和短期结局；需要更长随访的比较性研究以确定其肿瘤学获益
papers.ai_note: 高度选择性单臂小样本（n=17），无对照组，无法区分手术贡献与RET抑制剂本身疗效；能进入手术者为治疗后疾病稳定/缓解的选择性人群，存在明显的选择偏倚；3年OS 100%与3年PFS 75%来自仅17例且中位随访26个月的数据，3年估计值随访时间不足；未报告具体P值或CI，生存率无区间估计；晚期占比88.2%但挽救性手术适应证（复发/残留、可切除标准）在摘要中未界定

pico.p: 晚期RET融合阳性NSCLC、接受选择性RET抑制剂诱导治疗后行挽救性切除的患者17例（四川大学华西医院，2022年1月–2025年6月），平均年龄42.3岁，15例（88.2%）为晚期
pico.ic: 干预：选择性RET抑制剂（一线或二线，平均12个月，范围3–34个月）诱导后挽救性手术；无对照组

papers.reason: 为RET融合阳性晚期NSCLC在靶向耐药前后能否采用手术提供初步可行性数据，影响多学科团队对罕见分子亚型挽救性手术决策的证据基线，同时作为无对照病例系列提示后续比较性研究设计的必要性
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring rearranged during transfection (RET) gene fusions represents a rare molecular subset associated with an unfavorable prognosis. The advent of selective RET inhibitors has substantially reshaped the therapeutic landscape for RET fusion-positive NSCLC; nevertheless, acquired resistance remains an unmet clinical challenge, underscoring the need for alternative or combinatorial strategies. Here, we evaluate a novel therapeutic approach integrating salvage surgery with induction therapy using selective RET inhibitors. METHODS: We retrospectively identified patients with advanced RET fusion-positive NSCLC who underwent salvage resection following induction therapy with selective RET inhibitors at West China Hospital, Sichuan University. Clinicopathological characteristics were systematically reviewed. Progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. RESULTS: Between January 2022 and June 2025, 17 patients who received induction therapy with selective RET inhibitors followed by salvage surgery were enrolled. The mean age was 42.3 years, and 15 patients (88.2%) presented with advanced-stage disease. Induction therapy consisted of first- or second-line selective RET inhibitor treatment for a mean duration of 12 months (range, 3-34 months). All patients underwent salvage resection, with uneventful postoperative recovery and no major complications. No 30-day mortality was observed. Eight patients (47.1%) achieved a pathological complete response (pCR), while 13 patients (76.5%) achieved a major pathological response (MPR) including pCR. At a median follow-up of 26 months, the 3-year PFS and OS rates after salvage surgery were 75% and 100%, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Salvage surgery following selective RET inhibitor therapy was feasible in this highly selected cohort and was associated with favorable pathological responses and short-term outcomes. Comparative studies with longer follow-up are required to determine its oncological benefit.
