papers.title_zh: 透视引导三管法治疗异物性食管穿孔合并纵隔脓肿的单中心回顾性队列：80.6%完全愈合但治疗负担重、无对照
papers.title_en: The three-tube method for esophageal perforation with mediastinal abscess caused by a foreign body: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Yang Z, Zhang J, Wang Y, Ma Y, Ma Y, Yin M, Li C, Wu G et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Interventional Radiology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, China.
papers.results: 72例均成功置入预定管路（技术成功率100%）；干预前65例（90.3%）ASA III–IV级，18例需机械通气；中位随访9个月，58例（80.6%）完全瘘愈合并恢复经口进食，平均愈合时间98.16±43.56天；5例死于严重感染，1例死于大出血，8例形成持续性瘘需长期管管理；41例发生脓肿引流管吸引失败需透视调整或更换；转诊时间对延迟愈合的bootstrap校正AUC 0.718（截断值>5.50天）、瘘口大小校正AUC 0.705（截断值>1.15 cm）
papers.authors_conclusion: 透视引导管治疗技术可行，本选择性队列中80.6%完全愈合，包括需机械通气的患者；但愈合时间长、导管功能障碍频繁、6例死亡及8例持续瘘显示治疗负担沉重。该方法可在多学科诊疗中用于 carefully selected patients，但需前瞻性比较研究以确立其相对于外科与内镜治疗的安全性和有效性。
papers.ai_note: 单臂无对照设计，80.6%愈合率无法排除自选择与自然病程影响，作者亦承认需与手术/内镜比较；技术成功100%可能受纳入与操作者经验选择偏倚影响；6例轻症改用两管方案构成亚组异质性；AUC为探索性分析（bootstrap校正但摘要未给CI/P），转诊时间与瘘口大小的截断值未经外部验证；数据跨度10年，围术期与支持治疗可能随年代变化，摘要未说明；摘要未报告无效率的分母拆解与并发症分级

pico.p: 异物性食管穿孔合并纵隔脓肿并接受透视引导管治疗的患者72例（2015年6月–2025年12月）；其中6例为瘘口小、脓腔<2cm、一般状况良好者接受改良两管方案
pico.ic: 干预：鼻空肠营养+胃肠减压±经鼻或经皮脓肿引流的管保守框架（三管法；6例为两管法）；对照：无（未设手术或内镜对照组）

papers.reason: 为高生理受损（90.3% ASA III–IV）异物性食管穿孔合并纵隔脓肿患者提供管保守路径的结局基线数据，影响MDT中手术/内镜与保守引流的方案权衡，同时提示该路径需长期管理与导管维护资源
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Foreign body-induced esophageal perforation can cause mediastinal abscess and life-threatening infection. Treatment is particularly challenging in patients with substantial physiological impairment who may poorly tolerate surgery or repeated endoscopic procedures. This study evaluated the clinical outcomes of fluoroscopy-guided tube-based management for this condition. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 72 patients with foreign body-induced esophageal perforation complicated by mediastinal abscess who underwent fluoroscopy-guided tube-based treatment between June 2015 and December 2025. The treatment framework combined nasojejunal feeding and gastrointestinal decompression with transnasal or percutaneous abscess drainage when indicated. Six patients with small fistulous openings, abscess cavities smaller than 2 cm, and favorable general conditions received a modified two-tube regimen without direct abscess drainage. Technical success, fistula healing, healing time, mortality, persistent fistula, and treatment-related complications were evaluated. Exploratory discrimination of clinical variables for delayed healing was assessed using receiver operating characteristic analysis with 1,000 bootstrap resamples. RESULTS: The planned tube configuration was successfully placed in all 72 patients. Before intervention, 65 patients (90.3%) had an American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status of III or IV, and 18 required mechanical ventilation. During a median follow-up of 9 months, 58 patients (80.6%) achieved complete fistula healing and resumed oral intake, with a mean healing time of 98.16±43.56 days. Five patients died of severe infection, one died of massive hemorrhage, and eight developed persistent fistulas requiring long-term tube management. Abscess-drainage tube suction failure occurred in 41 patients and required fluoroscopic adjustment or replacement. Referral time (bootstrap-corrected area under the curve, 0.718; cutoff >5.50 days) and fistula size (corrected area under the curve, 0.705; cutoff >1.15 cm) showed exploratory discriminatory ability for delayed healing. CONCLUSIONS: Fluoroscopy-guided tube-based management was technically feasible and resulted in complete healing in 80.6% of this selected cohort, including patients requiring mechanical ventilation. However, prolonged healing, frequent catheter dysfunction, six deaths, and eight persistent fistulas demonstrate a substantial treatment burden. This approach may be considered within multidisciplinary care for carefully selected patients, but prospective comparative studies are required to establish its safety and effectiveness relative to surgical and endoscopic treatments.

papers.title_zh: 双肺移植clamshell切口胸骨裂开的发生率、危险因素及其对术后肺功能的影响：129例回顾性队列
papers.title_en: Risk factors and clinical implications of sternal dehiscence following clamshell incision in bilateral lung transplantation.
papers.authors: Kim DH, Park S, Park J, Choi SM, Bae SY, Yun T, Park JH, Na B et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery, Seoul National University Hospital, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
papers.results: 胸骨裂开发生15例（11.6%），其中重大病例11例（8.5%）；多变量分析示男性为独立危险因素（OR 8.89, 95%CI 1.27–108.74, P=0.02），围术期气管切开与更低发生率相关（OR 0.12, 95%CI 0.02–0.53, P=0.004）；钢丝固定与胸骨旁固定等闭合技术与裂开无显著关联（P=0.73、P>0.99）；两组在术后1年及末次随访的肺功能均无显著差异（未报告具体数值）
papers.authors_conclusion: Male sex was independently associated with sternal dehiscence following BLT, whereas perioperative tracheostomy was associated with a lower incidence; these findings should be regarded as hypothesis-generating given the observational design. Pulmonary function during the follow-up period was not significantly associated with sternal dehiscence in this cohort. Surgeons may consider reinforced closure in male patients, while the protective role of tracheostomy warrants further study.
papers.ai_note: 事件数仅15例，男性OR的95%CI极宽（1.27–108.74），提示模型不稳定、估计精度差；气管切开的‘保护作用’可能为反向因果或幸存偏倚（病情更重者更早死亡/无法完成随访），作者亦承认需进一步研究；肺功能‘无显著差异’未给出任何具体数值、效应量或效能分析，信息不足以判断是否排除了临床重要差异；胸骨裂开定义混合了影像学不愈合与再次手术修正两类异质结局；回顾性单中心设计，信息不足于外推。

pico.p: 接受clamshell切口双肺移植（BLT）的成人患者129例；胸骨裂开15例（11.6%），其中重大裂开11例（8.5%）
pico.ic: 观察性研究，无干预对照；比较胸骨裂开组与非裂开组术后1年及末次随访肺功能；手术闭合技术（钢丝固定、胸骨旁固定）作为候选暴露因素评估

papers.reason: 影响双肺移植clamshell切口闭合策略决策（如男性患者是否加固缝合）及移植术后胸骨并发症的影像学随访安排；同时为肺移植围术期并发症队列研究提供发生率与危险因素对照基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Clamshell incisions provide excellent exposure for bilateral lung transplantation (BLT) but carry an inherent risk of sternal dehiscence. This study aimed to identify the risk factors for sternal dehiscence and evaluate its impact on pulmonary function. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 129 adult patients who underwent BLT via clamshell incision between 2007 and 2024. Sternal dehiscence was defined as radiographic nonunion of the sternum confirmed by chest computed tomography scan at least 3 months postoperatively, or any sternal dehiscence requiring surgical correction regardless of the time interval. Risk factors were identified using Firth's penalized likelihood logistic regression analysis. Pulmonary function tests were compared between patients with and without dehiscence at 1 year postoperatively and the last follow-up. RESULTS: Sternal dehiscence occurred in 15 patients (11.6%), of which 11 (8.5%) were classified as major cases. Multivariable analysis identified male sex as an independent risk factor associated with dehiscence [odds ratio (OR) 8.89, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.27-108.74, P=0.02], whereas perioperative tracheostomy was independently associated with a lower incidence (OR =0.12, 95% CI: 0.02-0.53, P=0.004). Surgical closure techniques, including wiring and parasternal fixation, were not significantly associated with dehiscence (P=0.73 and P>0.99, respectively). No significant differences in pulmonary function were observed between groups at 1 year postoperatively and last follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: Male sex was independently associated with sternal dehiscence following BLT, whereas perioperative tracheostomy was associated with a lower incidence; these findings should be regarded as hypothesis-generating given the observational design. Pulmonary function during the follow-up period was not significantly associated with sternal dehiscence in this cohort. Surgeons may consider reinforced closure in male patients, while the protective role of tracheostomy warrants further study.

papers.title_zh: 边缘可切除Ⅲ期NSCLC新辅助免疫与联合策略的安全性：叙事综述
papers.title_en: Safety profiles of current and emerging neoadjuvant immune-modulatory and combination strategies in borderline resectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer: a narrative review.
papers.authors: Berjaoui N, Siu YTR, Bille A, Patel AJ
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust, London, United Kingdom.
papers.results: 6项III期试验：病理完全缓解率17.2%-40.7%，无事件生存风险比0.40-0.68；≥3级治疗相关不良事件32.5%-73.0%；有汇总报告的试验中免疫相关不良事件25.3%-42.1%；报告该数据的每项试验中治疗相关手术取消率均低于2%；多数未接受手术的患者原因为毒性以外因素。TIGIT单抗在3项随机研究中失败；最领先的TIM-3项目基于企业报告数据终止。NKG2A、CD73、TROP2导向联合方案显示新辅助病理缓解信号且未损失手术可行性，但各仅基于单臂平台队列且患者数少于80例。某PD-1×VEGF双抗在晚期疾病有阳性同行评议III期数据，无新辅助数据。
papers.authors_conclusion: 边缘可切除疾病中的操作性问题不是缓解率是否提高，而是毒性、手术推迟和功能下降是否改变了本已处于可切除边缘患者的获益-风险平衡；回答该问题需要在治疗前即定义边缘可切除状态的前瞻性队列，MDT-BRIDGE和NEOINSPIRE是首个此类研究。
papers.ai_note: 人群限定松动：标题与立论聚焦'边缘可切除Ⅲ期'，但所引用的安全性与疗效数值（pCR、EFS HR、≥3级TRAE等）几乎全部来自可切除人群的6项III期试验，综述本身未报告任何边缘可切除人群的数据，属以可切除数据外推边缘可切除场景。以'非共识解剖亚组'作为工作定义缺乏操作化标准与验证。安全性数据为跨试验罗列而非合并分析，各试验纳入标准、免疫相关不良事件汇总口径不一（部分试验未报告irAE汇总），横向比较32.5%-73.0%的≥3级TRAE发生率易产生误导。叙述同时纳入疗效数值（pCR、EFS HR），与安全性主题混杂；对TIGIT阴性结果依赖'三项随机研究失败'的定性表述，未给出具体效应量与置信区间。信息不足：新兴靶点部分缺乏关键研究的效应量、随访时长与手术结局定义。

pico.p: 拟接受新辅助/围手术期治疗的可切除及所谓'边缘可切除'Ⅲ期NSCLC患者（源自6项III期试验及<80例单臂平台队列等，未给出统一总样本量）
pico.ic: 新辅助或围手术期PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂联合铂类双药化疗，以及TIGIT、TIM-3、NKG2A、CD73、TROP2、PD-1×VEGF双抗等新兴联合策略；对照为各原始试验的对照组，综述未做头对头比较

papers.reason: 为边缘可切除Ⅲ期NSCLC新辅助免疫治疗的多学科决策提供安全性与手术可行性证据概览，并指明MDT-BRIDGE、NEOINSPIRE两项前瞻性队列作为该人群证据缺口的填补方向；亦为围手术期免疫治疗安全性讨论提供跨试验数据基线
papers.abstract_en: Borderline resectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has no consensus definition. In an international multidisciplinary survey of stage III TNM subsets, no agreement on resectability was reached for 11 of 37 subsets, and the multisocietal consensus exercise conducted alongside it left the same anatomical configurations unresolved. This review adopts those non-consensus subsets as its working definition and asks how the safety profiles of current and emerging neoadjuvant immune-modulatory and combination strategies, spanning PD-1 and PD-L1 blockade, emerging checkpoint and immune-metabolic targets, antibody-drug conjugates and bispecific antibodies, bear on surgical decision-making within them. Six phase 3 trials now support neoadjuvant or perioperative PD-1 or PD-L1 blockade with platinum doublet chemotherapy in resectable disease, with pathological complete response rates of 17.2%-40.7% and event-free survival hazard ratios of 0.40-0.68. Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events ranged from 32.5% to 73.0%, immune-mediated adverse events from 25.3% to 42.1% where an aggregate was reported, and treatment-related cancellation of surgery remained below 2% in every trial reporting it. Most patients who never reached resection did so for reasons other than toxicity. Among emerging targets, monospecific TIGIT blockade has failed in three randomised settings and the most advanced TIM-3 programme was discontinued on company-reported evidence, which recontextualises the earlier phase 2 signals for both classes. NKG2A, CD73 and TROP2-directed combinations have produced neoadjuvant pathological response signals without loss of surgical feasibility, although each rests on a single-arm platform cohort of fewer than 80 patients. One PD-1 and VEGF bispecific antibody has positive peer-reviewed phase 3 data in advanced disease and no neoadjuvant data. The operative question in borderline resectable disease is not whether response rates rise but whether toxicity, surgical delay and functional decline shift the risk-benefit balance in patients already marginal for resection. Answering it requires prospective cohorts in which borderline status is defined before treatment, of which MDT-BRIDGE and NEOINSPIRE are the first.

papers.title_zh: 胸腔镜肺癌根治术后睡眠障碍相关因素的回顾性队列分析：术前PSQI、术中输液量与POD2咳嗽疼痛独立相关
papers.title_en: Factors associated with postoperative sleep disturbance in patients undergoing thoracoscopic radical resection for lung cancer: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Weng Y, Zhao Y, Wang B, Guo F, Gao C, Sun L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anesthesiology, Tangdu Hospital, Fourth Military Medical University, Xi'an, China.
papers.results: 62例中36例（58.1%）在POD2符合RCSQ定义的PSD（RCSQ<60）。多因素logistic回归：术前PSQI评分 OR=1.58（95%CI 1.19-2.10，P=0.001）；术中输液量 OR=1.004/mL（95%CI 1.001-1.007，P=0.02）；POD2咳嗽疼痛 OR=2.23/分（95%CI 1.36-3.66，P=0.001）。模型拟合优度良好（Hosmer-Lemeshow P=0.10；Nagelkerke R²=0.652）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 术前睡眠质量、术中输液量与POD2咳嗽疼痛与本队列PSD独立相关。这些探索性发现强调了对潜在高风险患者加强评估的重要性，但在转化为确切的预防策略前仍需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。
papers.ai_note: 单中心回顾性、样本量小（62例、36个事件）而纳入3个自变量，事件数/变量比偏低，过拟合风险未讨论；术中输液量OR=1.004/mL的临床意义需按每100 mL换算方能判断，摘要未提供；PSD仅以POD2单时点RCSQ<60定义，缺乏连续评估；未报告术前干预或疼痛管理等可操作变量的效应量；信息不足：无外部验证与缺失数据处理说明。

pico.p: 胸腔镜肺癌根治术后患者62例（2023年6月–2024年10月，唐都医院），平均年龄67.5岁，女性45.2%

papers.reason: 为胸腔镜肺癌围手术期睡眠管理提供候选高风险筛查变量（术前PSQI、术中输液量、术后咳嗽疼痛），可指导术后谵妄/睡眠障碍预防研究的变量选择与样本量估算；其小样本探索性设计也提示后续验证研究的必要性。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Postoperative sleep disturbance (PSD) is common in patients following surgery, resulting in severe cognitive and mood disturbances, and even increase mortality risk. This study aimed to identify factors associated with PSD in patients undergoing thoracoscopic radical resection for lung cancer. METHODS: We retrospectively identified sixty-two patients who underwent thoracoscopic radical resection of lung cancer at Tangdu Hospital, a tertiary teaching hospital in Xi'an, China, from June 2023 through October 2024. PSD was defined as a Richards-Campbell Sleep Questionnaire (RCSQ) score <60 on postoperative day 2 (POD2). Preoperative sleep quality was assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI). Pain was measured using the Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) at rest and during coughing on POD1 and POD2. intraoperative fluid volume, and POD2 cough-induced pain, selected a priori based on clinical relevance and prior evidence. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors independently associated with PSD. RESULTS: Of 62 patients (mean age 67.5 years; 45.2% female), 36 (58.1%) met the RCSQ-defined criteria for PSD on POD2. Three factors were independently associated with PSD: preoperative PSQI score [odds ratio (OR) =1.58, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.19-2.10, P=0.001], intraoperative fluid volume (OR =1.004 per mL, 95% CI: 1.001-1.007, P=0.02), and POD2 cough-induced pain (OR =2.23 per point, 95% CI: 1.36-3.66, P=0.001). The model demonstrated good calibration (Hosmer-Lemeshow P=0.10) and discrimination (Nagelkerke R2=0.652). CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative sleep quality, intraoperative fluid volume, and POD2 cough-induced pain were independently associated with PSD in this cohort. These exploratory findings highlight the importance of closer assessment of potentially high-risk patients, but require validation in larger prospective studies before being translated into definitive preventive strategies.

papers.title_zh: 支气管扩张症全身炎症特征与疾病严重度及重度急性加重风险相关的关联研究（EMBARC-BRIDGE）
papers.title_en: Systemic Inflammation in Bronchiectasis: Data from the EMBARC-BRIDGE Study.
papers.authors: Hughes C, Long MB, Stobo J, Johnson ED, Viligorska K, Lind H, McIntosh E, Petrou I et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Respiratory Medicine and Gastroenterology, University of Dundee, Ninewells Hospital and Medical School, Dund…
papers.authors_conclusion: Bronchiectasis is associated with a systemic neutrophil and endothelial inflammatory signature linked to disease severity and risk of severe exacerbations, alongside altered but functionally-responsive circulating neutrophils.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Neutrophilic inflammation in the airways is associated with exacerbation risk in patients with bronchiectasis. Systemic inflammation and neutrophil function are less characterised. The aim of this study was to investigate the relationship between systemic inflammation and neutrophil function with severity of disease and clinical outcomes. METHODS: Observational international multi-centre study of adults with bronchiectasis (EMBARC-BRIDGE). Serum inflammatory profiling was performed in 487 patients using Olink® proteomics, and associations with key clinical and patient reported outcomes, including severe exacerbations during follow-up, were analysed. In a sub-study, peripheral blood neutrophils from bronchiectasis patients and controls were analysed for surface activation and functional markers, and functional responses including degranulation and neutrophil extracellular trap formation. RESULTS: Systemic inflammatory profiling revealed a dominant neutrophil-endothelial signature. Several proteins including PR3, AZU1, MPO, the soluble IL-33 receptor ST2, and the cellular stress marker GDF-15 were associated with increased disease severity using the bronchiectasis severity index, lower lung function, increased symptoms and for many markers, higher rates of severe exacerbations during follow-up. Neutrophils from bronchiectasis patients exhibited reduced surface CD11b and increased CXCR2, with lower CD11b correlating with lower lung function. Basal degranulation was reduced in bronchiectasis, whereas responsiveness to LPS stimulation was preserved. CONCLUSION: Bronchiectasis is associated with a systemic neutrophil and endothelial inflammatory signature linked to disease severity and risk of severe exacerbations, alongside altered but functionally-responsive circulating neutrophils.

papers.abstract_en: Thoracic defects arise from a broad spectrum of causes, including tumours, congenital deformities, infections, and radiation-induced damage. Their surgical management is often challenging and typically requires close interdisciplinary cooperation, particularly between thoracic and plastic surgeons. This retrospective project included all patients who underwent thoracic wall resection and subsequent reconstruction at the University Hospital Basel between January 2013 and January 2025. During this 12-year period, 89 patients with chest, lung, pleura, and breast pathologies underwent thoracic reconstruction. The proportion of patients with an oncological diagnosis was 17% (n=15). Overall, there were 63 men (71%) and 26 women (29%). The mean age was 64±13 years. Pectoralis major flaps were used in 34 patients; latissimus dorsi (LD) flaps were used in 25 patients, with additional pectoralis major flaps in 2 patients and a combination of pectoralis flap reconstruction with a vertical rectus abdominis myocutaneous (VRAM) flap in 3 patients. Isolated VRAM reconstruction was performed in 4 patients, and in one patient, transverse rectus abdominis myocutaneous (TRAM) flap reconstruction was performed. In 2 patients, the serratus anterior muscle was used, and in one patient each, a vastus lateralis flap and an obliquus externus flap were applied for defect coverage. In 16 patients, the defect was covered plastically by local skin rotation. Chest wall reconstruction following extensive thoracic resection is safe and effective when guided by a structured, stepwise approach and close interdisciplinary collaboration.

papers.title_en: Lean dual-portal versus conventional multi-portal robotic-assisted thoracic surgery for anatomical lung resection: a retrospective comparative cohort study of a sustainable approach harmonizing clinical efficiency, environmental protection, and next-generation education.
papers.authors: Shoji T, Cho S, Sakaguchi T, Hanawa K, Takahashi M, Katakura H
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Otsu Red Cross Hospital, Otsu, Japan.
papers.authors_conclusion: This small, single-center study suggests that the 'lean' DRATS approach is feasible for anatomical lung resection in a selected group of patients. While the strategy significantly reduced procedural costs and shortened hospital stay without compromising immediate safety, its equivalence to conventional robotic surgery requires further validation through larger prospective trials.
papers.ai_note: 方法学局限较多：回顾性非随机分组，分组由固定手术团队当日可用性决定（虽称可减少选择偏倚，但仍非随机，且提示学习曲线/团队效应混杂）；样本量小（26 vs 43），主要终点为手术效率与安全性，但手术时间、控制台时间、失血、并发症均无统计学差异，仅住院日达显著——摘要未说明住院日是否为预设主要终点，存在以次要/非预设终点突出阳性结果的可能；住院日对照组极值达66天提示离散度大，中位数差1天的临床意义未讨论；无长期肿瘤学随访；成本数据为单中心日元计价，外推性有限；'等效性'未通过非劣效设计检验，阴性差异不能解读为等效。信息不足：住院日差异的调整分析、学习曲线、并发症定义细节均未报告。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Conventional robotic-assisted thoracic surgery (RATS) is increasingly scrutinized for its high procedural costs, excessive medical plastic waste, and the passive role it often assigns to surgical trainees. To address these systemic inefficiencies, we introduced the 'lean' dual-portal RATS (DRATS) strategy. This study evaluates the clinical feasibility and multi-dimensional benefits of this approach, which prioritizes resource stewardship and educational autonomy. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective comparative cohort study (June 2024-April 2026) of 26 consecutive patients undergoing lean DRATS and 43 patients undergoing conventional 4-5 port RATS for anatomical lung resection. The lean strategy was characterized by a minimalist 2-port setup, the elimination of CO2 insufflation and specialized cannula seals, and the proactive 'Bedside Surgeon' model. Allocation to the DRATS group was determined by the daily availability of a designated fixed surgical team, minimizing selection bias. Primary outcomes included operative efficiency and safety, with complications recorded via the Clavien-Dindo classification. Patients were followed through outpatient clinic visits to monitor for late complications and confirm the absence of readmissions. RESULTS: Baseline characteristics, including the lobectomy/segmentectomy ratio (7/19 in DRATS vs. 18/25 in conventional, P=0.30), were comparable. For lean DRATS vs. conventional RATS: median operative time was 246 (range, 171-389) vs. 256 (151-436) minutes (P=0.56); median console time was 169 (114-259) vs. 180 (64-345) minutes (P=0.95); and median blood loss was 27 (2-434) vs. 25 (2-725) g (P=0.61). No conversions to thoracotomy occurred in either group. The major complication rate (grade ≥3) was 3.8% (1/26) vs. 2.3% (1/43) (P>0.99). Notably, the median hospital stay was significantly shorter in the lean DRATS group [5 (3-17) vs. 6 (4-66) days, P<0.001]. No patients in either group required readmission after discharge. The "lean" strategy achieved a cost reduction of approximately 118,000 JPY ($762 USD) per case by eliminating specialized seals and utilizing resident-operated manual endoscopic stapling executed synchronously during active console time. CONCLUSIONS: This small, single-center study suggests that the 'lean' DRATS approach is feasible for anatomical lung resection in a selected group of patients. While the strategy significantly reduced procedural costs and shortened hospital stay without compromising immediate safety, its equivalence to conventional robotic surgery requires further validation through larger prospective trials.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Even after perioperative chemotherapy combined with immunotherapy, pathological complete response (pCR) rates remain below 30%, and further improvement in long-term outcomes has stalled. Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), leveraging targeted cytotoxicity and the bystander effect, can achieve tumor downstaging, micrometastasis clearance, and organ preservation in the perioperative setting, offering a new option beyond conventional chemoimmunotherapy. In this review, we aimed to summarize contemporary clinical evidence for perioperative ADCs in resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and to provide practical guidance on patient selection, toxicity management, and future research. METHODS: We searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov, together with the abstract books of major oncology congresses [American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO), World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC), European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO)], from January 1, 2018 to September 14, 2026 for English-language publications on ADCs in the perioperative treatment of resectable NSCLC. We included clinical trials, case reports, conference abstracts, guidelines, and authoritative reviews. Two authors independently screened and selected the literature; disagreements were resolved by consensus. Landmark studies published before 2018 were captured by reference-list screening. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: We cover TROP2-targeted agents (datopotamab deruxtecan, sacituzumab govitecan), HER2-directed trastuzumab deruxtecan, and bispecific EGFR-HER3 ADCs across neoadjuvant, adjuvant, and perioperative strategies, with attention to practice-changing platform trials such as NeoCOAST-2. Studies are grouped by therapeutic partner, namely ADCs combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors, ADCs combined with targeted agents, and ADCs administered as single agents in molecularly selected populations. We further examine how ADCs may substitute for, or complement, platinum-based chemotherapy, and how they interface with immune checkpoint inhibitors across the perioperative continuum. We discuss biomarker-guided patient selection, including TROP2 and HER2 expression and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)-based minimal residual disease (MRD); practical perioperative toxicity management (interstitial lung disease, oral mucositis, ocular and hematologic toxicity); and emerging mechanisms of ADC resistance. We also highlight future priorities, including MRD-directed, individualized adjuvant therapy and strategies to overcome resistance, to optimize ADC-based regimens for patients with suboptimal responses to standard treatment. CONCLUSIONS: ADCs should be positioned as a complement rather than a replacement for perioperative chemoimmunotherapy.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Primary epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) T790M-mutant lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is rare, and the clinicopathological characteristics and tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) of different compound-mutant subtypes remain poorly characterized. This study aimed to characterize the clinicopathological and TIME features of primary EGFR T790M compound-mutant LUAD and explore subtype-specific associations with disease-free survival. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 255 patients with surgically resected primary EGFR T790M compound-mutant LUAD. Tissue microarrays from 158 patients were evaluated using immunohistochemistry (IHC) and multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Disease-free survival (DFS) was analyzed using the Kaplan-Meier method, while prognostic factors were evaluated using Cox proportional hazards regression for clinicopathological variables and Firth's penalized Cox regression for immune markers. RESULTS: Primary EGFR T790M mutation predominantly occurred in compound-mutant form, with T790M+L858R being the most common subtype. Compared with T790M+L858R, T790M+19del had a larger maximum tumor diameter and higher frequencies of lymphovascular invasion, pleural invasion, and lymph node metastasis (all P<0.05). IHC and mIF analyses demonstrated subtype-associated TIME differences. The T790M+19del subtype showed an increased proportion of CD68+CD163+ macrophages and higher expression of immune-regulatory markers, whereas the T790M+L858R subtype showed relative enrichment of CD3+CD8+ T cells. In exploratory survival analyses, subtype-specific associations between TIME-related markers and DFS were observed: concurrent high expression of CD66b and CTLA4 was associated with shorter DFS in the T790M+19del subtype, whereas high TIGIT expression was associated with shorter DFS in the T790M+L858R subtype. CONCLUSIONS: Primary EGFR T790M compound-mutant LUAD exhibits subtype-associated clinicopathological and TIME heterogeneity. These findings highlight the importance of considering accompanying EGFR activating mutation subtypes when evaluating this rare molecular subgroup.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Subxiphoid uniportal video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (SU-VATS) has attracted increasing attention as a minimally invasive strategy that avoids intercostal nerve damage, a frequent drawback of conventional intercostal VATS. This scoping review maps the existing literature to answer three questions: how the technique has evolved, for which thoracic procedures it has been applied and with what outcomes, and what innovations and evidence gaps will shape its future. METHODS: PubMed was searched from January 2010 through 6 June 2026 (primary search) and the search strategy was refined and re-executed on 6 September 2026 to verify the selection process, using combinations of "subxiphoid", "infrasternal", "uniport*", "single-port", "single-incision", "VATS", and "thoracoscopic" terms, supplemented by backward citation searching. Two authors independently screened records and charted the data; 71 studies were included. RESULTS: SU-VATS has been employed across a broad spectrum of thoracic operations: lobectomy, segmentectomy, thymectomy for anterior mediastinal pathology, bilateral pulmonary resection, and thoracic sympathectomy. In most comparisons-almost all observational and unblinded-SU-VATS was associated with lower postoperative pain ratings [visual analogue scale (VAS)/numeric rating scale (NRS)] than intercostal uniportal VATS (IU-VATS), although one study reported greater incisional discomfort after bilateral procedures. A distinctive benefit is management of bilateral disease through one incision without repositioning. Nonetheless, SU-VATS entails a longer learning curve, extended operative times during early adoption, and greater difficulty accessing upper lobe or posterior mediastinal targets. Recent innovations-including sternal elevation devices, articulating instruments, three-dimensional (3D) thoracoscopy, indocyanine green (ICG) fluorescence, and robotic platforms-have been introduced to address these spatial constraints. CONCLUSIONS: SU-VATS constitutes a meaningful addition to the minimally invasive thoracic surgeon's toolkit, with observational comparisons suggesting advantages in analgesia and bilateral operability. Current data support its safety and feasibility for appropriately selected cases, but oncologic equivalence has not been established, and multicenter randomized trials with standardized endpoints are required to define its optimal position. Evidence strength differs by procedure-most substantial for thymectomy and least mature for sympathectomy. Robotic systems and image-based navigation are expected to broaden its indications further.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer death in the United States, with rural Appalachian communities experiencing disproportionately high incidence and mortality rates. Limited access to low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) screening, socioeconomic barriers, and cultural factors contribute to delayed diagnoses and poor survival outcomes. The Association of Cancer Care Centers (ACCC)'s Rural Appalachian Lung Cancer Screening Initiative (RALCSI) aimed to reduce these disparities by strengthening the implementation of guideline-concordant lung cancer screening programs through workflow redesign, provider and patient education, and community engagement. The aim of this study was to describe the development and early impact of the RALCSI quality improvement intervention on lung cancer screening in rural Appalachia. METHODS: From October 2023 through June 2025, a 10-county focus area in rural Appalachia was selected using epidemiologic data and Rural-Urban Commuting Area (RUCA) classification. A multiple-methods quality improvement (QI) approach was used. Baseline data were collected on site characteristics, screening volumes, and diagnostic yield. Interventions included provider training guided by task force members' expertise and ACCC's Lung Cancer Screening Implementation Change Package, targeted patient outreach adapted for the rural Appalachian context, and process improvements such as electronic health record (EHR) prompts and centralized scheduling. Quantitative metrics (first-time scans, repeat scans, interval scans, and lung cancer diagnoses) were tracked, while qualitative data from provider and patient feedback were analyzed to identify barriers and facilitators. RESULTS: Two participating sites, Pikeville Medical Center (PMC) and Buchanan General Hospital in partnership with the University of Virginia (BGH/UVA), implemented new workflows and education programs to strengthen lung cancer screening. Screening volumes increased over the intervention period, with PMC performing 458 first-time scans and 543 repeat scans-an increase of 83% and 72%, respectively, compared to the 2023 baseline of 250 first-time and 315 repeat scans. PMC diagnosed 10 lung cancers through screening during this period. BGH/UVA conducted 75 first-time scans and 57 repeat scans, representing increases of 108% and 104% compared to the 2023 baseline of 36 first-time and 28 repeat scans, although no lung cancers were diagnosed during the study period. Providers demonstrated increased confidence in applying screening guidelines and engaging patients in shared decision-making, while patient outreach through trusted community channels improved participation. Persistent barriers included transportation challenges, follow-up adherence, accurate identification of eligible individuals for screening, and appropriate coding and billing of lung cancer screening services. CONCLUSIONS: Community-informed, systems-based interventions can significantly improve lung cancer screening in rural regions. The ACCC RALCSI model demonstrates the value of combining provider education, culturally sensitive outreach, and workflow redesign to increase early detection and reduce disparities. Future efforts should focus on sustainability, policy-level interventions, and evaluation of long-term outcomes to support equitable access to screening nationwide.

papers.title_en: Correlation between chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and comorbidities-a systematic analysis integrating global burden of disease and mendelian randomization study.
papers.authors: Feng H, Jiao C, Lv W, Zheng R
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Shengjing Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China.
papers.results: COPD合并症的绝对负担持续上升，主要驱动为人口老龄化与增长（如缺血性心脏病、肌骨疾病）；高SDI地区肌骨与精神疾病负担更重，中低SDI地区缺血性心脏病所致死亡与DALY更显著；经Benjamini-Hochberg校正后，COPD患病率与全部8种合并症的生态学关联均存在显著年龄异质性（all q ≤0.028）；MR分析显示遗传预测的COPD与哮喘和抑郁风险升高显著相关（FDR <0.05），且遗传易感性哮喘和抑郁与COPD发病风险升高相关（FDR <0.05）
papers.authors_conclusion: The comorbidity patterns between COPD and its key concomitant conditions are influenced by multiple factors, including demographic structure, regional development levels, and shared biological mechanisms. Our findings underscore the necessity of shifting from a single-disease management model towards integrated care strategies that emphasize comorbidity screening and holistic patient management.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：MR结果仅报告方向与FDR阈值（FDR<0.05），摘要未给出OR值、95%CI、F统计量、工具变量数目与样本量，效应量无法评估；关联为生态学层面（国家/地区聚合数据），存在生态学谬误风险，不能等同个体层面因果；'双向遗传关联'表述依赖单方法（IVW）为主的敏感性分析未在摘要体现；呼吸道肿瘤列为关注合并症但结果未见相应MR报告，疑为选择性报告

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) frequently coexists with multiple comorbidities. However, the long-term trends, regional disparities, and potential causal relationships in the global burden of these comorbidities remain to be systematically elucidated. This study aimed to characterize the disease burden of common comorbidities in patients with COPD and to assess the potential causal relationships between these comorbidities and COPD. METHODS: This study integrated data from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (GBD 2023) and conducted two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses. Based on GBD data from 1990 to 2023, we performed descriptive burden assessment, Das Gupta decomposition, Bayesian age-period-cohort modelling, exploratory correlation analysis, and formal age-interaction regression. Using summary statistics from the FinnGen consortium, we evaluated bidirectional genetic associations between COPD and various comorbidities primarily via the inverse variance weighted (IVW) method with false discovery rate (FDR) correction for multiple comparisons. The comorbidities of focus included asthma, anxiety disorders, major depressive disorder, pulmonary hypertension, hypertensive heart disease, ischemic heart disease, musculoskeletal disorders, osteoporosis, and respiratory tract cancers. RESULTS: The absolute burden of comorbidities in COPD continued to increase, albeit driven by distinct factors. Population aging and growth were identified as the primary drivers for the rising burden of several COPD comorbidities, such as ischemic heart disease and musculoskeletal disorders. Significant regional inequalities were observed in disease distribution: high Socio-demographic Index (SDI) regions bore a heavier burden of musculoskeletal and mental disorders, whereas middle and low SDI regions exhibited more pronounced mortality and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) attributable to ischemic heart disease. Formal interaction models demonstrated significant age heterogeneity in the ecological associations between COPD prevalence and all eight comorbidities after Benjamini-Hochberg correction (all q ≤0.028). MR analyses provided evidence supporting bidirectional genetic associations between COPD and specific comorbidities. Genetically predicted COPD was significantly associated with an increased risk of asthma and depression (FDR <0.05), and conversely, genetic susceptibility to asthma and depression was associated with a higher risk of developing COPD (FDR <0.05). CONCLUSIONS: The comorbidity patterns between COPD and its key concomitant conditions are influenced by multiple factors, including demographic structure, regional development levels, and shared biological mechanisms. Our findings underscore the necessity of shifting from a single-disease management model towards integrated care strategies that emphasize comorbidity screening and holistic patient management.

papers.title_zh: 胸腔镜交感神经切断术围术期斑点灌注动态变化及其与代偿性出汗的关联（117例回顾性队列，关联在校正后减弱）
papers.title_en: Speckle perfusion dynamics as an objective marker of sympathetic interruption and its association with compensatory sweating after thoracic sympathectomy.
papers.authors: Shih BC, Moon DH, Lee S
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery, Gangnam Severance Hospital, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Se…
papers.results: 灌注值由术前120.9±30.7升至触发前128.1±29.8，术后降至102.7±23.3（all P<0.001）。触发前百分比变化与代偿性出汗相关（OR 1.03, 95%CI 1.00-1.05; P=0.02）。心率与触发前反应相关（r=0.21, P=0.02），但无独立预测价值。冷觉与体重指数相关（未给出具体数值）。
papers.authors_conclusion: Speckle perfusion demonstrates measurable perioperative changes in cutaneous microvascular perfusion associated with thoracic sympathetic interruption, supporting its potential as an objective physiologic marker of the vascular response to sympathectomy. Greater pre-trigger perfusion response was associated with clinically significant compensatory sweating in univariable analysis, although this association was attenuated after multivariable adjustment and remains exploratory. These findings suggest that preoperative vascular reactivity may reflect an autonomic phenotype relevant to compensatory sweating and warrant prospective physiologic validation.
papers.ai_note: 代偿性出汗关联仅在单因素分析中成立（OR 1.03, 95%CI 1.00-1.05，下限恰为1.00），摘要明确承认多因素校正后关联减弱且为探索性，但未给出任何校正后效应值与CI——摘要层面无法判断独立效应是否存在，信息不足；核心目标之一的'预测代偿性出汗'实际未被验证。灌注术前-触发前-术后变化仅有组内自身对照、无非手术或非切断对照组，'交感神经阻断的客观标志'的特异性无法确立。心率r=0.21为弱相关。冷觉与BMI的结论无数值支撑。回顾性、单中心、无外部验证与前瞻性生理学验证，均需后续研究确认。

pico.p: 接受胸腔镜交感神经切断术并完成围术期斑点灌注评估的原发性手掌多汗症患者117例（回顾性队列）
pico.ic: 同一患者自身前后对照（术前、触发前、术后三个时间点灌注值及相对基线百分比变化）；无独立对照组

papers.reason: 影响胸腔镜交感神经切断术代偿性出汗这一最常见并发症的术前风险评估路径选择：若灌注反应可预测代偿性出汗，可指导患者告知与术式决策；当前证据仅为探索性单因素关联，提示该方向尚不足以改变临床实践，为后续前瞻性验证研究提供效应量参考与方法学教训（须报告多因素校正结果）。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Thoracic sympathectomy is an effective treatment for primary palmar hyperhidrosis; however, postoperative compensatory sweating remains a common and unpredictable complication. Objective physiologic markers for assessing sympathetic interruption and predicting the risk of compensatory sweating remain insufficiently established. This study aimed to evaluate perioperative speckle perfusion dynamics as an objective marker of sympathetic interruption and to assess its association with compensatory sweating after thoracic sympathectomy. METHODS: A retrospective cohort of 117 patients undergoing thoracic sympathectomy with perioperative speckle perfusion assessment was analyzed. Perfusion was measured at preoperative, pre-trigger, and postoperative time points. Percent changes from baseline were calculated. Associations with compensatory sweating and cold sensation were evaluated using logistic regression. RESULTS: Perfusion increased from 120.9±30.7 preoperatively to 128.1±29.8 at the pre-trigger state and decreased to 102.7±23.3 postoperatively (all P<0.001). Percent pre-trigger change was associated with compensatory sweating (odds ratio 1.03, 95% confidence interval: 1.00-1.05; P=0.02). Heart rate correlated with pre-trigger response (r=0.21, P=0.02) but was not independently predictive. Cold sensation was related to body mass index. CONCLUSIONS: Speckle perfusion demonstrates measurable perioperative changes in cutaneous microvascular perfusion associated with thoracic sympathetic interruption, supporting its potential as an objective physiologic marker of the vascular response to sympathectomy. Greater pre-trigger perfusion response was associated with clinically significant compensatory sweating in univariable analysis, although this association was attenuated after multivariable adjustment and remains exploratory. These findings suggest that preoperative vascular reactivity may reflect an autonomic phenotype relevant to compensatory sweating and warrant prospective physiologic validation.

papers.title_en: Real-world outcomes of neoadjuvant targeted therapy in resectable epidermal growth factor receptor mutation-positive non-small cell lung cancer: a retrospective study.
papers.authors: Li J, Zhang Y, Gao J, Deng H, Luo Z, Ma X, Xie M, Xue X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory and Critical Care, Xuanwu Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China.
papers.results: 总体ORR为57.7%；MPR率为26.7%；两组MPR率无显著组间差异；不良事件以皮疹、皮肤干燥、腹泻和口腔溃疡最常见，AE发生率组间无统计学差异；无患者发生≥3级严重不良事件；亚组分析显示一代/二代与三代EGFR-TKI之间1年及3年RFS和OS无显著差异；按早期与局部晚期分层的1年及3年RFS和OS亦无统计学差异（摘要未给出具体生存率数值、CI或P值）
papers.authors_conclusion: In real-world clinical practice, EGFR-TKIs used as NTT for patients with resectable EGFR-mutant NSCLC show encouraging therapeutic potential and are associated with an absence of severe adverse reactions. Patients receiving distinct generations of EGFR-TKIs as neoadjuvant treatment demonstrated comparable long-term prognostic outcomes.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要中所有主要疗效与生存比较均未报告具体数值、95%CI或P值，仅以'no significant difference'表述，无法判断检验效能与是否存在假阴性；样本量仅45例且无手术±化疗等标准治疗对照组，无法回答新辅助靶向是否优于现有标准，作者'encouraging therapeutic potential'的结论缺乏对照支撑，属无比较条件下的选择性积极表述；MPR 26.7%明显偏低但未在结论中讨论；亚组按早期/局部晚期分层的生存数据同样无具体数字，信息不足

pico.p: 2018年7月至2023年4月接受新辅助EGFR-TKI治疗的EGFR突变肺腺癌患者45例（一代/二代TKI 18例，三代TKI 27例），均完成至少2个周期后手术切除
pico.ic: 一代/二代EGFR-TKI vs 三代EGFR-TKI 作为新辅助靶向治疗（无非新辅助靶向治疗对照组）

papers.reason: 为可切除EGFR突变NSCLC新辅助靶向的真实世界MPR/ORR基线与安全谱提供参考，提示三代与一二代TKI在该场景下可能无生存差异；但因无对照与无具体生存数值，仅能作为假设生成性证据，不能直接改变新辅助方案选择
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Multiple clinical trials have validated the efficacy of neoadjuvant targeted therapy (NTT) for resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations. This retrospective study aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant EGFR-tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) in real-world cohorts, and to compare therapeutic outcomes across different generations of EGFR-TKIs in patients with EGFR-mutant resectable NSCLC. METHODS: Patients diagnosed with EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma who received NTT between July 2018 and April 2023 were retrospectively enrolled. All participants completed at least two cycles of neoadjuvant EGFR-TKI therapy before surgical resection. RESULTS: Forty-five patients with EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma were enrolled in the study, including 18 treated with first/second-generation EGFR-TKIs and 27 treated with third-generation EGFR-TKIs. The overall objective response rate (ORR) was 57.7%, and the major pathological response (MPR) rate was 26.7%. No significant intergroup difference was observed in MPR rates. Rash, dry skin, diarrhea and oral ulcerations were the most frequent adverse events (AEs), and no statistically significant intergroup disparity was detected in AE incidence. No patient experienced grade ≥3 severe AEs. Subgroup analysis showed no significant differences in 1-year and 3-year relapse-free survival (RFS) and overall survival (OS) between patients receiving first/second-generation EGFR-TKIs and those receiving third-generation EGFR-TKIs. Similarly, 1- and 3-year RFS and OS showed no statistical differences when stratified by early-stage versus locally advanced disease. CONCLUSIONS: In real-world clinical practice, EGFR-TKIs used as NTT for patients with resectable EGFR-mutant NSCLC show encouraging therapeutic potential and are associated with an absence of severe adverse reactions. Patients receiving distinct generations of EGFR-TKIs as neoadjuvant treatment demonstrated comparable long-term prognostic outcomes.

papers.title_en: Perioperative and early oncologic outcomes of complex segmentectomy via uniportal video-assisted thoracic surgery for primary lung cancer.
papers.authors: Watanabe T, Suzuki E, Yoshii N, Kohama T, Iguchi K, Tanahashi M, Okuda K
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic and Pediatric Surgery, Nagoya City University Graduate School of Medical Sciences, Nagoya, Japan.
papers.results: 中位手术时间152 min；中位估计出血量6 mL；中转开胸3例（3.7%），均为可控中转、无紧急开胸；术后并发症4例（4.9%）；无30天及90天死亡、无30天再入院；R0切除率100%；中位随访10个月，局部复发0例，远处复发4例（4.9%）
papers.authors_conclusion: U-VATS复杂肺段切除用于原发性肺癌，其术后并发症率与中转率与其他胸腔镜入路报道一致；在充分选择的患者中、经周密术前规划与标准化术中策略，这些结果支持U-VATS复杂肺段切除的技术可行性

pico.ic: 无对照组（单臂设计，仅与其他胸腔镜入路的文献报道作间接比较）

papers.reason: 为单孔VATS复杂肺段切除的安全性提供初步病例系列基线，可用于评估该术式开展的可行性预期与围手术期风险量级，但不足以改变手术入路或亚肺叶切除策略的临床决策
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Uniportal video-assisted thoracic surgery (U-VATS) has been increasingly adopted. However, evidence regarding the safety and oncologic outcomes of U-VATS complex segmentectomy remains limited. We aimed to evaluate the perioperative and early oncologic outcomes of U-VATS complex segmentectomy for primary lung cancer. METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed patients who underwent U-VATS complex segmentectomy for primary lung cancer at our institution between December 2021 and November 2025. Patient characteristics, perioperative outcomes, and oncologic outcomes were evaluated. RESULTS: Eighty-two patients were enrolled. The median age of the patients was 72 years. The indication for segmentectomy was intentional in 61 patients (74.4%) and compromised in 21 patients (25.6%). The median operative time was 152 min and the median estimated blood loss was 6 mL. Conversion was required in 3 patients (3.7%). All conversions were performed in a controlled manner; no patients required emergency thoracotomy. Postoperative complications occurred in 4 patients (4.9%). There were no 30- or 90-day mortalities or readmissions within 30 days after surgery. R0 resection was achieved in all patients. The median follow-up duration was 10 months. No local recurrence was observed during the follow-up period. Distant recurrence occurred in 4 patients (4.9%). CONCLUSIONS: U-VATS complex segmentectomy for primary lung cancer was associated with postoperative complication and conversion rates consistent with those reported for other thoracoscopic approaches. These findings support the technical feasibility of U-VATS complex segmentectomy in appropriately selected patients when performed with meticulous preoperative planning and standardized intraoperative strategies.

papers.title_en: Computed tomography (CT)-guided fiducial placement for lung nodule localization: a single-center experience.
papers.authors: Ward KR, Davis R, Vadnala V, Kim M, Aung K, Henderson H, Metz T, Watson TJ et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Surgery, Corewell Health William Beaumont University Hospital, Royal Oak, MI, USA.
papers.results: 金标置入成功38例；出血3例(8%)，均自限；气胸7例(18%)，其中3例(8%)需猪尾管引流；术中全部金标被识别；6例结节仅靠视诊或触诊即定位；手术方案改变3例(8%)（1例三次楔形切除失败后改行肺叶切除，2例金标未取出但认为切除充分）；最终病理腺癌29例(76%)、转移癌5例(13%)、非癌性病变4例(11%)；所有肿瘤标本切缘阴性，最近切缘距离中位1.4 cm（IQR 0.7-1.9 cm）；结节最大径中位1.2 cm（IQR 1.0-1.5 cm）。摘要未报告P值或95%CI。
papers.authors_conclusion: CT引导金标置入是一种可靠的定位方法；需干预的气胸发生于8%的病例；几乎全部金标和可疑病变经楔形切除成功移除；与其他结节定位方法相比，该方法总体耐受性好、成功率高、并发症少、资源效率高，并表现出长期的实质内稳定性；仍需包括成本评估在内的进一步研究来比较各种定位方法。
papers.ai_note: 单臂无对照的回顾性小样本（n=38），'高成功率、并发症少、优于其他方法'的判断缺乏头对头数据支撑，属外推；金标置入全部成功可能反映选择性纳入（未报告置入失败或未转手术的病例），存在选择偏倚；'所有金标术中被识别'与后文'2例金标未取出'表面存在表述张力（识别≠取出）；气胸总体发生率18%而结论以'8%需干预'口径强调耐受性，属选择性强调；气胸与出血仅按自限/需引流分层，无与钩针、微线圈、吲哚菁绿等现行定位方法的比较数据；成本评估缺失为作者自认局限。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: With the adoption of low-dose computed tomography (CT) for lung cancer screening, small lung nodules are increasingly detected. Sublobar resection has been shown to be oncologically equivalent to lobectomy for peripheral lung cancers ≤2 cm and appropriate for small pulmonary metastases, necessitating localization methods for non-anatomic wedge resection. Preoperative CT-guided metal fiducial placement with intraoperative fluoroscopy is one such method. We hypothesized that this technique would enable high resection success with few complications. METHODS: We performed a single-institution retrospective review of patients undergoing lung nodule resection preceded by CT-guided fiducial placement between 12/2022-2/2025. RESULTS: Fiducial placement was successful in 38 consecutive patients. Complications included hemorrhage [3 (8%), self-limited] and pneumothorax [7 (18%); 3 (8%) requiring pigtail catheter]. All fiducials were identified at the time of surgery. Six nodules could be identified by visualization or palpation alone. Operative plans changed in 3 (8%) cases: one lobectomy after three failed wedge resections, and two cases where the fiducial was not retrieved, but resection was deemed adequate. On final pathology, 29 (76%) patients had adenocarcinoma, 5 (13%) had metastases, and 4 (11%) had non-cancerous lesions. All cancer specimens had negative margins with a median distance to the closest cut margin of 1.4 cm (IQR, 0.7-1.9 cm), and the median lung nodule size was 1.2 cm (IQR, 1.0-1.5 cm). CONCLUSIONS: CT-guided fiducial placement is a reliable localization method. Pneumothorax requiring intervention occurred in 8% of cases. Nearly all fiducials and suspicious lesions were successfully removed via wedge resection. Compared to other methods of nodule localization, CT-guided fiducial placement was generally well tolerated with a high success rate and few complications, was resource-efficient, and demonstrated prolonged intraparenchymal stability. Further studies, including cost assessments, are needed to compare localization methods.

papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems for chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation can detect abnormalities, generate reports, provide visual grounding, and support dialogue but often offer limited mechanisms for inspection and follow-up. We present Transparent Radiology Assistance for Chest X-ray Explanation and Review (TRACER), a multimodal multi-agent workflow integrating CXR analysis, consultation support, and prior-report comparison with structured findings, gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) cues, report-generation steps, and execution trajectories. Evaluation included report-quality benchmarking on 2000 frontal CXRs and user studies with 60 non-radiologist participants. Experiment II used 12 cases, with one fixed report per case in both text-only and transparency-supported conditions; the latter additionally displayed structured findings, finding-specific Grad-CAM cues, and execution trajectories. Open-ended responses were scored by an independent automated judge with clinician validation on a stratified subset. Experiment III evaluated eight prior-current pairs with or without an archive-assisted comparison paragraph. The full report pipeline achieved the best values on six of eight automatic metrics. Transparency support increased Consultation Preparation Quality from 2.133 ± 1.302 to 3.142 ± 1.154 (odds ratio 6.76, 95% confidence interval 3.92-11.67; P < 0.001  ). Archive assistance improved difference identification from 0.642±0.338 to 0.833±0.285 (odds ratio 4.16, 95% confidence interval 2.33-7.42; P < 0.001  ) and reduced mean completion time from 108.825 to 74.225 s. The transparency-supported condition also yielded higher usability ratings and lower perceived workload. These findings support TRACER as an inspectable workflow for CXR report review, verification-oriented consultation preparation, and prior-current comparison; clinical usefulness requires evaluation with patients and clinicians.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Post-COPD diagnosis, individuals have an increased risk of cardiopulmonary events, but little is known about the risk pre-diagnosis. This study extends previous evidence by investigating the prevalence of cardiopulmonary events before the first recorded COPD diagnosis, including within a standardised 3-year pre-diagnosis window, and compared cardiopulmonary risk with that of matched controls without COPD. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This retrospective, cohort study included patients with a diagnosis of COPD in the Clinical Practice Research Datalink. The overall cohort included patients aged ≥35 years with a COPD diagnosis prior to December 31, 2019, from which an incident COPD cohort was identified with first recorded diagnosis between January 1, 2018-December 31, 2019 (index date). Cardiopulmonary events of interest were quantified within 3 years pre-index among those with ≥3 years of pre-index data and during the full look-back period. Matched non-COPD patients served as controls (1:2 ratio). RESULTS: Of 426,854 patients with COPD, 77,428 were incident and matched 1:2 to patients without COPD. Patients in the incident cohort (mean age 67.4 [SD 13.6] years, 52% male, 94% White) had a higher prevalence of pre-diagnosis cardiopulmonary events than controls (76.2% versus 45.6%; odds ratio (OR) 3.8, [95% CI: 3.8-3.9]). This association was consistent, with greater relative odds observed among those with ≥3 years pre-index data (n=70,062): 56.6% had a cardiopulmonary event vs 20.9% (OR 4.9, 95% CI: 4.8-5.0) within 3 years pre-index, including severe cardiovascular events in 16,679 (23.8%) and respiratory events in 32,293 (46.1%) patients. Most common severe cardiovascular events were atrial fibrillation (58.1%), heart failure (46.1%) and myocardial infarction (15.1%). Before diagnosis, patients with incident COPD also had substantially greater HCRU, including 4.3-fold higher inpatient costs than matched controls. CONCLUSION: Cardiopulmonary events are frequent before COPD diagnosis, and signal elevated cardiopulmonary risk. Understanding the occurrence of antecedent cardiopulmonary events in COPD may enable earlier diagnosis and treatment.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) is a key treatment for patients with COPD. The main challenge in PR is maintaining benefits over the long term. The main objective of this observational study was to evaluate the proportion of patients who maintained at least half of their personal goals, as determined during the PR programme (PRP), at one year. METHODS: Patients with COPD admitted to a PRP were prospectively included in this observational study. At the end of the PRP, patients were assessed using standard tools (exercise capacity, dyspnea, quality of life…) and developed a written plan for goal maintenance. Patients were then assessed at 6 and 12 months. The primary endpoint was maintenance of the goal(s) determined by the patient at 12 months. The secondary endpoints were the maintenance of the goal(s) at 6 months and the maintained benefits of the PRP at 12 months. RESULTS: 221 patients were included and 214 analysed. Fifty one percent of the patients maintained at least half of their goals at 12 months and sixty four percent of the patients at 6 months. At 12 months, anxiety was not significantly altered, and the increases in dyspnea and depression, as well as the decrease in exercise capacity and quality of life, were significant but not clinically relevant (except quality of life). CONCLUSION: after a PRP including a written plan for maintaining goals, half of the patients maintained at least half of their goals at 12 months, without experiencing a clinically relevant decline in PR benefits.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The perioperative advantages of video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) over thoracotomy are established, but the real-world introduction of a minimally invasive program is shaped by patient selection, technical maturation, conversion and secular change in care. We evaluated the decade-long implementation of VATS within a regional thoracic surgery service and estimated its association with early postoperative outcomes. METHODS: This is a retrospective cohort study of anatomical lung resections performed over the first decade [2009-2018] of a VATS implementation program at two tertiary hospitals covered by a single thoracic surgery department. The primary exposure was the approach with which the operation was started under an intention-to-treat analysis strategy, and the outcomes were 90-day mortality, a composite of major morbidity and perioperative mortality, and 30-day readmission. Propensity score weighting used preoperative covariates, including calendar year and hospital. Covariate balance before and after weighting was assessed by absolute standardized mean differences. The average treatment effect (ATE), reported as risk difference with 95% confidence interval (CI), was the primary estimand, with average treatment on the treated (ATT) and average treatment effect on the overlap population (ATO) as sensitivity estimands. An exploratory analysis comparing conversion with upfront thoracotomy was carried out under the same prespecification. RESULTS: A total of 964 out of 1,404 anatomical lung resections met the inclusion criteria. The series included 472 operations begun thoracoscopically, of which 97 were converted (20%), versus 492 upfront thoracotomies. Completed VATS rose from 16.7% of anatomical resections in 2009 to 53.7% in 2018, while conversion annual rates fell from 50.0% to 6.5%. Converted procedures had the highest crude rate of every adverse outcome. Under intention to treat, an intended VATS approach was not significantly associated with 90-day mortality (ATE -1.9 percentage points; 95% CI: -4.7 to +0.9; P=0.17), major morbidity and mortality (ATE -4.6 points; 95% CI: -9.4 to +0.2; P=0.06) or readmission (ATE -2.0 points; 95% CI: -5.9 to +2.0; P=0.33); for the composite outcome, the ATT (P=0.04) and ATO (P=0.047) estimands reached significance. In the as-treated analysis, all three outcomes were significant in favor of completed VATS. No statistically significant differences were detected between conversions and upfront thoracotomies in the exploratory analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Across a decade-long regional implementation trajectory, adoption of VATS rose and conversion fell. When conversions are analyzed in the arm in which the operation was begun, the association between an intended thoracoscopic approach and better perioperative outcomes is attenuated and no longer significant. These findings do not question the perioperative advantages of thoracoscopic lobectomy, but the benefit attributable to adopting a thoracoscopic strategy at service level is smaller and less certain than that observed among the operations it completes.

papers.title_zh: IPF合并小细胞肺癌40例单中心回顾性队列：以老年男性、晚期居多，随访期内死亡以IPF急性加重与肿瘤进展为主
papers.title_en: Clinical and prognostic characteristics of concurrent small cell lung cancer in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a retrospective study.
papers.authors: Shi Y, Li Z, Chen R, Shao C, Li J, Xu K, Liu Y, Wang M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sc…
papers.results: 中位随访时间12.0个月；随访期内29例(72.5%)死亡，主要死因为IPF急性加重(AE-IPF)13例(44.8%)、SCLC进展12例(41.4%)；分期：IV期17例(42.5%)、III期15例(37.5%)；合并其他基础疾病28例(70.0%)；CT示肺气肿26例(65%)；IPF与SCLC同期诊断23例(57.5%)，余17例为IPF随访中发现SCLC；吡非尼酮与尼达尼布各仅2例处方。摘要未报告中位OS、HR、CI或P值
papers.authors_conclusion: 纳入研究的IPF-SCLC患者以老年男性、吸烟指数重为主，多数诊断时已为晚期SCLC；抗纤维化药物使用少见，化疗为主要抗肿瘤治疗；未控制的SCLC进展与AE-IPF是主要死因；临床医师应考虑在化疗同时尽早启动抗纤维化治疗、监测AE-IPF并采取多学科管理
papers.ai_note: 无对照组且未做任何组间比较，作者关于『尽早启动抗纤维化治疗』的建议仅基于4例用药经验，数据无法支持疗效推断，属假设生成；死因归类依赖回顾性病历记录，AE-IPF与SCLC进展的判定标准未交代，存在归因偏倚；摘要未给出中位总生存期、生存曲线、分期或治疗分层的生存差异及任何CI/P值，信息不足；单中心住院人群、92.5%男性，外推性有限

pico.p: PUMCH 2014年1月至2023年12月住院的IPF-SCLC患者，n=40（平均年龄68.2±6.3岁，范围54–82岁；男性37例92.5%；吸烟史35例87.5%）
pico.ic: 无干预对照（回顾性描述性研究）；治疗构成：静脉化疗37例(92.5%)、口服依托泊苷2例(5%)、未化疗1例(2.5%)、肺部放疗11例(27.5%)；抗纤维化药物吡非尼酮、尼达尼布各仅2例使用

papers.reason: 提示胸部肿瘤合并IPF人群的临床管理缺口（抗纤维化用药率极低、诊断偏晚）与死因构成，为IPF-肺癌共病队列设计和AE-IPF监测试验终点提供参考基线
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer (LC) is a comorbidity that seriously affects the prognosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) patients. Small cell LC (SCLC) accounts for the highest proportion of hospitalized LC patients with concurrent IPF at Peking Union Medical College Hospital (PUMCH). To enable effective and standardized management of patients with IPF and SCLC, this study aims to summarize the clinical and prognostic characteristics of IPF-SCLC patients to improve their prognosis. METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled patients with IPF (diagnosed by 2022 ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT criteria)-SCLC (pathologically confirmed) admitted to PUMCH from January 2014 to December 2023. Clinical manifestation, chest computed tomography (CT) imaging, laboratory test, treatment and outcome data of patients with IPF-SCLC were collected and reviewed in detail with final follow-up on June 30, 2024. RESULTS: Forty patients with IPF-SCLC were included with the average age of 68.2±6.3 years (range, 54 to 82 years). And there were 37 (92.5%) males. Median follow-up time was 12.0 months. Additionally, 35 (87.5%) patients had a smoking history. Twenty-eight (70.0%) IPF-SCLC patients were concurrent with one or more other underlying diseases. Emphysema was detected in 26 (65%) patients via chest CT. IPF and SCLC were diagnosed during the same period in 23 (57.5%) patients, whereas SCLC was diagnosed during the follow-up of IPF in the remaining 17 patients. However, pirfenidone and nintedanib were only prescribed to two patients, respectively. Most patients were diagnosed with late-stage SCLC: 17 (42.5%) patients had stage IV SCLC, and 15 (37.5%) patients had stage III SCLC. Furthermore, with respect to anticancer therapy, one (2.5%) patient received no chemotherapy, 2 (5%) patients received oral etoposide, 37 (92.5%) patients received intravenous chemotherapy, and 11 (27.5%) patients received pulmonary radiotherapy. Finally, 29 (72.5%) patients died during follow-up. The main causes of death were acute exacerbation of IPF (AE-IPF) (13 patients, 44.8%) and progression of SCLC (12 patients, 41.4%). CONCLUSIONS: The patients with IPF-SCLC included in our studies were mainly elderly males with a heavy smoking index, most of whom were diagnosed with late-stage SCLC. Antifibrotic medications for IPF were uncommon, and chemotherapy was the main cancer treatment. The progression of uncontrolled SCLC and AE-IPF were the main causes of death. Clinicians should consider early initiation of antifibrotic therapy alongside chemotherapy, monitor for the occurrence of AE-IPF, and adopt multidisciplinary management.

papers.title_zh: 治疗前NLR对可切除食管癌新辅助免疫化疗病理缓解的预测价值有限（AUROC仅0.586）
papers.title_en: Neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio (NLR) predicts pathological response to neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy in resectable esophageal cancer: a retrospective study.
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Guo Y, Cai X, Zhang Z, Zhang M
papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Metabolic Dysregulation & Prevention and Treatment of Esophageal Cancer, Shanghai Chest Hospital…
papers.results: non-pCR患者治疗前NLR显著高于pCR患者（P=0.04）；NLR与Becker TRG呈弱正相关（r=0.130, P=0.03）；NLR预测non-pCR的AUROC=0.586（95%CI: 0.510-0.663, P=0.04），最佳cutoff 3.59（敏感度37.6%，特异度79.3%，PPV 89.0%，NPV 24.1%）；NLR联合临床分期后预测non-pCR的AUROC升至0.633；ESCC亚组（n=271）NLR预测non-pCR的AUROC=0.609（95%CI: 0.530-0.687），预测non-MPR的AUROC=0.570（95%CI: 0.512-0.642）；联合临床T、N分类后non-pCR的AUROC=0.654、non-MPR的AUROC=0.626；多因素logistic回归示NLR为non-pCR的独立预测因子（OR=1.325, 95%CI: 1.005-1.747, P=0.046），bootstrap内部验证支持其稳健性
papers.authors_conclusion: Elevated pretreatment NLR is associated with poorer pathological response to nICT in patients with resectable esophageal cancer, particularly in ESCC. When combined with clinical staging, NLR may serve as an accessible adjunctive tool to identify patients with a low probability of pCR.
papers.ai_note: 主要终点预测效能AUROC仅0.586，接近随机水平（0.5），敏感度37.6%、NPV 24.1%极低，作者'accessible adjunctive tool'的结论与实际判别力存在明显落差；cutoff由同一数据集ROC导出且未行外部验证，bootstrap仅内部验证；ESCC亚组及non-MPR为多重比较且无多重性校正；NLR为非特异性炎症指标，混杂因素（感染、分期分布）控制在摘要中信息不足

pico.p: 295例接受新辅助免疫化疗（nICT）后手术的可切除食管癌患者（ESCC亚组271例）
pico.ic: 治疗前NLR（cutoff 3.59）预测non-pCR；联合临床分期/临床T、N分类的组合模型比较单一NLR

papers.reason: 为nICT前基于常规血检筛选潜在non-pCR患者的策略提供效能基线数据，提示单一NLR判别力不足以指导临床降级或治疗决策，可作为同类预测标志物研究的对照参考
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy (nICT) has demonstrated promising efficacy in locally advanced esophageal cancer. The pretreatment neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio (NLR) has shown prognostic value across various solid tumors. This study aimed to evaluate the predictive value of pretreatment NLR for pathological response in patients with resectable esophageal cancer receiving nICT. METHODS: A total of 295 patients with resectable esophageal cancer who underwent nICT followed by surgery were retrospectively analyzed. Pretreatment NLR was calculated from peripheral blood counts. Pathological response was assessed using the Becker tumor regression grading (TRG) system. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was conducted to evaluate the predictive performance of NLR. Multivariable logistic regression and bootstrap internal validation were performed to assess its independent predictive value. RESULTS: Pretreatment NLR was significantly higher in non-pathological complete response (non-pCR) patients than in pathological complete response (pCR) patients (P=0.04). A weak positive correlation was observed between NLR and TRG (r=0.130, P=0.03). The area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of NLR for predicting non-pCR was 0.586 [95% confidence intervals (CI): 0.510-0.663, P=0.04], with an optimal cutoff value of 3.59 (sensitivity 37.6%, specificity 79.3%, positive predictive value 89.0%, negative predictive value 24.1%). The combination of NLR with clinical stage improved the AUROC to 0.633 for predicting non-pCR. In the esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) subgroup (n=271), NLR demonstrated improved predictive performance for both non-pCR (AUROC =0.609, 95% CI: 0.530-0.687) and non-major pathological response (non-MPR) (AUROC =0.570, 95% CI: 0.512-0.642). Integration with clinical T and N categories further increased the AUROC to 0.654 for non-pCR and 0.626 for non-MPR. Multivariable logistic regression confirmed that NLR was an independent predictor of non-pCR [odds ratios (OR) =1.325, 95% CI: 1.005-1.747, P=0.046], and bootstrap validation supported its robustness. CONCLUSIONS: Elevated pretreatment NLR is associated with poorer pathological response to nICT in patients with resectable esophageal cancer, particularly in ESCC. When combined with clinical staging, NLR may serve as an accessible adjunctive tool to identify patients with a low probability of pCR.

papers.title_zh: 丹麦全国胸腺上皮肿瘤队列中副肿瘤疾病负担与时序特征：诊断前自身免疫病/癌症史与总生存无显著关联
papers.title_en: AB027. Paraneoplastic diseases in patients with thymic epithelial tumours: findings from the nation-wide Danish thymic epithelial tumor database.
papers.authors: Østergaard T, Santoni-Rugiu E, Jensen THL, Perell KA, Petersen RH, Petersen PM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Oncology, Copenhagen University Hospital, Denmark.
papers.results: 中位随访65个月。诊断前：105例（37.2%）有既往癌症诊断，88例（31.2%）有自身免疫病。随访中新发自身免疫病33例（11.7%），新发胸腺外癌症41例（14.5%）。诊断前以皮肤癌和结肠直肠癌为主，诊断后以淋巴瘤和前列腺癌最常见。重症肌无力在诊断前后均为首位自身免疫病；Good综合征仅在诊断后出现于6例患者。既往自身免疫病与既往胸腺外癌症均与总生存无统计学显著关联（摘要未报告HR/CI/P值）。
papers.authors_conclusion: TET患者中观察到沉重的自身免疫与恶性疾病负担，以重症肌无力为主。既往副肿瘤疾病与生存无关联。某些疾病发病率呈现趋势，提示TET诊断后副肿瘤疾病模式发生转变。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告任何HR、95%CI或P值，也未报告生存事件数与log-rank检验结果，'无显著关联'无法区分是真阴性还是样本量/效能不足（282例、事件数未知），属不可解释的阴性结论。全研究为描述性设计，无多变量校正，未控制胸腺瘤亚型、分期、治疗方式等混杂；疾病'时序'仅为前后计数比较，未做时间依赖或发病密度分析。中位年龄66岁明显高于常见胸腺瘤发病年龄谱，人群代表性存疑。无主要/次要终点之分，不存在主要终点阴性而突出次要终点的问题。

pico.p: 2015–2020年丹麦全国确诊胸腺上皮肿瘤（TET）患者282例，中位年龄66岁；胸腺瘤85%、胸腺癌14%、胸腺神经内分泌肿瘤1.4%
pico.ic: 无干预；按TET诊断前后时序描述自身免疫病、免疫缺陷与胸腺外恶性肿瘤的发生情况，并用Kaplan-Meier/log-rank检验其与总生存的关联

papers.reason: 影响胸腺上皮肿瘤患者TET诊断后的长期随访策略设计（第二原发癌筛查与自身免疫病监测的病种侧重），并为本单位TET队列的合并症基线与事件率提供全国对照数据；同时提示既往合并症不应作为生存预后的否定性判据。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Patients with thymic epithelial tumors (TETs) are predisposed to autoimmune dis-eases, immunodeficiencies, and extrathymic malignancies. Still, the timing of these conditions relative to TET diagnosis and their prognostic significance remain poorly characterized. METHODS: This nationwide study included all Danish patients diagnosed with TETs from 2015 to 2020. Data on demographics, tumor subtype, autoimmune diseases, immunodeficiencies, malig-nancies, follow-up, and survival were collected from electronic medical records. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize patient characteristics and disease chronology, while Kaplan-Meier analyses and log-rank tests were applied to assess associating with survival. RESULTS: Among 282 patients with a median age of 66 years, thymoma accounted for 85% of cases, thymic carcinoma for 14%, and thymic neuroendocrine tumors for 1.4%. Prior to TET diagnosis, 105 (37.2%) patients had a previous cancer diagnosis and 88 (31.2%) had autoim-mune disease. Over a median follow-up of 65 months, 33 (11.7%) patients developed new auto-immune diseases, and 41 (14.5%) patients developed new extrathymic cancers. The pattern of malignancies differed over time, with skin and colorectal cancers predominating before TET diagnosis, while lymphoma and prostate cancer were most frequent afterward. Myasthenia gravis was the leading autoimmune disease both before and after TET diagnosis, while Good's syndrome occurred only after diagnosis in six patients. Pre-existing autoimmune disease and pre-existing extrathymic cancer were not significantly associated with overall survival. CONCLUSIONS: A substantial burden of autoimmune and malignant disease was observed among patients with TETs, predominated by myasthenia gravis. Pre-existing paraneoplastic diseases were not associated with survival. A trend was observed in the incidence of certain disorders suggesting a shift in the pattern of developed paraneoplastic diseases after TET diagnosis.

papers.title_zh: 人工智能在食管癌放疗中的应用：文献综述——回顾105项研究揭示AI在决策与计划环节证据较多、在质量保证与治疗实施环节证据不足
papers.title_en: Artificial intelligence in esophageal cancer radiotherapy: a literature review.
papers.authors: Wang G, Bai G, Huo S
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Intervention, The Second People's Hospital of Baiyin City, Baiyin, China.
papers.results: A total of 105 studies covering the different stages of the radiotherapy workflow were included in the review. Most studies focused on initial treatment decision-making, primarily benefit-risk stratification through predictive modeling of treatment outcomes and treatment-related toxicities, followed by treatment planning and preparation, particularly automated segmentation and treatment planning. Few studies investigated AI applications in treatment plan approval and quality assurance, or treatment delivery. Most of the included studies were retrospective, with substantial heterogeneity in study designs, methodologies, and reporting.
papers.authors_conclusion: AI demonstrates substantial potential to facilitate clinical decision-making while improving the efficiency and accuracy of radiotherapy workflows. Future research should prioritize multicenter prospective studies, standardized methodological and reporting frameworks, and explainable AI (XAI) to improve the reliability, transparency, and clinical translation of AI models.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，未描述系统检索流程的PRISMA规范或纳入研究的质量评估方法，偏倚控制信息不足。综述本身未报告任何AI模型的具体性能指标（AUC、DSC等），无法据此判断临床可用性。检索截止日期标注为2026年5月26日，为未来日期，存在时间线矛盾或录入错误的可能，信息不足。纳入研究以回顾性为主且异质性大，作者对此已有明确认识。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Radiotherapy is a key component in the management of esophageal cancer (EC). Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative tool for optimizing radiotherapy workflows. Numerous AI-based tools are being developed to improve efficiency and facilitate the personalization of radiation oncology. This study aimed to provide an up-to-date review of the literature on recent advances in AI applications across the EC radiotherapy workflow. METHODS: The PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases were searched to retrieve original English-language articles published from January 1, 2020 to May 26, 2026. The following search terms were used: "Esophageal neoplasms", "esophageal cancer", "oesophageal cancer" AND "artificial intelligence", "AI" AND "radiation oncology", "radiotherapy", "radiation", "chemoradiotherapy". The included studies covered different steps in the radiotherapy workflow; that is, initial treatment decision-making, treatment planning and preparation, treatment delivery, and post-treatment follow-up. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: A total of 105 studies covering the different stages of the radiotherapy workflow were included in the review. Most studies focused on initial treatment decision-making, primarily benefit-risk stratification through predictive modeling of treatment outcomes and treatment-related toxicities, followed by treatment planning and preparation, particularly automated segmentation and treatment planning. Conversely, few studies investigated AI applications in treatment plan approval and quality assurance, or treatment delivery. Notably, most of the included studies were retrospective, with substantial heterogeneity in study designs, methodologies, and reporting. CONCLUSIONS: AI demonstrates substantial potential to facilitate clinical decision-making while improving the efficiency and accuracy of radiotherapy workflows. Future research should prioritize multicenter prospective studies, standardized methodological and reporting frameworks, and explainable AI (XAI) to improve the reliability, transparency, and clinical translation of AI models.

papers.title_zh: 胸科手术后非膨胀肺（NEL）加用无创通气的单中心单臂回顾性观察：肺复张率随时间递增，但无对照无法区分自然复张
papers.title_en: Noninvasive ventilation for non-expandable lung after pleural surgery: a single-center retrospective study.
papers.authors: Le Gall T, Mismetti V, Sulaiman A, Filaire L, Toledano L, La Greca K, Oprandi S, Tiffet O et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, North Hospital, University Hospital of Saint-Étienne, Saint-Étienne, France.
papers.results: 完全复张率：D1 42.3%（22/52）→ D3 73.1%（38/52）→ 出院后4周 86.6%（45/52）；失败率由13.5%（7/52）降至3.8%（2/52）；部分复张率：D1 44.2%、D3 19.2%、W4 9.6%。胸管引流中位时长4天，住院中位时长4天；肺部并发症2例（3.8%）；胸腔积液复发3例（5.8%）；30天死亡0例；治疗依从性94.2%；32.7%患者带家用NIV出院。摘要未报告CI或P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: In this preliminary, single-center, uncontrolled experience, NIV was feasible and associated with progressive radiological lung re-expansion in patients with established NEL following pleural surgery, with infrequent adverse events. These findings provide a preliminary proof of concept supporting NIV as a potential adjunct to standard postoperative care in this indication. Prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trials, stratified by the mechanism of NEL, are needed to confirm this potential benefit and identify the patients most likely to benefit.
papers.ai_note: 无对照组，肺复张的进行性改善无法与NEL的自然转归、胸管引流等常规处理区分，作者结论中'associated with'的归因强度缺乏设计支撑；样本仅限实际接受NIV者，缺乏全部NEL患者分母，存在适应证与选择偏倚；主要终点为影像学复张（半主观、无盲法评估），且未见CI/P等统计学检验；研究时间窗标注为2022年5月至2026年2月，终点时间晚于当前，随访完整性信息不足。

pico.p: 胸科手术后发生NEL并接受NIV的患者52例，中位年龄73岁；胸腔积液病因恶性占71.2%，手术方式以VATS为主
pico.ic: 无创通气（NIV）作为标准术后照护的潜在辅助手段；无对照组/未设置未接受NIV的比较人群

papers.reason: 为胸科术后NEL是否常规加用NIV提供可行性、安全性与影像学应答的初步基线数据，可用于术前谈话与随访方案参考，并作为后续分层RCT的效应量与事件率估计依据；因无对照，不足以改变临床决策。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Non-expandable lung (NEL) is a well-recognized complication of pleural surgery, characterized by failure of the lung to fully re-expand and appose to the parietal pleura, resulting in a persistent pleural space and substantial morbidity. Management of NEL remains challenging, and although the physiological rationale suggests that positive airway pressure could enhance alveolar recruitment and facilitate pleural apposition, the role of noninvasive ventilation (NIV) in treating this condition remains poorly studied. This study aimed to evaluate the potential benefit of NIV on radiological outcomes, as well as its feasibility and safety, for NEL following pleural surgery. METHODS: This retrospective, single-center observational study included patients who received NIV for NEL following pleural surgery between May 2022 and February 2026. The primary outcome was lung re-expansion after NIV, assessed by chest radiography on day 1 (D1) and day 3 (D3), and at 4 weeks (W4) after discharge. Secondary outcomes included duration of chest tube drainage, length of hospital stay, pulmonary complications, NIV-related adverse events, recurrence of pleural effusion, 30-day mortality, home NIV prescription, and treatment adherence. RESULTS: A total of 52 patients, with a median age of 73 years, were included in the final analysis. The etiology of pleural effusion was malignant in 71.2% of cases, and video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) was the predominant surgical approach. Complete re-expansion increased progressively, from 42.3% (22/52) at D1 to 73.1% (38/52) at D3 and 86.6% (45/52) at W4 after discharge, while the failure rate decreased correspondingly from 13.5% (7/52) to 3.8% (2/52) over the same follow-up period. Partial re-expansion also followed an inverse trend (44.2% at D1, 19.2% at D3, 9.6% at W4). The median durations of chest tube drainage and hospital stay were each 4 days. Pulmonary complications occurred in 2 patients (3.8%), recurrence of pleural effusion in 3 patients (5.8%), and no 30-day mortality was observed. NIV was well tolerated, with only minor adverse events; treatment adherence reached 94.2%, and 32.7% of patients were discharged with home NIV. CONCLUSIONS: In this preliminary, single-center, uncontrolled experience, NIV was feasible and associated with progressive radiological lung re-expansion in patients with established NEL following pleural surgery, with infrequent adverse events. These findings provide a preliminary proof of concept supporting NIV as a potential adjunct to standard postoperative care in this indication. Prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trials, stratified by the mechanism of NEL, are needed to confirm this potential benefit and identify the patients most likely to benefit.

papers.authors: Riedi SA, Crasta D, Dahal M, McMullen C, Chung JW, Narula N

papers.results: CWP组全部为男性且BMI更低；三组急性肾损伤（AKI）、肾脏替代治疗（RRT）与住院时长相似；支气管狭窄在心脏死亡供者（DCD）供肺移植后显著更常见；生存分析提示各队列生存相似（摘要未给出HR、95%CI或P值）
