pico.ic: 按移植病因分组（CWP vs A-ILD vs NA-ILD）比较移植后生存与并发症；无干预性对照

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Coal workers' pneumoconiosis (CWP) is a lung disease caused by long-term coal dust exposure. Appalachian miners experience disproportionately high disease prevalence and mortality. Lung transplantation offers outcomes comparable to other interstitial lung diseases (ILDs), yet limited data exist on patients with CWP. This study examines regional disease burden and lung transplant outcomes for CWP at our institution compared with non-occupational ILD. METHODS: A retrospective cohort study evaluated lung transplant recipients with CWP, autoimmune-ILD (A-ILD), and nonautoimmune-ILD (NA-ILD) at the University of Kentucky from 2017 to 2025. Patients were categorized by ILD etiology, and demographic, clinical, and post-transplant outcome data were collected from institutional records under institutional review board-approved protocols. Continuous variables were analyzed using one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) or the Kruskal-Wallis test. Categorical variables were compared using Pearson's Chi-squared test or Fisher's exact test. Survival was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier analysis. RESULTS: Among 67 lung transplant recipients, 23 had CWP, 11 had A-ILD, and 33 had NA-ILD. CWP recipients were exclusively male and had a lower body mass index (BMI). Transplant recipients across all cohorts were predominantly male. Rates of acute kidney injury (AKI), renal replacement therapy (RRT), and hospital stay were similar across groups. Bronchial stenosis post-transplant was significantly more common with cardiac-death donors. Survival analyses suggested similar survival between the cohorts. CONCLUSIONS: This study observed no statistically significant differences in survival or postoperative complications in patients with CWP compared to those with non-occupational ILD. Female underrepresentation was found despite modern increases in women in coal-mining fields. Post-transplant complications of bronchial stenosis requiring dilatation ± stent were more likely in those who received organ donation after circulatory death (DCD). Limited impact of pre-transplant comorbidities was also noted. Despite small, single-center design, results suggest lung transplantation as a feasible treatment option in carefully selected patients with advanced CWP and highlight the need for larger multicenter studies.

papers.title_zh: 基于深度学习的CAD系统BMAX评分与健康筛查检出的肺间质异常CT表现及临床参数的相关性
papers.title_en: Impact of a deep learning-based computer-aided detection system (BMAX) on CT findings and clinical parameters in screening-detected interstitial lung abnormalities: a cross-sectional study.
papers.authors: Furukawa T, Akaike K, Ichiyasu H, Masuda Y, Okabayashi H, Hamada S, Masunaga A, Kawamura K et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory Medicine, Kumamoto University Hospital, Faculty of Life Sciences, Kumamoto University, Kumamot…
papers.results: 高BMAX组纤维化型ILA比例90.2% vs 63.2%（P<0.001）；UIP模式14.7% vs 0.0%（P<0.001）；牵拉性支气管扩张87.8% vs 60.5%（P<0.001）；蜂窝影17.8% vs 0.0%（P<0.001）；%FVC 96.7% vs 103.1%（P<0.001）；%DLco 88.1% vs 104.4%（P<0.001）；KL-6与SP-D升高（均P<0.001）。相关性分析显示BMAX评分与上述生物标志物、肺功能参数及纤维化CT模式显著相关（摘要未给出相关系数或CI）
papers.authors_conclusion: BMAX评分与纤维化特征及ILA严重程度指标相关，提示其在识别ILA患者高风险纤维化影像特征方面具有潜在应用价值
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：（1）BMAX原为胸片ILD检测设计，本研究仅以CT征象作横断面关联验证，缺少独立影像学参照标准与诊断准确性指标（敏感度/特异度/AUC），无法评估其筛查效能；（2）0.3阈值未说明确定依据，也无外部验证队列；（3）无随访结局，'高风险'仅为关联推断，不能外推预后；（4）健康筛查人群为选择性样本，患病构成与真实就诊人群不同，人群限定松动；（5）UIP与蜂窝影在低BMAX组为0%，提示可能存在分组或判读上的完全分离，摘要未报告多因素校正

pico.p: 健康筛查检出的肺间质异常（ILA）患者362例，分为高BMAX组（≥0.3，n=286）与低BMAX组（<0.3，n=76）
pico.ic: 无干预；高BMAX组（≥0.3）与低BMAX组（<0.3）的CT表现、肺功能与生物标志物比较

papers.reason: 为BMAX类胸片CAD工具的CT表型关联提供初步证据，可作为胸科AI辅助ILD筛查研究的队列设计与基线参考，但尚不足以改变ILA随访决策
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: BMAX is a deep learning-based computer-aided detection (CAD) system designed to identify chronic fibrosing interstitial lung disease (ILD) on chest radiographs. While its utility in clinical settings is recognized, the association between BMAX scores and specific computed tomography (CT) findings or clinical parameters in patients with interstitial lung abnormalities (ILAs) remains unclear. This study investigated the correlation between BMAX scores and specific CT findings and clinical parameters in patients with ILAs. METHODS: In this observational, cross-sectional study, we enrolled 362 patients with ILAs detected during health screening. Patients were classified into high (≥0.3, n=286) or low (<0.3, n=76) BMAX groups. CT findings and clinical parameters were compared between groups. Correlations between BMAX scores and relevant biomarkers, respiratory function, and imaging features were evaluated. RESULTS: Patients in the high-BMAX group had greater rates of fibrotic ILA (90.2% vs. 63.2%, P<0.001), usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) patterns (14.7% vs. 0.0%, P<0.001), traction bronchiectasis (87.8% vs. 60.5%, P<0.001), and honeycombing (17.8% vs. 0.0%, P<0.001) than patients in the low-BMAX group. The high-BMAX group also exhibited statistically lower, although clinically preserved, pulmonary-function parameters, including percent predicted forced vital capacity (%FVC; 96.7% vs. 103.1%, P<0.001) and percent predicted diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (%DLco; 88.1% vs. 104.4%, P<0.001), and elevated levels of disease severity markers [Krebs von den Lungen-6 (KL-6) and surfactant protein D (SP-D), both P<0.001] compared to the low-BMAX group. Correlation analysis confirmed that BMAX scores were significantly associated with these biomarkers, pulmonary-function parameters, and fibrosing CT patterns. CONCLUSIONS: BMAX scores are associated with fibrotic characteristics and indicators of ILA severity, suggesting their potential utility for identifying high-risk fibrotic imaging features in patients with ILA.

papers.title_zh: 解剖性肺切除并发症的外科视角：叙述性综述指出并发症总体减少但术后漏气二十年未变，新辅助免疫化疗后手术安全性证据薄弱
papers.title_en: Complications in anatomical lung resection: a comprehensive surgical perspective in a narrative review.
papers.authors: Kennamer K, Reza JA
papers.affiliation_highlight: Macon & Joan Brock Virginia Health Sciences at Old Dominion University, Norfolk, VA, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: While many postoperative complications have reduced in frequency, the rate of postoperative air leak has not changed in two decades. Robust surgical clinical data following neoadjuvant treatment is limited and larger studies, which also report robotic surgical outcomes, are needed to reflect cotemporary surgical practice.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，未报告检索式、检索日期、纳排标准与纳入研究的质量评价，证据强度无法量化；摘要中'漏气率二十年未变''新辅助免疫化疗后不增加手术风险'等关键论断均无任何发生率、CI 或 P 值支持（信息不足）；'不增加手术风险'同时以'available data reflects smaller sample sizes'限定，存在人群与证据量限定松动；主要信息为叙述性归纳而非可直接引用的定量结果。
papers.reason: 为解剖性肺切除围手术期并发症（持续性漏气、支气管胸膜瘘、脓胸、腔内治疗）的临床处理提供综述性参考框架，并明确指出新辅助免疫化疗后手术结局与机器人手术数据缺口，可为相关队列/注册研究的终点设置与样本量论证提供背景依据。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: The development of new technologies and techniques has reduced the frequency and duration of many complications following pulmonary resection. This article reviews complications following lung resection including contemporary strategies in preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative management. METHODS: A literature review was performed using PubMed, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library. Searches were conducted using topic-specific keywords related to perioperative management and complications following anatomical lung resection. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: Minimally invasive surgery is standard and has reduced cost and rates of many complications; however, rates of air leak remain unchanged. Resection following neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy, including minimally invasive surgery, does not appear to increase surgical risk although the available data reflects smaller sample sizes. Significant postoperative complications including bronchopleural fistula and empyema continue to require intensive and thoughtful management. Endoluminal therapies can be effective independently or as adjuncts in management these complications. A high index of suspicion should prompt early intervention to limit negative impact of postoperative complication. CONCLUSIONS: While many postoperative complications have reduced in frequency, the rate of postoperative air leak has not changed in two decades. Robust surgical clinical data following neoadjuvant treatment is limited and larger studies, which also report robotic surgical outcomes, are needed to reflect cotemporary surgical practice.

papers.title_en: Multi-omics and Functional Analyses Identify Cancer-associated Fibroblast-derived Insulin-like Growth Factor 1 as a Stromal Mediator of Lung Adenocarcinoma Progression.
papers.authors: Deng J, Sheng J, You L, Han Q, Wang Y, Pan H, Lu Y, Cai X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medical Oncology School of Medicine Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital Zhejiang University Hangzhou China.
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings indicate that CAF-derived IGF1 contributes to LUAD progression and bone metastatic remodeling through paracrine stromal-tumor communication, highlighting the IGF1/IGF1R axis as a potential stromal-directed therapeutic target in selected LUAD patients.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：发现端仅来自1例快速进展患者的单细胞+外显子测序，n=1的发现强度有限；摘要全篇无任何效应量、样本量、CI或P值，功能与体内实验仅作定性描述（增强/减弱、转移负荷降低），无法评估效应大小与统计学显著性；外部数据集仅称corroborated，未给出验证队列规模与定量结果；LUAD伴/不伴骨转移组织的免疫荧光验证无样本量与量化统计；结论中selected LUAD patients的人群界定未定义，存在人群限定松动风险；IGF1/IGF1R作为治疗靶点的可成药性与对现有治疗的增益未在本研究中评估。

pico.p: 单例快速进展肺腺癌患者（scRNA-seq与探索性全外显子测序）；外部单细胞数据集；伴或不伴骨转移的LUAD组织（免疫荧光验证）；共培养与体内模型（样本量摘要未报告）
pico.ic: 重组IGF1处理 vs 未处理的LUAD细胞；CAF样细胞IGF1敲低 vs 对照的共培养及体内模型

papers.reason: 为LUAD间质靶点IGF1/IGF1R的假说提供机制与实验依据，影响后续生物标志物/靶向联合治疗研究的靶点优先级排序，同时作为单例发现型多组学研究界定该类证据的强度边界，为队列验证研究设计提供参照。
papers.abstract_en: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, yet the stromal mechanisms driving rapid disease progression are incompletely understood. Here, we integrated single-cell RNA sequencing with exploratory whole-exome sequencing to characterize tumor microenvironment remodeling in a rapidly progressing LUAD patient. Tumor tissue exhibited marked stromal enrichment, with inflammatory cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) constituting a prominent fibroblast subset. Receptor-ligand and cell-type-specific expression analyses identified CAF-derived insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) as a potential stromal mediator of LUAD progression. This fibroblast-specific IGF1 pattern was corroborated by an external single-cell dataset and by immunofluorescence validation in LUAD tissues with or without bone metastasis. Functionally, recombinant IGF1 enhanced LUAD cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, whereas IGF1 knockdown in CAF-like cells attenuated these malignant phenotypes in co-culture models. In vivo, IGF1 knockdown in CAF-like cells reduced distant metastatic burden, accompanied by alterations in Wnt-related signaling, extracellular matrix organization, and metastasis-associated molecules. These findings indicate that CAF-derived IGF1 contributes to LUAD progression and bone metastatic remodeling through paracrine stromal-tumor communication, highlighting the IGF1/IGF1R axis as a potential stromal-directed therapeutic target in selected LUAD patients.

papers.title_zh: 美国COPD吸入维持治疗使用率与治疗模式的真实世界描述：仅约三分之一新发患者、约半数现患患者及不足六成高风险患者接受维持治疗
papers.title_en: Contemporary Inhaled Maintenance Therapy Patterns and Treatment Progression for Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) in the United States: Findings from the DUALITY Patient Journey Study.
papers.authors: Siddharthan T, Germack HD, DeMartino JK, Carstens DD, Baudy PS, Holder MC, Willshaw L, Spy A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Miller School of Medicine, University of Miami, 1600 NW 10th Avenue, Suite 1149, Miami, FL, 33136, USA.
papers.results: 新发/现患COPD患者平均随访分别为16.6和24.7个月；接受吸入维持治疗比例分别为33.0%和51.2%。最常见为双药治疗（20.2%、32.5%，以ICS/LABA为主），其次为三药治疗（12.5%、22.5%）和单药治疗（7.6%、12.0%）。高风险患者（基线≥1次重度或≥2次中度急性加重）中仅58.8%接受任何吸入维持治疗，其中双药37.0%、三药27.8%、单药13.2%。摘要未报告CI/P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: In this real-world study, there was unmet need across the COPD journey, evidenced by low uptake of inhaled maintenance therapy, including among those with a history of exacerbations. Maintenance therapy regimens were not fully aligned with Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Diseases recommended treatment, and persistence to triple therapy was limited. Further research is warranted to understand barriers to timely treatment initiation, optimize escalation and persistence, and identify patients with unmet need despite inhaled maintenance therapy.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告任何效应量的CI/P或统计学检验，各比例差异无法判断是否显著。方法学疑点：①纯描述性设计、无对照组，'未达指南推荐''存在未满足需求'属推断性表述，摘要未直接测量GOLD指南依从性或临床结局；②新发与现患患者随访时长不同（16.6 vs 24.7个月），两组治疗比例不可直接比较；③要求索引前≥12个月连续参保，可能产生保险稳定人群的选择偏倚；④治疗线次与加重识别依赖claims算法，缺乏临床严重度（如肺功能、症状评分）信息；⑤吸入治疗比例偏低亦可能部分源于算法识别或随访窗口（≥6个月）限制，不能完全等同于临床未治疗。该研究与胸外科/胸部肿瘤业务无直接关联。

pico.ic: 无干预对照；描述吸入维持治疗（LABA、LAMA、ICS单药/双药/三药）的使用与治疗线次模式

papers.reason: 为COPD维持治疗的真实世界使用基线提供大样本参照，可用于呼吸科门诊/围手术期合并COPD患者的用药现状评估与研究队列的外部对照；但不涉及肿瘤决策。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Inhaled maintenance therapy (long-acting β2-agonists [LABA], long-acting muscarinic antagonists [LAMA], and inhaled corticosteroids [ICS], used alone or in combination) is the cornerstone of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) management. This study described contemporary real-world COPD treatment patterns in the USA. METHODS: Retrospective data for patients aged ≥ 40 years with COPD were obtained from Komodo Research Data (01/01/2016-06/30/2024). The index date was January 1, 2022 for patients with a prior COPD diagnosis (i.e., prevalent patients) or the first observed COPD diagnosis for incident patients. Continuous health insurance enrollment was required for ≥ 12 months pre-index (i.e., baseline) and ≥ 6 months post-index, unless death occurred (i.e., follow-up). A claims-based algorithm identified lines of therapy for inhaled maintenance treatments. Treatment patterns were described during follow-up, overall and among subgroups of interest, including at-risk patients (i.e., ≥ 1 severe or ≥ 2 moderate exacerbations during baseline). RESULTS: A total of 1,421,278 patients with COPD were identified (incident 153,390; prevalent 1,267,888). Over a mean follow-up of 16.6 and 24.7 months, 33.0% and 51.2% of patients with incident or prevalent COPD, respectively, received inhaled maintenance therapy. Dual therapy was the most common treatment class (20.2%, 32.5%), driven by ICS/LABA use, followed by triple therapy (12.5%, 22.5%), and monotherapy (7.6%, 12.0%). Among at-risk patients, only 58.8% received any inhaled maintenance therapy (dual therapy 37.0%, triple therapy 27.8%, monotherapy 13.2%). CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world study, there was unmet need across the COPD journey, evidenced by low uptake of inhaled maintenance therapy, including among those with a history of exacerbations. Maintenance therapy regimens were not fully aligned with Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Diseases recommended treatment, and persistence to triple therapy was limited. Further research is warranted to understand barriers to timely treatment initiation, optimize escalation and persistence, and identify patients with unmet need despite inhaled maintenance therapy.

papers.authors: Ham S, Hwang I, Kim C, Hwang J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Healthcare Readiness Institute for Unified Korea, Korea University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
papers.results: 全数据基线：五个肺叶DSC 0.92-0.93，支气管0.82、肺血管0.67、肺结节0.78。主动学习+级联配置：肺叶DSC提升至0.94-0.96；支气管、肺血管、肺结节DSC分别提升至0.90、0.77、0.86（与基线相比均p<0.05）；肺血管HD95由5.4降至2.5 mm，肺结节HD95由4.8降至2.1 mm。

papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of thoracic structures on chest computed tomography (CT) is important for lung cancer surgery, but manual annotation is labor intensive and particularly challenging for small structures such as pulmonary vessels and nodules. We compared four nnU-Net v2-based segmentation configurations: single-stage full-data training, active learning alone, cascaded segmentation alone, and active learning combined with cascaded segmentation in a retrospective single-center cohort. This retrospective study included chest CT scans from 85 patients. In the cascaded configurations, pulmonary lobes were segmented in the first stage to provide global anatomical context, followed by refinement of the bronchus, pulmonary vessels, and nodules within the constrained region. All four configurations were evaluated using the same fixed patient-level internal test set of 30 patients, with segmentation performance assessed using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and the 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95). The full-data baseline achieved DSCs of 0.92-0.93 for the five pulmonary lobes, with lower performance for the bronchus (0.82), pulmonary vessels (0.67), and pulmonary nodules (0.78). The combined active learning and cascaded configuration improved lobar DSCs to 0.94-0.96. Compared with the baseline, DSC increased to 0.90, 0.77, and 0.86 for the bronchus, pulmonary vessels, and pulmonary nodules, respectively (all p < 0.05), while HD95 decreased from 5.4 to 2.5 mm for pulmonary vessels and from 4.8 to 2.1 mm for pulmonary nodules. In this single-center cohort, cascaded segmentation strategies showed improved internal test performance for small thoracic structures, supporting further evaluation in larger multicenter cohorts.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: While large language models (LLMs) show promise in general medicine, existing benchmarks lack the disease-specific rigor needed to assess guideline adherence. Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) care requires alignment with rapidly evolving National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Guidelines. We developed an NCCN-grounded benchmark to assess guideline concordance of seven selected LLMs in NSCLC management. METHODS: We developed an NCCN (Version 4.2025)-grounded NSCLC benchmark. The final analysis set contained 793 archived question-and-answer (Q&A) items. Each item included weighted positive criteria and safety-critical negative criteria. Seven specified LLMs were evaluated once per item, without a system prompt, retrieval augmentation, tools, or internet access. Automated rubric-based scores were used for descriptive comparison. RESULTS: Across seven specified LLMs on 793 NCCN Guidelines-based queries, Gemini-3-Pro achieved the highest clean normalized score (0.739), while DeepSeek-V3.2 was the highest-scoring open-source model (0.695). Scores were generally higher for foundational tasks and lower for clinical-trial interpretation and therapeutic modality selection, with interpretation of clinical trial results showing the lowest task-level performance. Gemini-3-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2 had the lowest omission rates (28.36% and 33.24%, respectively). Gemini-3-Pro had a 0% inclusion rate of rubric-defined contraindicated negative points in this benchmark. Automated scores are benchmark-specific and do not establish clinical safety or independently validated clinical quality. CONCLUSIONS: This NCCN-grounded benchmark compares seven specified LLMs using a fixed question set. Although leading models performed better on several foundational tasks, the results reflect guideline-rubric concordance rather than clinical correctness and do not show readiness for independent clinical decision-making.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Epidermal growth factor receptor exon 20 insertion mutations (EGFR ex20ins) define a rare, structurally heterogeneous subtype of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) that is relatively insensitive to conventional EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors. Although amivantamab, sunvozertinib, zipalertinib, furmonertinib, and other EGFR ex20ins-directed agents have expanded treatment options in advanced disease, their role in resectable NSCLC remains undefined. This narrative review summarizes the biological and clinical characteristics of EGFR ex20ins and critically evaluates advanced-stage evidence and emerging perioperative strategies. METHODS: PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Google Scholar, major preprint servers, oncology conference proceedings, trial registries, and regulatory sources were searched initially on June 3, 2026, with a targeted update on August 24, 2026. Peer-reviewed primary studies were prioritized; regulatory records, trial registries, conference abstracts, and preprints were included when they provided relevant emerging evidence. English- and Chinese-language publications were considered. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: EGFR ex20ins comprise heterogeneous insertion, duplication, and deletion-insertion variants with distinct conformational effects and drug sensitivity. Advanced-stage studies have established clinically relevant activity for EGFR/c-MET bispecific antibodies and novel EGFR ex20ins-directed tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs), including randomized phase III progression-free survival (PFS) benefits for selected regimens. Perioperative studies are evaluating sunvozertinib, zipalertinib, furmonertinib, and amivantamab; however, evidence remains limited to ongoing trials, case reports, small series, and immature conference data, without mature randomized event-free survival (EFS), disease-free survival (DFS), or overall survival (OS) results. CONCLUSIONS: Advanced-stage evidence supports perioperative investigation but cannot establish benefit in resectable disease. Progress requires accurate variant-level testing and randomized trials defining pathological response, surgical feasibility, toxicity, central nervous system (CNS) control, DFS, and OS.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pneumoconiosis is a major occupational lung disease with an insidious onset, making early diagnosis challenging. We aimed to develop and internally validate a chest computed tomography (CT)-based radiomics model for objective identification of pneumoconiosis and to support subjective visual diagnosis in dust-exposed individuals. METHODS: This retrospective study consecutively enrolled 474 patients with documented occupational dust exposure who underwent pneumoconiosis evaluation at The Third People's Hospital of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region between January 2020 and December 2024. Eligible participants had high-resolution chest CT images and no history of pulmonary surgery or trauma; those with coexisting respiratory disease, severe systemic dysfunction, or poor image quality were excluded. The reference standard was expert-panel consensus according to GBZ 70-2015 criteria. Lung parenchyma was semi-automatically segmented using a region-growing algorithm in three-dimensional (3D) Slicer, and radiomics features were extracted with the Deepwise Multimodal Research Platform. From 2,153 features, Pearson correlation filtering (r≥0.9 excluded) and analysis of variance (ANOVA) F-test (P<0.05) selected the 10 most discriminative features. Data were randomly divided into training and test sets. A logistic regression model was constructed and evaluated using area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, calibration, and decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: Of 474 patients, 293 had pneumoconiosis (all stage I) and 181 were dust-exposed controls. The model achieved AUCs of 0.804 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.754-0.853] in the training set (n=331) and 0.759 (95% CI: 0.680-0.838) in the test set (n=143). At the optimal threshold, sensitivity and specificity were 76.2% and 68.3% in the training set and 61.8% and 67.1% in the test set, respectively. Calibration curves showed good agreement between predicted and observed outcomes, and DCA confirmed net clinical benefit across a range of threshold probabilities. CONCLUSIONS: This CT-based whole-lung radiomics model, without manual lesion delineation, shows promise for early pneumoconiosis identification in dust-exposed populations, with favorable diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility. However, the findings are preliminary and require external validation in independent multicenter cohorts before clinical implementation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major public health problem in prisons, where overcrowding, delayed diagnosis, and limited continuity of care may increase disease burden and worsen outcomes. We aimed to estimate the registered TB burden, describe treatment outcomes, and identify factors associated with drug-resistant TB and unfavorable outcomes in prisons in Lima-Callao, Peru, during 2024. METHODS: We conducted a multicenter retrospective cohort study using routinely collected TB surveillance data from 12 prisons. All patients diagnosed with TB who initiated and/or received treatment during 2024 were included. The registered TB burden was estimated as the number of diagnosed and recorded TB cases per 1,000 inmates. Treatment outcome analyses were restricted to patients with recorded programmatic outcomes. Poisson regression with robust variance was used to estimate crude and adjusted relative risks (aRRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). RESULTS: Overall, 2,060 TB cases were recorded among 33,268 inmates, corresponding to a registered TB burden of 61.9 cases per 1,000 inmates, in the context of a mean overcrowding rate of 160.3%. The registered burden varied across facilities from 0.0 to 122.8 cases per 1,000 inmates, with the highest values observed in Huacho, Lurigancho, and Cañete. The median age was 31 years, and pulmonary TB accounted for 94.0% of cases. Drug-resistant TB was identified in 292 patients (14.2%). In adjusted analyses, drug-resistant TB was associated with younger age and a longer symptom-to-diagnosis interval (aRR per additional day: 1.007; 95% CI: 1.006-1.009). Among patients with documented treatment outcomes (n = 1,347), 1,231 (91.4%) were cured or completed treatment, whereas 116 (8.6%) experienced death, treatment failure, or loss to follow-up. TB/HIV coinfection was associated with unfavorable outcomes (aRR: 4.383; 95% CI: 2.406-7.985). CONCLUSIONS: Prisons in Lima-Callao had a high and heterogeneous registered TB burden. Strengthening systematic screening, timely molecular diagnosis, drug-resistance surveillance, treatment continuity, and structural interventions may reduce missed diagnoses and improve treatment outcomes.

papers.title_en: Global burden of respiratory infections and tuberculosis and risk factors, 1990-2021: a systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021.
papers.authors: Wang J, Duan J
papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Molecular Oncology, Beijing Key Laboratory, CAMS Key Laboratory of Translational Research on Lun…
papers.results: 2021年全球RIT导致1125万例死亡和3.4968亿DALYs，分别占全球总死亡的16.59%和总DALYs的12.15%；COVID-19成为RIT死亡的首要原因（789万例死亡），其次为下呼吸道感染。SDI与年龄标化DALYs、死亡和患病率呈强负相关，但与发病率无显著相关。1990–2021年环境和行为风险因素归因负担显著下降，而代谢风险上升，高SDI地区尤为明显。摘要未报告置信区间与P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: 尽管年龄标化率（ASRs）下降，由于人口转变和新冠疫情，RIT的全球绝对负担持续上升；持续的社会经济不平等呼吁采取综合策略，结合疫苗接种、结核病控制、风险因素减少和卫生系统强化，以改善呼吸健康公平性。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要全部关键估计值均未给出95%CI或不确定区间，GBD为模型推算的生态学数据，无法评估估计不确定性。SDI与疾病负担的负相关存在生态学谬误风险，不能推断个体层面因果。2021年数值被COVID-19（789万死亡）主导，以该年截面数据描述'趋势终点'可能夸大近期负担跳升，且COVID-19与传统RIT归并计算使跨年可比性存疑。未报告AAPC具体数值，'环境行为风险下降、代谢风险上升'的结论缺乏可核查的量化效应量。

pico.p: 1990–2021年204个国家/地区的呼吸道感染与结核病（RIT）人群，基于GBD 2021数据
pico.ic: 无干预对照；为描述性负担估算与风险因素归因分析（AAPC/joinpoint、SDI相关、比较风险评估CRA）

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis (RIT) remain major contributors to global morbidity and mortality, with pronounced geographic and socioeconomic disparities. The emergence of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) has further disrupted existing control efforts, highlighting the need to reassess temporal trends, socioeconomic disparities, and risk-factor changes. This study aimed to quantify temporal trends, characterize geographic and socioeconomic disparities, and assess changes in risk-factor-attributable burden of RIT from 1990 to 2021. METHODS: Using Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 data, we quantified incidence, prevalence, deaths, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) of RIT across 204 countries/regions from 1990 to 2021. Temporal trends were assessed using average annual percentage change (AAPC) and joinpoint regression. Associations with the Socio-demographic Index (SDI) were examined using Pearson correlation and generalized additive models (GAMs). Risk factor-attributable burdens were estimated using comparative risk assessment (CRA) methodology. RESULTS: In 2021, RIT caused 11.25 million deaths and 349.68 million DALYs worldwide, accounting for 16.59% of total deaths and 12.15% of total DALYs. COVID-19 became the leading cause of RIT mortality (7.89 million deaths), followed by lower RIT. We identified four distinct regional burden trajectories, which reflected differences in health-system capacity and pandemic impact. SDI showed strong negative associations with age-standardized DALYs, deaths, and prevalence, but showed no significant association with incidence. From 1990 to 2021, environmental and behavioral risk factor burdens declined substantially, whereas metabolic risks rose, particularly in high-SDI regions. CONCLUSIONS: Despite declining age-standardized rates (ASRs), the absolute global burden of RIT continues to rise due to demographic transitions and the COVID-19 pandemic. Persistent socioeconomic disparities call for integrated strategies that combine vaccination, tuberculosis control, risk-factor reduction, and health-system strengthening to improve respiratory health equity.

papers.title_zh: 肺移植围手术期维生素C轨迹与氧化应激状态：21例前瞻性观察未发现低维生素C组氧化损伤或早期结局更差
papers.title_en: Vitamin C status and oxidative profile in lung transplantation: a prospective observational study.
papers.authors: Gori F, Scaravilli V, Ferrari F, Carlesso E, Carlin A, Polledri E, Manesso L, Fumagalli J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Anesthesia, Critical Care and Emergency, Fondazione IRCCS Ca' Granda Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico, Milan,…
papers.results: 共入组21例受者，8例（38%）为HypoC。NormC组维生素C随时间下降（P<0.001），HypoC组持续低水平。THs与8-OHdG自ICU入院至术后第7天升高（均P<0.001），总抗氧化能力稳定但低于参考值。HypoC与NormC两组间氧化标志物、OSI及临床结局均无显著差异。
papers.authors_conclusion: VitC levels fall markedly after LuTx, particularly in patients with initially adequate concentrations, but this decline does not appear to increase oxidative injury or worsen early postoperative outcomes. Larger studies are needed to identify whether specific subgroups may benefit from targeted VitC supplementation.
papers.ai_note: 样本量仅21例，对临床结局差异的检验效能极低，'无显著差异'更接近无结论而非证伪，作者结论中'不增加氧化损伤'的表述存在II类错误风险；未说明28 µmol/L截点的依据；仅按单一术前水平分组、未校正混杂；总抗氧化能力持续低于参考值却报告'稳定'，与临床意义的关系未讨论；作者建议的'特定亚组可能受益于补充'在本研究中无任何补充干预数据支持，属外推。

pico.p: 肺移植受者21例，其中术前维生素C缺乏（HypoC，<28 µmol/L）8例（38%）
pico.ic: 按术前维生素C水平分组（HypoC <28 µmol/L vs NormC ≥28 µmol/L）比较各时点氧化标志物与早期临床结局；非干预性观察，无补充治疗

papers.reason: 为肺移植围手术期是否需要常规维生素C补充这一临床问题提供初步（虽效能不足）的阴性证据，提示术前低VitC水平并非氧化损伤或早期结局的决定因素，可作为后续更大规模干预研究的基线参考。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Vitamin C (VitC) is a key circulating antioxidant, yet its perioperative kinetics and relationship with oxidative stress in lung transplantation (LuTx) remain undefined. This study aimed to describe perioperative trajectories of VitC and oxidative status markers in LuTx recipients, and to explore whether pre-transplant VitC status is associated with postoperative oxidative stress or early clinical outcomes. METHODS: Serum was collected at anesthesia induction for LuTx (pre-LuTx), at intensive care unit (ICU) admission, 72 hours after LuTx (72 h post-LuTx), and LuTx on postoperative day 7 (7 d post-LuTx). VitC, total antioxidant capacity, total hydroperoxides (THs), 8-hydroxy-2'-deoxyguanosine (8-OHdG), and the Oxidative Stress Index (OSI) were quantified. Patients were classified based on pre-LuTx VitC levels: HypoC: <28 µmol/L and NormC: ≥28 µmol/L. RESULTS: Twenty-one recipients were enrolled, with 8 (38%) HypoC. VitC declined over time (P<0.001) in the NormC group, while HypoC had persistently low VitC. THs and 8-OHdG increased from ICU admission to postoperative day 7 (both P<0.001), while total antioxidant capacity remained stable and below reference values. No significant differences in oxidative markers, OSI, or clinical outcomes emerged between HypoC and NormC. CONCLUSIONS: VitC levels fall markedly after LuTx, particularly in patients with initially adequate concentrations, but this decline does not appear to increase oxidative injury or worsen early postoperative outcomes. Larger studies are needed to identify whether specific subgroups may benefit from targeted VitC supplementation.

papers.title_zh: Nuss术后90天内多维患者报告恢复与早期疼痛轨迹：疼痛下降快于功能受限的回顾性描述
papers.title_en: Multidimensional patient-reported recovery and early pain trajectories within 90 days after the Nuss procedure: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.authors: Liu C, Xu D, Chen Z, Wu J, Li S, Chen C, He Z, Qiao G et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Zhujiang Hospital, Southern Medical University, Guangzhou, China.
papers.results: 疼痛中位数从术后1-7天的5.50 (IQR 4.25-6.50)降至15-30天的2.33 (IQR 1.00-4.00)；功能受限同期为4.82 (IQR 3.86-5.94)与3.00 (IQR 1.71-4.70)。术后15-30天，11/88例 (12.5%) 在探索性、基于分布的阈值下疼痛较低但功能受限持续。探索性两类别模型分出改善类79/89例与持续高疼痛类10/89例。在有轨迹及后续结局数据的79例中，31-90天残留疼痛见于持续高疼痛类6/9例、改善类11/70例。内部一致性：症状域各时间窗0.900-0.950，功能域0.737-0.909。摘要未报告任何P值或95%CI。
papers.authors_conclusion: Nuss术后前90天的恢复是多维的，功能受限与对金属条的感知改善慢于疼痛；探索性轨迹结果亦提示早期恢复存在异质性；多维随访可能提供更完整的恢复视图，并需要采用标准化镇痛、神经病理性疼痛测量和更长随访的前瞻性研究。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：全文未提供P值或95%CI，6/9 vs 11/70等关键轨迹-结局关联无统计学检验，无法判断是否超出随机波动。轨迹类别与'疼痛较低但功能受限持续'的阈值均为事后/基于分布的探索性定义，存在数据驱动分组偏倚。主要发现为描述性，却支撑'多维随访更完整'的实践倡导，属结论超出证据强度。样本为单中心93例、且各类别子集更小，外推性有限；镇痛方案未标准化，疼痛与功能轨迹的混杂未控制。

pico.p: Nuss手术患者93例（单中心回顾性，至少3次有效评估；各时间窗子集为88、89、79例），共1,729份评估记录
pico.ic: 无干预，观察性描述；按术后5个时间窗汇总多维症状与功能评分，并探索性拟合两类别疼痛轨迹模型

papers.reason: 为胸壁畸形（Nuss手术）术后随访提供疼痛与功能恢复不同步的量化基线，提示术后随访不应仅以疼痛强度判断恢复；同时其探索性轨迹方法可作为本专业PRO队列设计与结局指标选择的参考。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Postoperative assessment after the Nuss procedure often emphasizes pain intensity, although recovery also includes functional and procedure-specific symptoms. We characterized multidimensional patient-reported recovery during the first 90 postoperative days. METHODS: This retrospective single-center cohort included 93 patients with at least three valid assessments on a 10-item Nuss-specific symptom and function scale. Records were summarized in five postoperative windows. Longitudinal domain patterns, pain-function discordance, and exploratory early pain trajectories were described. Internal consistency of the scale and the perioperative anesthesia and analgesia context were additionally evaluated. RESULTS: The cohort contributed 1,729 records. Pain declined from a median of 5.50 [interquartile range (IQR), 4.25-6.50] during days 1-7 to 2.33 (IQR, 1.00-4.00) during days 15-30, whereas functional limitation was 4.82 (IQR, 3.86-5.94) and 3.00 (IQR, 1.71-4.70), respectively. During days 15-30, 11/88 patients (12.5%) had relatively low pain but persistent functional limitation under exploratory, distribution-informed thresholds. An exploratory two-class model yielded an improving class (79/89) and a persistent-high-pain class (10/89). Among 79 patients with trajectory and later outcome data, residual pain during days 31-90 occurred in 6/9 patients in the persistent-high-pain class and 11/70 in the improving class. Internal-consistency coefficients across windows ranged from 0.900 to 0.950 for the symptom domain and from 0.737 to 0.909 for the function domain. CONCLUSIONS: Recovery during the first 90 days after the Nuss procedure was multidimensional, with functional limitation and bar awareness improving more slowly than pain. Exploratory trajectory findings also indicated heterogeneity in early recovery. Multidomain follow-up may provide a more complete view of recovery, and prospective studies with standardized analgesia, neuropathic-pain measures, and longer follow-up are warranted.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is molecularly heterogeneous, and computationally nominated biomarkers often lack sufficient functional validation. CALB1 is a calcium-binding protein, but its clinical relevance, cellular source, and signaling role in NSCLC remain unclear. This study aimed to identify subtype-associated regulators in NSCLC through a machine-learning-assisted multi-omics framework and to characterize the functional and signaling relevance of CALB1 in malignant progression. METHODS: NSCLC transcriptomic cohorts were used to define metabolic-epigenetic remodeling (MER) subtypes. Machine-learning-assisted Cox modeling was then applied to identify subtype-associated prognostic regulators. CALB1 was selected for further validation using public cohorts, in-house NSCLC specimens, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR), western blotting, immunohistochemistry, single-cell RNA sequencing, proteomic and phosphoproteomic profiling, and functional assays. CALB1 was silenced in A549 and PC9 cells to assess its effects on PI3K/AKT activation, proliferation, migration, invasion, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-associated phenotypes. Alpelisib was used as a PI3Kα inhibitor to examine the pathway-level involvement of PI3K/AKT signaling in CALB1-associated phenotypes. In vivo relevance and alpelisib responsiveness were further evaluated using a four-group subcutaneous A549 xenograft model comprising sh-Control + vehicle, sh-CALB1 + vehicle, sh-Control + alpelisib, and sh-CALB1 + alpelisib groups. RESULTS: Three MER subtypes were identified, with MER2 showing the poorest prognosis and distinct immune-metabolic features. CALB1 was retained in the prognostic model and positively correlated with model-derived risk scores. CALB1 was upregulated in NSCLC tissues, associated with advanced clinicopathological features and unfavorable prognosis, and mainly enriched in malignant epithelial cells. CALB1-high tumors showed enrichment of proliferative, metabolic, DNA repair, and PI3K/AKT-related programs. CALB1 knockdown induced coordinated proteomic and phosphoproteomic changes involving proliferation, migration, extracellular matrix organization, secretory trafficking, and PI3K/AKT signaling. Functionally, CALB1 silencing reduced p-PI3K and p-AKT levels and suppressed proliferation, migration, invasion, and EMT-associated phenotypes. PI3Kα inhibition with alpelisib attenuated CALB1 overexpression-associated malignant phenotypes in vitro. In vivo, stable CALB1 knockdown suppressed xenograft growth and enhanced the antitumor response to alpelisib, with the sh-CALB1 + alpelisib group showing the greatest reductions in tumor volume and tumor weight. CONCLUSIONS: This study identifies CALB1 as a subtype-associated regulator in NSCLC through a machine-learning-assisted multi-omics framework. CALB1 may promote malignant progression partly through PI3K/AKT-related signaling. Stable CALB1 knockdown increased the in vivo antitumor response to alpelisib, supporting CALB1 as a potential modulator of PI3Kα inhibitor sensitivity.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pathological high-risk features in early-stage lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) are associated with prognosis, but whether the number of coexisting features is associated with progressively worse prognosis remains uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic impact of pathological high-risk feature count in patients with stage I invasive LUAD (≤3 cm). METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients with stage I invasive LUAD (≤3 cm) who underwent complete resection between January 2018 and April 2025. Patients were stratified by the number of pathological high-risk features [lymphovascular invasion‌, visceral pleural invasion, spread through air spaces, high-grade histologic patterns (micropapillary, solid, and complex glandular patterns), and poor differentiation]. Relapse-free survival (RFS) and overall survival (OS) were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared using the log-rank test. Multivariable Cox regression analysis was used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). RESULTS: Among 4,030 patients, 2,791, 690, 296, and 253 had 0, 1, 2, and ≥3 pathological high-risk features, respectively. The median follow-up duration was 38 months for RFS and 39 months for OS. In the primary analysis, RFS was significantly worse for 1 versus 0 feature (log-rank P<0.001; HR =2.871; 95% CI: 1.720-4.794) and for ≥3 versus 2 features (log-rank P<0.001; HR =2.997; 95% CI: 1.655-5.429), but not for 2 versus 1 feature (log-rank P=0.37; HR =1.264; 95% CI: 0.674-2.370). For OS, the difference between the 1-feature and 0-feature groups remained significant (log-rank P=0.002; HR =2.309; 95% CI: 1.190-4.480), whereas the comparisons of 2 versus 1 feature (log-rank P=0.06; HR =1.885; 95% CI: 0.883-4.023) and ≥3 versus 2 features (log-rank P=0.15; HR =1.542; 95% CI: 0.756-3.144) were not significant. In the sensitivity analysis combining high-grade histologic patterns and poor differentiation, RFS was significantly worse across all adjacent groups: 1 versus 0 feature (log-rank P<0.001; HR =2.908; 95% CI: 1.769-4.781), 2 versus 1 feature (log-rank P=0.003; HR =1.985; 95% CI: 1.200-3.285), and ≥3 versus 2 features (log-rank P<0.001; HR =2.438; 95% CI: 1.404-4.234). For OS, significant differences were observed for 1 versus 0 feature (log-rank P<0.001; HR =2.548; 95% CI: 1.363-4.762) and 2 versus 1 feature (log-rank P=0.03; HR =1.950; 95% CI: 1.018-3.738), but not for ≥3 versus 2 features (log-rank P=0.09; HR =1.499; 95% CI: 0.716-3.137). CONCLUSIONS: A higher pathological high-risk feature count was associated with progressively worse prognosis in patients with stage I invasive LUAD (≤3 cm).

papers.title_en: Clinical outcomes with initial oral triple and dual therapy in echocardiography-defined connective tissue disease-associated pulmonary hypertension: a retrospective single-center cohort study.
papers.authors: Shen X, Chen Q, Ren M, Wang L, Wu J, Cao J, Yin Y, Ren T et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, Suzhou, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: In this real-world cohort of patients with echocardiography-defined CTD-PH, initial selexipag-containing oral triple therapy was associated with greater improvement in noninvasive ESC/ERS risk status and functional outcomes than dual therapy over 26 weeks, supporting further evaluation of noninvasive risk-guided oral treatment intensification in CTD-associated pulmonary vascular disease. However, given the small, single-center, nonrandomized retrospective design, these findings cannot establish superior efficacy or safety and require prospective multicenter confirmation with systematic hemodynamic assessment.
papers.ai_note: 选择性强调：探索性疾病进展终点 HR 0.75（95%CI 0.39-1.43）不显著，摘要以主要终点（非侵入性风险标准计数）与6MWD等替代/功能指标阳性为主导叙述；主要终点仅报告P=0.003与达标比例，未给出变化量的组间效应值及CI，效应量信息不足。方法学局限：治疗由医师常规选择存在适应证混杂，基线可比性仅限所列少数变量；超声心动图定义PH、摘要未提及右心导管血流动力学确认，存在误分类风险；完整病例分析且无插补，可能引入选择偏倚。安全性方面三联组不良事件率数值更高（89.8% vs 78.3%）但称无显著差异，样本量不足以检出差异。

pico.p: 2020年4月至2025年6月单中心连续入组、启动肺动脉高压靶向治疗的成人CTD-PH患者119例（三联59例，双联60例）；年龄45.5 vs 47.2岁，女性93% vs 83%；基线6MWD 290.0 vs 286.9 m，NT-proBNP 1,455 vs 1,473 pg/mL
pico.ic: 初始含selexipag的口服三联治疗（selexipag+马昔腾坦+他达拉非） vs 双联治疗（马昔腾坦+他达拉非）；由主治医师在常规诊疗中选择，非随机

papers.reason: 为CTD-PH患者初始口服治疗是否强化（加用selexipag）提供初步真实世界证据，同时暴露该领域以非侵入性风险替代终点为主、缺乏血流动力学确认的方法学问题，可作为后续前瞻性研究设计与终点选择的参照。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Connective tissue disease-associated pulmonary hypertension (CTD-PH) is a serious complication, but evidence on early oral treatment intensification in patients followed primarily by echocardiography is limited. We evaluated outcomes associated with initial selexipag-containing oral triple therapy vs. dual therapy in echocardiography-defined CTD-PH. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort included consecutive adults who initiated PH-targeted therapy between April 2020 and June 2025. Treatment was selected by treating physicians in routine care and was not randomized: dual therapy comprised macitentan plus tadalafil, whereas triple therapy additionally included selexipag. Baseline clinical, laboratory, and echocardiographic variables were obtained from standardized institutional assessments and reassessed at week 26. The primary endpoint was the change in the number (0-3) of European Society of Cardiology/European Respiratory Society (ESC/ERS) noninvasive low-risk criteria met: World Health Organization functional class (WHO-FC) I-II, 6-minute walk distance (6MWD) >440 m, and B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) <50 ng/L or N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) <300 ng/L. Complete cases with all three components available at both time points were analyzed without imputation. Disease-progression events were recorded through 30 weeks, and adverse events were assessed during follow-up. RESULTS: Of 119 patients, 59 received triple therapy and 60 received dual therapy. The groups had similar baseline functional and biomarker profiles (6MWD, 290.0 vs. 286.9 m; NT-proBNP, 1,455 vs. 1,473 pg/mL); mean age was 45.5 vs. 47.2 years in the triple and dual therapy group respectively, and 93% vs. 83% were women. At week 26, the change in low-risk criteria differed between groups (P=0.003), with 57.6% vs. 33.3% meeting all the three criteria. Mean 6MWD increased by 156 vs. 104 m (adjusted difference, 52 m; 95% confidence interval (CI): 29-78; P<0.001), and WHO-FC distributions differed at week 26 (P=0.007). Exploratory analysis yielded an hazard ratio (HR) of 0.75 (95% CI: 0.39-1.43) for the first disease-progression event. At least one adverse event occurred in 53/59 (89.8%) vs. 47/60 (78.3%) patients; diarrhea occurred in 24/59 (40.7%) vs. 19/60 (31.7%), nausea in 21/59 (35.6%) vs. 16/60 (26.7%), and jaw pain in 16/59 (27.1%) vs. 11/60 (18.3%), with no significant between-group differences. CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world cohort of patients with echocardiography-defined CTD-PH, initial selexipag-containing oral triple therapy was associated with greater improvement in noninvasive ESC/ERS risk status and functional outcomes than dual therapy over 26 weeks, supporting further evaluation of noninvasive risk-guided oral treatment intensification in CTD-associated pulmonary vascular disease. However, given the small, single-center, nonrandomized retrospective design, these findings cannot establish superior efficacy or safety and require prospective multicenter confirmation with systematic hemodynamic assessment.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Castleman disease (CD) is a rare lymphoproliferative disorder, and unicentric mediastinal CD (UMCD) represents an uncommon thoracic manifestation for which surgical resection remains the mainstay of treatment.This study aims to: (I) characterize the anatomical distribution of UMCD in a single-center cohort; (II) evaluate the efficacy of video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) for UMCD resection and identify preoperative predictors of thoracotomy; (III) analyze prognostic outcomes in surgically managed UMCD patients. METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 49 consecutive UMCD patients (26 males, 23 females; mean age 37.27±15.27 years) undergoing surgical resection at the department of thoracic surgery (Tangdu Hospital, Fourth Military Medical University) between May 2014 and October 2024. Demographic characteristics, anatomical distributions, and perioperative outcomes were systematically analyzed. Comparative analysis between VATS and thoracotomy groups was performed using independent samples t-tests. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression identified predictors of thoracotomy, with diagnostic performance evaluated via receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Survival outcomes were assessed using Kaplan-Meier methodology. RESULTS: The most frequent anatomical involvement occurred in station 3A lymph nodes (12 cases, 24.5%), followed by station 10 (11 cases, 22.3%) and station 4 (8 cases, 16.3%). Mean tumor size was 6.25±3.09 cm (intraoperative measurement). Histopathological subtypes included hyaline vascular variant (43 cases, 87.7%), plasma cell variant (4 cases, 8.2%), and mixed-type (2 cases, 4.1%). Compared to thoracotomy, VATS demonstrated shorter operative duration (P<0.05), reduced intraoperative blood loss (P<0.05), and shorter postoperative chest tube retention (3±2.81 vs. 5.52±3.54 days, P<0.05). Multivariate analysis identified tumor diameter >6.6 cm (P<0.05) and arterial-phase contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) attenuation >102 Hounsfield units (HU) (P<0.05) as independent predictors of thoracotomy. ROC analysis revealed an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.875 for the combined diagnostic model. With a median follow-up duration of 52 months, the VATS group maintained 100% recurrence-free survival. In the thoracotomy group, three patients succumbed to disease (two from local recurrence refractory to conservative therapy, one from postoperative pneumonia with respiratory failure following pneumonectomy). The overall survival (OS) rate for the cohort was 91.83%. CONCLUSIONS: Station 3A lymph nodes represent the predominant anatomical site of UMCD involvement. VATS resection confers significant advantages over thoracotomy, including reduced operative time, blood loss, and postoperative recovery duration. The diameter >6.6 cm and arterial-phase CT attenuation >102 HU of tumors serve as reliable preoperative indicators for thoracotomy. Early surgical intervention correlates with favorable prognosis, while postoperative complications and local recurrence demonstrate significant association with mortality.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Despite substantial advances in therapeutic strategies, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) remains the leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. The poor prognosis of NSCLC is largely due to the limited efficacy of existing clinical treatments and the lack of reliable and effective molecular therapeutic targets. Studies have shown that small nucleolar RNAs (snoRNAs) play pivotal regulatory roles in multiple pathological processes involved in tumor formation and malignant progression. However, the specific biological functions and underlying molecular mechanisms of individual snoRNAs in the occurrence and development of NSCLC remain largely unclear, highlighting the need for systematic exploration. METHODS: A reanalysis of genome-scale clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)-Cas9 knockout screening data covering all annotated snoRNAs in NSCLC cell lines was performed. Colony formation assays confirmed the functional role of SNORD42A in NSCLC cells. A combined bioinformatic analysis of our internal sequencing data and public datasets further identified the molecular locus of SNORD42A in the pathogenesis of NSCLC. RESULTS: Genome-wide screening identified SNORD42A as a key candidate snoRNA regulating NSCLC cell proliferation. Both the in-house snoRNA sequencing data and bioinformatics analysis of The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) cohort demonstrated that SNORD42A was significantly overexpressed in clinical NSCLC tissues compared with paired adjacent normal lung tissues, indicating its potential oncogenic role in NSCLC. Functional validation experiments further demonstrated that SNORD42A knockdown markedly inhibited the clonogenic capacity of NSCLC cells. Moreover, an integrative bioinformatics analysis of TCGA data revealed that SNORD42A expression was closely correlated with cell cycle regulation and cellular senescence signaling pathways, and its expression level was significantly associated with the clinical prognosis of patients with NSCLC. CONCLUSIONS: SNORD42A functions as a pro-tumorigenic factor that promotes NSCLC progression, with its effects potentially linked to alterations in cellular protein synthesis. This study revealed the functional importance of SNORD42A in NSCLC malignancy, suggesting that SNORD42A may serve as a novel prognostic biomarker and a promising therapeutic target for the treatment of NSCLC.

papers.results: 气管切开相关出血总体发生率0.6-5.0%；大或 minor 出血发生率达5.7%；ECMO等高危人群发生率最高达40%。皮下气肿主要与早期机械性并发症相关，局灶性气道狭窄为肉芽组织增生的后期后果；轻微浅表出血的处理以直接压迫、填塞、纠正可逆性凝血病及选择性局部/电凝干预为主；TIF与其他并发症性质不同，即使少量或一过性出血也可能先于灾难性大出血。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Tracheostomy is one of the most commonly performed procedures in critically ill patients, with bleeding representing the most frequent early complication. Stomal bleeding and granulation tissue formation create ongoing management challenges that can complicate patient care. Other complications include stomal infection, subcutaneous emphysema, focal airway stenosis, and tracheoinnominate fistula (TIF), which differ in clinical severity and management. Current management relies on reactive measures, yet no standardized approach exists for preventing or managing persistent minor bleeding around the tracheostomy site. This study aims to review the incidence, pathophysiology, risk factors, and current management of tracheostomy-related bleeding and stomal complications, with emphasis on identifying gaps in prevention and treatment strategies. METHODS: We conducted targeted literature searches using PubMed/MEDLINE for English-language human studies published between January 1, 2000 and September 17, 2026 involving adults aged 19 years or older. Search terms included "tracheostomy", "tracheotomy", "bleeding", "hemorrhage", "granulation tissue", "tracheoinnominate fistula", "stomal infection", "cellulitis", "abscess", "decannulation", "dislodgement", "subcutaneous emphysema", "tracheal stenosis", "ECMO", "transplantation", "immunosuppression", "tranexamic acid", "epinephrine", and "cautery". We extracted data on incidence rates, management approaches, and clinical outcomes. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: Bleeding is the most common early complication of tracheostomy procedures, occurring in 0.6-5.0% of cases overall, with rates reaching 5.7% for major or minor bleeding and up to 40% in high-risk populations such as patients on extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO). Stomal infections, airway complications, and early accidental decannulation is also important to consider in tracheostomy patients. Subcutaneous emphysema was primarily associated with early mechanical complications, whereas focal airway stenosis represented a later consequence of granulation. Management of minor superficial bleeding generally consisted of direct pressure, packing, correction of reversible coagulopathy, and selected topical or cautery-based interventions. TIF remained distinct from these complications because even limited or transient bleeding may precede catastrophic hemorrhage, necessitating urgent recognition and escalation when a vascular source is suspected. CONCLUSIONS: Tracheostomy-related bleeding and stomal oozing represent common complications with limited preventive options. Current management is reactive, relying on manual pressure application, packing materials, and procedural interventions. Particular attention should be made to distinguish minor superficial bleeding from sentinel or life-threatening hemorrhage. Novel approaches could potentially reduce bleeding complications, minimize granulation tissue formation, and improve patient comfort during the critical early post-tracheostomy period.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Pneumonectomy operations have been performed for around 100 years with post-pneumonectomy empyema (PPE) as a feared complication. Unlike an isolated empyema, these cases are most often associated with a bronchopleural fistula (BPF) that causes ongoing contamination of the surgical space and contralateral lung with subsequent respiratory failure and severe sepsis. The objective of this narrative review is to outline the wide range of treatment options that range from conservative management to more extensive surgical procedures, while also proposing a treatment algorithm. METHODS: Two reviewers (A.P.K. and A.A.) queried PubMed, MEDLINE, and the Cochrane Library since inception for meta-analyses, retrospective, cohort studies, case series, and case reports. Disagreements between the two reviewers were resolved through discussion and consensus. Exclusion criteria included non-English articles. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: First reports of BPF were managed with open window thoracostomy (OWT), which eventually evolved into the two-stage "Modified Clagett Procedure". Alternative surgical approaches described included trans-sternal and contralateral intra-thoracic approach for left-sided fistulas with short stumps to avoid repair in an infected field. More recently, endoscopic approaches have been described with variable success rates but are worth exploring for small fistulas to avoid the morbid surgical approach and poor surgical candidates as a salvage technique. CONCLUSIONS: Although there is limited data given the scarcity of this disease, current evidence shows that PPE with associated BPF located in a small (<6-8 mm) healthy stump can be successfully managed endoscopically, whereas surgical approach may be the better strategy for larger fistulas. Further evaluation of specific endoscopic techniques is necessary to further refine the treatment algorithm.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Esophageal cancer remains a major global health burden, but comparative analyses across leading economies are limited. This study aimed to comprehensively evaluate and compare the esophageal cancer burden from 1990 to 2023 and project trends to 2050 in the top five gross domestic product (GDP) countries-China, Germany, India, Japan, and the United States-using data from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 study. METHODS: We extracted age-, sex-, and risk factor-specific data on esophageal cancer incidence, mortality, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) for the five countries from the GBD 2023 database. Age-standardized rates (ASRs) were calculated, and temporal trends were assessed using Joinpoint regression. Age-period-cohort (APC) modeling was employed to disentangle the independent effects of age, period, and cohort. Decomposition analysis quantified the contributions of population aging, population growth, and epidemiological changes. Bayesian age-period-cohort (BAPC) models were applied to project disease burden through 2050. RESULTS: China had the highest absolute burden but achieved the steepest declines. India's age-standardized incidence rates (ASIRs) more than doubled. Japan, Germany, and the USA maintained lower, stable rates. APC analysis showed an "inverted-U" age peak in China versus older peaks elsewhere. Decomposition identified epidemiological changes as the main alleviating factor in China, whereas aging and unfavorable trends drove India's rise. Smoking dominated in four countries; India was co-driven by chewing tobacco and low vegetable intake. BAPC projections foresee continued declines in China, Germany, and Japan, a surge in India, and a rebound in the USA. CONCLUSIONS: The esophageal cancer burden exhibits marked heterogeneity across the top five GDP countries, driven by distinct demographic transitions, risk factor profiles, and public health responses. These findings emphasize the urgent need for tailored, context-specific cancer control strategies, including strengthened tobacco and alcohol regulation, dietary improvements, and expanded screening in high-risk populations.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: COPD is associated with significant lower limb muscle weakness, a predictor of mortality. Pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) incorporating resistance exercises is a key intervention to counteract this impairment. However, 50% of patients fail to improve muscle strength, classifying them as non-responders (NR). To understand this variability, this study aimed to assess all components of the muscle strength production chain before and after PR, and to identify predictors of non-response. METHODS: 33 COPD patients completed a 4-week inpatient PR program including standardized strength training following ACSM international guidelines. Quadriceps maximal voluntary isometric contraction (QMVIC), rate of force development (RFD), voluntary activation (VAcortical), corticospinal excitability (MEP/Mmax), and contractile properties were assessed before and after PR. Patients with a QMVIC increase < 7.5N·m were classified as NR. Logistic regression analysis was used to identify predictors of non-response. RESULTS: On average, QMVIC improved (+5.4 N·m; p=0.02), but 60.6% of patients were NR (despite comparable training metrics). Baseline VA was similar between groups. Responders showed a significant increase in VAcortical (p=0.03), while NR exhibited no changes (p=0.78). Corticospinal excitability and peripheral muscle adaptations improved similarly in both groups. RFD was lower in NR both pre and post PR (p<0.01), and was identified as a key predictor of non-response (sensibility: 95%; specificity: 90%). CONCLUSION: Both groups displayed comparable improvements in corticospinal excitability and peripheral muscle properties; however, only responders showed a significant increase in voluntary activation. Identifying RFD as a predictor of non-response provides a valuable tool for early patient stratification and personalized training strategies.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Thymic epithelial neoplasms are rare tumors of the anterior (prevascular) mediastinum, and complete surgical resection is the cornerstone of treatment. Over the past decade, minimally invasive techniques (video-assisted and robot-assisted thoracoscopic surgery, VATS/RATS) have progressively replaced sternotomy for selected thymic tumors while preserving oncological principles. However, most published series originate from high-income centers in North America, Europe, and Asia, and contemporary data from Latin American public referral hospitals remain scarce. We report the surgical management and immediate perioperative safety of thymic neoplasms at a high-volume Brazilian cancer center. METHODS: Retrospective analysis of a prospectively maintained institutional REDCap database at a single tertiary cancer center. Consecutive patients operated on between April 2020 and May 2026 for a clinical and radiological diagnosis of thymic neoplasm were included. Recorded variables comprised demographics, tumor location, preoperative biopsy, surgical approach and conversion, operative time, transfusion, intraoperative complications, postoperative destination, and confirmed pathology. Minimally invasive surgery was defined as a VATS or RATS approach without conversion to open surgery. Data were summarized with descriptive statistics; continuous variables are reported as medians (IQR). RESULTS: Sixty-three patients were included; 40 (65%) were women, with a median age of 66 years (IQR 53 to 73). The lesion was located in the anterior mediastinum in 59 patients (94%), and preoperative biopsy was performed in 26. All procedures were elective. A minimally invasive approach was used in 47 patients (81%; VATS 40, RATS 7), and 11 through an open approach (thoracotomy 7, sternotomy 3, clamshell 1), with one conversion to thoracotomy. Median operative time was 180 minutes. Immediate perioperative safety was favorable, with no transfusions, a single intraoperative complication, and postoperative ward destination in 37 patients versus intensive care in 25. When histologically confirmed, thymoma was the predominant diagnosis, followed by benign lesions and secondary tumors. CONCLUSIONS: In this Latin American public cancer center, thymic neoplasms were managed predominantly by minimally invasive surgery (81%), with a low conversion rate and favorable perioperative safety, adding evidence for this approach from an underrepresented region.

papers.abstract_en: Esophageal squamous papilloma (ESP) is an uncommon epithelial lesion encountered incidentally during upper gastrointestinal endoscopy. For the endoscopist standing at the trolley, two practical questions follow detection: what should I do with this lesion now, and what should I do with this patient afterwards? The published answers are inconsistent. Series range from reports of benign behavior to case descriptions of malignant transformation, and the lack of a clear clinical pathway leaves trainees and experienced endoscopists alike uncertain whether to biopsy, excise, follow-up, or simply reassure. Drawing on a single-center review of 107 adults with histologically confirmed ESP identified through linked endoscopy and histopathology records spanning October 2007 to December 2025, we offer a practical commentary on the lesion as it presents in real clinical practice. No patient had dysplasia at the index endoscopy, one had a synchronous squamous cell carcinoma, and no metachronous dysplasia or carcinoma was identified during available follow-up. We use this experience to discuss how ESP can be approached pragmatically: when to biopsy versus excise, when to consider follow-up endoscopy, when to look for coexistent disease, how diffuse papillomatosis should be distinguished from a solitary lesion, what our data can and cannot say about human papillomavirus involvement, and how to communicate the diagnosis to patients without alarming them. Our central lesson is that an isolated, non-dysplastic squamous papilloma is, in most cases, a clinically minor finding, but it demands disciplined assessment of the wider mucosa and patient-level risk factors before being dismissed-a conclusion that is limited by a low follow-up rate in our cohort and should be read accordingly. We propose a simple, risk-based clinical framework, illustrated with representative endoscopic and histological images, intended for early-career endoscopists and the wider esophageal community.

papers.authors: Liu Y, Fan R
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary Medicine, Xiangyang Hospital affiliated to Hubei University of Chinese Medicine, Xiangyang, Hube…
papers.results: CA4按SHAP重要性排名第1（0.120），诊断效能AUC = 0.879；Ridge模型在训练与验证队列AUC = 0.930、0.897和0.864；分子对接Vina结合能-7.078 kcal/mol，MM-PBSA ΔGbind -76.5 kJ/mol；SPR检测MTX与重组CA4呈浓度依赖性结合KD = 6.25 μM；MTX处理小鼠中CA4下调，TLR4、胶原沉积及血清TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IFN-α、IFN-β升高；BEAS-2B中CA4过表达抑制迁移、侵袭与增殖，逆转MTX诱导的TLR4、NF-κB、IRF3、VIM、FN1、COL1A1上调并恢复E-cadherin；强制过表达TLR4逆转CA4的保护效应。摘要未报告任何P值、置信区间或终点的显著性检验数据
papers.authors_conclusion: In MTX-PF, MTX directly binds CA4 in vitro. CA4 loss accompanies coordinate upregulation of the TLR4-NF-κB/IRF3 axis and an EMT program coupling epithelial injury to fibrogenesis, and CA4 restoration reverses this program in epithelial cells. Although TLR4 gain-of-function abrogated CA4-mediated suppression, its causal necessity remains untested. Given that TLR4 signaling is context-dependent and can facilitate inflammation resolution in some fibrosis models, therapeutic blockade requires careful attention to cell type and timing. CA4 thus represents a candidate molecular correlate and experimental target, pending clinical and in vivo validation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Methotrexate (MTX)-induced pulmonary fibrosis (MTX-PF) is the most severe and frequently irreversible manifestation of MTX pulmonary toxicity, yet the molecular target and signaling circuitry linking drug exposure to fibrosis remain undefined, hampering diagnosis and targeted intervention. METHODS: We integrated network toxicology, an ensemble of 112 machine-learning classifiers and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) with six GEO cohorts to nominate fibrotic-lung genes, which were intersected with predicted MTX targets to prioritize candidates relevant to MTX-PF. Lead candidates were validated by molecular docking, 100-ns molecular dynamics simulation, MM-PBSA binding free energy calculation and surface plasmon resonance (SPR). In vivo MTX-induced mouse models and in vitro BEAS-2B assays, including the Transwell migration/invasion, EdU proliferation, immunofluorescence, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, CA4 and TLR4 overexpression, and a CA4/TLR4 co-overexpression rescue experiment, were performed to assess the regulatory role of the top-ranked gene. RESULTS: Carbonic anhydrase 4 (CA4) ranked first by SHAP importance (0.120) and diagnostic performance (AUC = 0.879); the Ridge model discriminated training and validation cohorts (AUC = 0.930, 0.897 and 0.864). MTX bound stably to CA4 in silico (Vina -7.078 kcal/mol; MM-PBSA ΔGbind -76.5 kJ/mol), and SPR detected concentration-dependent binding to recombinant CA4 (KD = 6.25 μM), identifying CA4 as a candidate direct binding partner. In MTX-treated mice, CA4 was downregulated while TLR4, collagen deposition and serum TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, IFN-α and IFN-β were elevated. In BEAS-2B cells, CA4 overexpression suppressed migration, invasion and proliferation, reversed MTX-induced upregulation of TLR4, NF-κB, IRF3, VIM, FN1 and COL1A1, and restored E-cadherin. Forced TLR4 overexpression reversed the protective effect of CA4 and re-established the inflammatory and mesenchymal phenotype. CONCLUSION: In MTX-PF, MTX directly binds CA4 in vitro. CA4 loss accompanies coordinate upregulation of the TLR4-NF-κB/IRF3 axis and an EMT program coupling epithelial injury to fibrogenesis, and CA4 restoration reverses this program in epithelial cells. Although TLR4 gain-of-function abrogated CA4-mediated suppression, its causal necessity remains untested. Given that TLR4 signaling is context-dependent and can facilitate inflammation resolution in some fibrosis models, therapeutic blockade requires careful attention to cell type and timing. CA4 thus represents a candidate molecular correlate and experimental target, pending clinical and in vivo validation.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) is an infectious disease caused by the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (MTBC). This study aimed to characterize the lower-airway microbiome in patients with PTB and compare it with that of patients without PTB (Non-PTB) undergoing bronchoscopy for pulmonary disease, in order to describe differences in microbial composition between the two groups and improve our understanding of pulmonary microbial ecology in tuberculosis. METHODS: We performed metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) on bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) from 75 patients (38 PTB, 37 Non-PTB). Microbial diversity, composition, and differential taxa were analyzed using standard bioinformatics tools. RESULTS: PTB samples showed higher Shannon and Simpson indices, whereas Richness did not differ significantly between groups. Beta diversity analyses revealed modest but statistically detectable differences in microbial community composition between PTB and Non-PTB samples. The PTB group showed higher relative abundances of MTBC and several oral-associated taxa (e.g., Prevotella and Fusobacterium), whereas Non-PTB samples showed higher relative abundances of taxa including Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Aspergillus fumigatus. CONCLUSION: This BALF metagenomic study characterized lower-airway microbial features in patients with PTB and identified differences in microbial community composition and structure between PTB and patients with heterogeneous Non-PTB pulmonary diseases.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) accounts for roughly half of all lung cancer cases and novel therapeutic targets remain scarce. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death, offers a promising strategy to combat therapy resistance. Mitochondrial single-stranded DNA-binding protein 1 (SSBP1) is critical for mitochondrial genome stability, but its role in ferroptosis and LUAD progression remains undefined. METHODS: We analyzed SSBP1 expression and prognostic value in LUAD using public datasets and clinical specimens. In vitro, we used SSBP1 knockdown/overexpression in LUAD cell lines to assess cell viability, ferroptosis markers (Fe2+, Lipid ROS, MDA, rescue experiments), and mitochondrial function. Transcriptomic sequencing, GSEA, and Western blot were employed to identify the underlying pathway. The therapeutic potential of SSBP1 inhibition combined with the ferroptosis inducer RSL3 was validated in vitro and in a xenograft mouse model. RESULTS: High SSBP1 expression is associated with patient prognosis and restrains lipid peroxidation by sustaining ERK-dependent NRF2 nuclear translocation and subsequent HO-1 and GPX4 expression. Loss of SSBP1 impairs this antioxidant signaling axis, leading to increased ferrous ions and lipid ROS within LUAD cells, ultimately sensitized LUAD cells to RSL3, significantly enhancing ferroptosis and inhibiting tumor growth in vivo. Furthermore, mitochondrial damage resulting from ferroptosis in cancer cells exacerbates the mitochondrial apoptosis pathway induced by SSBP1 dysregulation. CONCLUSION: SSBP1, a mitochondrial-localized protein associated with LUAD patient prognosis, promotes LUAD progression by inhibiting ferroptosis through the ERK/NRF2/GPX4 axis.

papers.title_zh: 来瑞特韦对比单纯标准治疗轻中度COVID-19症状持续缓解与核酸转阴时间的多中心真实世界观察性研究：非随机设计下获益关联显著但无重症结局证据
papers.title_en: Effects of leritrelvir for adults with mild-to-moderate coronavirus disease 2019: a multicenter real-world study.
papers.authors: Cheng LL, Lu MQ, Ding BH, Zeng HQ, Xiang TX, Weng WD, Liang XJ, Jin J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Respiratory Disease, National Clinical Research Center for Respiratory Disease, Guangzhou Instit…
papers.results: 主要终点（持续症状缓解）：未校正HR 1.41（95%CI 1.18-1.68，P<0.001）；多因素校正HR 1.66（95%CI 1.38-1.99，P<0.001）；PS匹配HR 1.81（robust 95%CI 1.43-2.29，P<0.001）；匹配队列中位症状缓解时间来瑞特韦组6天 vs 对照组8天。关键次要终点（核酸转阴）：对应HR分别为1.20（95%CI 1.01-1.43，P=0.04）、1.22（95%CI 1.01-1.47，P=0.04）、1.47（robust 95%CI 1.21-1.79，P<0.001）；匹配中位时间分别为3天与4天。不良事件发生率：未匹配两组分别为22.41%与19.42%。
papers.authors_conclusion: 在该前瞻性、多中心、非随机队列中，来瑞特韦使用与更早的症状持续缓解及SARS-CoV-2核酸转阴相关；尽管关联方向在多因素校正与PS匹配分析中一致，残余混杂、开放标签症状评估、非比例风险、随访不完整以及重症结局事件缺失，限制了因果性、亚组特异性及重症结局层面的结论。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告重症/死亡等硬终点事件（作者自述无重症结局事件），故无法评估临床重要结局获益；不良事件发生率在来瑞特韦组更高（22.41% vs 19.42%）但摘要未给出组间统计检验，安全性比较信息不足。主要终点与关键次要终点均为阳性，无明显选择性强调，但关键次要终点未校正与校正HR的P值仅0.04、接近显著性边界，且未报告多重比较校正；开放标签下以患者自报症状为主要终点存在评估偏倚风险；非随机设计+PS匹配仅136对，残余混杂与适应证混杂（早用药人群可能基线病程更短）可解释部分HR差异。

pico.p: 中国141个中心的1,527例轻中度COVID-19成人患者（来瑞特韦组1,388例，单纯标准治疗组139例；PS匹配各136例）
pico.ic: 来瑞特韦400 mg每日三次、疗程5天+标准治疗 vs 单纯标准治疗

papers.reason: 影响轻中度COVID-19门诊抗病毒药物是否尽早启用的临床决策参考，同时作为非随机真实世界研究与PS匹配方法学案例，为胸部疾病领域观察性疗效评估的偏倚分析提供对照素材；因无重症结局且为观察性设计，不改变现有指南层级推荐。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Real-world evidence for leritrelvir, a single-component 3C-like protease inhibitor, in adults with mild-to-moderate coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) remains limited. We evaluated the association of early leritrelvir use with symptom resolution, negative viral-test conversion, and adverse events in routine clinical practice. METHODS: This prospective, multicenter, nonrandomized, open-label observational cohort study was conducted at 141 sites in China (mainland ). Among 1,527 adults with mild-to-moderate COVID-19, 1,388 received leritrelvir (400 mg three times daily for 5 days) plus standard care and 139 received standard care alone. The primary endpoint was time to sustained resolution of 11 predefined symptoms. The key secondary endpoint was time to negative severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) nucleic acid test (NAT) conversion. All participants contributed a primary time-to-event record. We estimated unadjusted and multivariable-adjusted Cox models and performed 1:1 propensity score (PS) matching (136 participants per group). RESULTS: For sustained symptom resolution, the unadjusted hazard ratio (HR) was 1.41 [95% confidence interval (CI): 1.18-1.68; P<0.001], the multivariable-adjusted HR was 1.66 (95% CI: 1.38-1.99; P<0.001), and the PS-matched HR was 1.81 (robust 95% CI: 1.43-2.29; P<0.001). In the matched cohort, median time to symptom resolution was 6 days with leritrelvir and 8 days with standard care alone. For negative NAT conversion, the corresponding HRs were 1.20 (95% CI: 1.01-1.43; P=0.04), 1.22 (95% CI: 1.01-1.47; P=0.04), and 1.47 (robust 95% CI: 1.21-1.79; P<0.001); matched medians were 3 and 4 days. Adverse events occurred in 22.41% and 19.42% of the unmatched groups, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: In this prospective, multicenter, nonrandomized cohort, leritrelvir use was associated with earlier sustained symptom resolution and negative SARS-CoV-2 NAT conversion than standard care alone. Although the direction of association was consistent across multivariable-adjusted and PS-matched analyses, residual confounding, open-label symptom assessment, nonproportional hazards, incomplete follow-up, and the absence of severe-outcome events preclude causal, subgroup-specific, or severe-outcome conclusions.
