papers.title_zh: 后纵隔Müllerian囊肿的椎旁解剖特征与术中分离方式：单中心7例手术-病理对照分析
papers.title_en: Posterior mediastinal Müllerian cysts: a single-center retrospective analysis.
papers.authors: Goto H, Nakanishi K, Sugiura Y, Emoto K, Ishida T
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of General Thoracic Surgery, National Hospital Organization Saitama Hospital, Saitama, Japan.
papers.results: 7例均为女性，中位年龄45岁；所有病变位于椎旁区域，影像学均表现为边缘光滑的单房囊性病变；术中均见薄壁囊肿内含清亮液体；与主动脉、奇静脉等邻近结构相邻面可行钝性分离，沿椎体（VB）表面需锐性分离；病理示囊壁紧邻致密纤维结缔组织，其间仅隔一层较疏松结缔组织。摘要未报告CI/P值及复发、随访等结局数据。
papers.authors_conclusion: Posterior mediastinal Müllerian cysts are thin-walled cystic lesions with a characteristic paraspinal distribution and no apparent continuity with surrounding organs. The requirement for sharp dissection adjacent to the VB may reflect the close anatomical relationship between the cyst wall and the fibrous connective tissue overlying the VB.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告手术入路（开胸/胸腔镜）、随访时长、复发率及症状缓解情况，无法评估治疗效果与长期结局。病例仅7例、无对照，属描述性证据；'与周围器官无明显连续性'为术中主观观察，缺乏影像或病理连续性验证；'锐性分离需求反映囊壁与椎体表面纤维组织的密切关系'为推断性表述（may reflect），属机制假说而非证实结论。病变发生率、影像鉴别要点（如何与神经鞘瘤囊变、食管源性囊肿区分）未涉及。

pico.p: 单中心2010年1月至2024年12月接受手术切除并经病理确诊的后纵隔Müllerian囊肿患者7例
pico.ic: 所有患者均接受手术切除（未设对照组；摘要未报告具体手术入路比较）

papers.reason: 为后纵隔Müllerian囊肿这一极罕见病变提供手术解剖学参考，影响椎旁囊肿术中分离策略（椎体面预期粘连需锐性分离、邻近大血管面可钝性分离）与术前鉴别诊断思路，同时为该病变的病例系列文献补充单中心手术-病理对照数据。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Posterior mediastinal Müllerian cysts are rare cystic lesions typically occurring in women in their 40s to 60s and located in the paraspinal region. Evidence is mainly limited to case reports, and their anatomical characteristics and pathological basis for localization remain poorly understood. This study aimed to investigate the anatomical features of these cysts and the relationship between operative and pathological findings. METHODS: This single-center retrospective analysis included seven patients who underwent surgical resection and were pathologically diagnosed with posterior mediastinal Müllerian cysts between January 2010 and December 2024. Clinical, imaging, intraoperative, and pathological findings were reviewed, with particular attention to lesion location, dissection characteristics, and histological findings. RESULTS: All patients were women, with a median age of 45 years. All lesions were located in the paraspinal region and appeared as smooth-marginated, unilocular cystic lesions on imaging. Intraoperatively, all lesions were thin-walled cysts containing clear fluid. Blunt dissection was feasible along surfaces adjacent to surrounding structures, including the aorta and azygos vein, whereas sharp dissection was required along the vertebral body (VB) surface. Histopathological examination demonstrated dense fibrous connective tissue immediately adjacent to the cyst wall, separated only by a thin layer of relatively loose connective tissue. CONCLUSIONS: Posterior mediastinal Müllerian cysts are thin-walled cystic lesions with a characteristic paraspinal distribution and no apparent continuity with surrounding organs. The requirement for sharp dissection adjacent to the VB may reflect the close anatomical relationship between the cyst wall and the fibrous connective tissue overlying the VB.

papers.title_en: CRTAM enhances T cell antimicrobial activity, particularly CD8+ T cells, against Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection.
papers.authors: Peng Y, Wang J, Ji X, Huang G, Zhu L, Wu Y, Wu X, Sha W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Shanghai Clinical Research Center for Infectious Disease (tuberculosis), Shanghai Key Laboratory of Tuberculosis, Shangh…

papers.reason: 启发式模式收录（未接入语言模型精评）：按期刊层级与研究类型自动入选。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The mechanisms underpinning protective host immunity against Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) are not fully elucidated. Resisters, individuals with prolonged exposure to Mtb who remain negative on repeated immunological testing for Mtb infection, provide a unique opportunity to investigate protective immune responses. This study systematically investigated the functional characteristics of CXCR3+CD107a+ effector cells in Resisters to identify molecules potentially associated with protective anti-mycobacterial immunity. METHODS: mRNA sequencing was employed to investigate the transcriptional characteristics of CXCR3+CD107a+ effector lymphocytes from Resisters and tuberculosis patients. Flow cytometry was utilized to assess CRTAM expression and effector phenotypes, and colony-forming units assays quantified the bacterial burdens in infected macrophages. Crtam-deficient and wild-type mice were used to investigate the function of CRTAM to host control of mycobacterial infection in vivo. RESULTS: mRNA sequencing of CXCR3+CD107a+ effector lymphocytes isolated from Resisters revealed elevated CRTAM expression, which positively correlated with anti-mycobacterial effector molecules. CRTAM levels were lower in patients with chronic Mtb infection. Mycobacterial stimulation rapidly increased CRTAM expression, particularly in CD8+ T cells. CRTAM expression and agonistic CRTAM stimulation were associated with enhanced T-cell effector responses and inhibition of intracellular mycobacterial growth. Crtam-deficient mice showed increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infection, whereas recombinant CRTAM administration conferred significant immune protection. CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify CRTAM as a protective immune-associated molecule that contributes to anti-mycobacterial effector responses. The recombinant CRTAM findings provided initial in vivo proof-of-concept that CRTAM can modulate infection-associated outcomes during Mtb infection, supporting its further investigation as an immune-regulatory molecule.

papers.title_en: Diagnostic challenge of delayed immune-related hepatitis during zongertinib treatment after nivolumab plus ipilimumab in a 52-year-old man with HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer: a case report.
papers.authors: Oba T, Shiohira S, Machida Y, Nakatani D, Akasaka K, Amano M, Matsushima H
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Respiratory Medicine, Japanese Red Cross Saitama Hospital, Saitama, Japan.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Delayed immune-related hepatitis after discontinuation of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) is increasingly recognized, but attribution is difficult when liver injury develops during subsequent tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy. This diagnostic dilemma has not been well described during human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-selective TKI treatment after dual ICI therapy. CASE DESCRIPTION: A 52-year-old Japanese man with HER2 exon 20 insertion-positive stage IVB non-small cell lung cancer received nivolumab plus ipilimumab from February 28 to November 13, 2025, and developed grade 2 oral mucositis, grade 2 adrenal insufficiency, and grade 1-2 skin toxicity. Zongertinib was initiated on November 26. Routine testing on January 6, 2026 showed grade 3 hepatocellular injury, and zongertinib was withheld. Despite drug withdrawal, liver injury progressed, and he was admitted with mild fatigue on January 20, when aspartate aminotransferase, alanine aminotransferase, alkaline phosphatase, and γ-glutamyl transpeptidase levels were 774, 1,386, 156, and 160 U/L, respectively. Total bilirubin remained approximately 1.0 mg/dL. Viral and autoimmune testing and imaging disclosed no alternative cause. Liver biopsy showed active hepatitis with lymphocyte-predominant portal and lobular inflammation and interface activity, findings compatible with an immune-mediated hepatitis pattern but not specific for the causative agent. Prednisolone 40 mg/day (approximately 0.5 mg/kg/day) produced rapid biochemical improvement with resolution of fatigue. Zongertinib was resumed on February 11 and continued without recurrent hepatitis through June 2026. CONCLUSIONS: The progression of liver injury despite zongertinib withdrawal, multiple prior immune-related adverse events, exclusion of competing causes, compatible histology, corticosteroid responsiveness, and absence of recurrence after zongertinib rechallenge collectively favored delayed immune-related hepatitis, although zongertinib-associated drug-induced liver injury could not be completely excluded. In similar cases, a structured etiological assessment, including liver biopsy when the result may alter cancer treatment, can help guide management.

papers.title_en: Surgical conversion after anaplastic lymphoma kinase-tyrosine kinase inhibitors (ALK-TKIs) therapy in N3 stage ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer: a report of three cases.
papers.authors: Xiao B, Guo H, Zhang J, Yang XN
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary Surgery, Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, Guangdong Academy of Medical Sciences, Southern…
papers.results: Case 1：DP化疗3周期后SD，克唑替尼150天，肿瘤直径缩小81%，叶切除+纵隔淋巴结清扫，病理完全缓解（pCR，0/12淋巴结），未行术后ALK-TKI，术后12个月出现孤立脑转移，报告OS 83个月；Case 2：阿来替尼225天，PR，楔形切除+纵隔淋巴结清扫，非主要病理缓解（non-MPR），0/5淋巴结阳性，术后继续阿来替尼，随访64个月无复发存活；Case 3：阿来替尼135天，PR，段切除+纵隔淋巴结清扫，pCR，0/10淋巴结阳性，术后继续阿来替尼，随访38个月无复发存活
papers.authors_conclusion: 在经过选择的N3期ALK阳性NSCLC患者中，ALK-TKI诱导治疗后手术切除是一种可行的治疗策略；术后维持ALK-TKI可能有助于获得良好的长期生存结局。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：3例无对照的病例报告，'经过选择的患者'选择标准未说明，人群限定松动；结论中'术后维持ALK-TKI可能改善长期生存'仅由2例支撑且无对照，与Case 1（未行辅助TKI后12个月脑转移）的对比属非随机的个案观察，不能归因；主要报告为病理缓解与随访描述，无统计学检验、无CI/P值

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase-tyrosine kinase inhibitors (ALK-TKIs) can produce substantial and durable tumor regression in ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). We report three cases of stage N3 ALK-positive NSCLC patients who successfully underwent surgical resection after ALK-TKIs therapy. CASE DESCRIPTION: Case 1 was a 45-year-old female who had stable disease (SD) after three cycles of docetaxel plus cisplatin and then received crizotinib 250 mg twice daily for 150 days. Tumor diameter decreased by 81%, and she underwent lobectomy with mediastinal lymph-node dissection. The resected lung lesion and sampled nodes showed pathological complete response (pCR) (0/12 nodes). She did not receive postoperative ALK-TKI therapy and developed an isolated brain metastasis 12 months after surgery; treatment with crizotinib and Gamma Knife radiosurgery achieved subsequent disease control, and the reported overall survival (OS) was 83 months. papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immunotherapy is an essential treatment strategy for lung cancer, yet resistance to it is often unavoidable, resulting in treatment failure and poor prognosis. The cancer stem cell (CSC) theory offers a valuable perspective for understanding tumor metastasis and resistance to immunotherapy. However, there is a scarcity of multi-omics studies that identify tumor stemness subpopulations and their associated signaling pathways. In this study, we combined single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) with spatial transcriptomics sequencing (ST-seq) to identify a myosin heavy chain 11 (MYH11)-high stemness subpopulation linked to immunotherapy resistance. METHODS: We conducted quality control and removed batch effects from two scRNA-seq datasets, then annotated cell types using established marker genes. Malignant cells were distinguished from epithelial cells with fastCNV. Stemness subpopulations were identified using a machine learning-derived messenger RNA (mRNA) stemness index (mRNAsi) and CytoTRACE analysis. To functionally characterize the stemness subpopulation, we employed Monocle3 pseudotime trajectory analysis, CellChat cell-cell communication analysis, and predicted transcription factors (TFs). We also performed consensus clustering on bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) data, followed by immune-related scoring, immune cell deconvolution, and drug sensitivity prediction. Clinical validation was achieved through multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) and immunohistochemistry (IHC). Experimental validation included short hairpin RNA (shRNA)-mediated MYH11 knockdown, real-time quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR) and western blot analyses, and tumor sphere formation assays to assess cancer stemness. RESULTS: We identified nine major cell types and found a significant enrichment of epithelial cells in tumors resistant to immunotherapy. Using fastCNV, we identified malignant cells and defined seven malignant cell subtypes based on stemness scoring. Notably, the Stem-subtype was significantly enriched in resistant tumors. Functional analysis showed that the Stem-subtype could differentiate into other malignant cell subtypes, with a strong enrichment in the NOTCH signaling pathway. Analysis of fibroblast subpopulations revealed that MYH11 + fibroblasts were closely linked to the Stem-subtype, collectively contributing to immunotherapy resistance. Consensus clustering identified two stemness-related subtypes, with Stemness I associated with poor prognosis. Immune scoring and immune cell analysis further indicated an unfavorable response to immunotherapy in Stemness I. Drug sensitivity prediction identified potential therapeutic agents, and in silico knockout experiments revealed downstream target genes. Validation with clinical samples confirmed that MYH11-high cancer cells were closely correlated with exhausted CD8+ T cell infiltration and poor immunotherapy outcomes. Experimental validation demonstrated that MYH11 knockdown significantly reduced the expression levels of CXCL12 and TUBA1A, as well as the expression of core NOTCH pathway genes. Furthermore, the tumor sphere-forming capacity was markedly suppressed. CONCLUSIONS: In summary, our multi-omics analysis revealed a MYH11-high malignant cell stemness subpopulation and a MYH11 + fibroblast subpopulation, both of which are closely linked to immunotherapy resistance and poor prognosis in lung cancer.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), particularly emphysema, is associated with chronic lung inflammation, structural remodeling, and an increased risk of lung cancer. Although neutrophils are abundant in COPD and lung cancer, how neutrophils influence tumor development in emphysematous lungs remains unclear. We hypothesized that emphysema alters neutrophil anti-tumor functions, thereby promoting lung cancer progression. METHODS: Using a mouse model of emphysema followed by lung cancer cell inoculation, we assessed the effect of neutrophil depletion on tumor growth. We then characterized neutrophil abundance, phenotype, reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, and tumor-cell cytotoxicity in blood and lungs from mice with lung cancer, with or without emphysema. Finally, we compared neutrophil functions in lung cancer patients with and without COPD. RESULTS: In mice with emphysema and lung cancer, neutrophil depletion further increased tumor burden, indicating that neutrophils retain anti-tumor activity in this setting. While neutrophil numbers were not significantly altered by emphysema, their functional profile was changed. Lung ROS production increased in mice with lung cancer alone but was reduced in mice with lung cancer on a background of emphysema. Consistently, neutrophils from lung cancer patients with COPD showed reduced ROS production and lower cytotoxicity toward tumor cells compared with neutrophils from lung cancer patients without COPD. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that emphysema impairs neutrophil anti-tumor function, reducing their cytotoxic capacity and thereby facilitating lung cancer progression. This provides a potential mechanistic link between COPD and lung cancer and highlights neutrophils as functionally important anti-tumor immune cells in the COPD-associated lung microenvironment.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Spread through air spaces (STAS), defined as tumor cell dissemination into alveolar spaces, is a prognostic factor for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer and is typically identified in surgical specimens from patients with early-stage disease. We describe a rare autopsy case of rapid progression with STAS in a patient with recurrent lung adenocarcinoma. CASE DESCRIPTION: A 70-year-old man with stage IA lung adenocarcinoma previously treated with stereotactic radiotherapy and multiple comorbidities, including chronic heart failure due to the dilated phase of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, ventricular tachycardia treated with amiodarone, and diabetes mellitus, was admitted because of progressive dyspnea and respiratory failure. Computed tomography (CT) revealed bilateral ground-glass opacities with increased consolidation at the site of prior irradiation. Given the elevated liver attenuation on CT, amiodarone-induced pulmonary toxicity and pulmonary edema were initially suspected, the drug was discontinued, and diuretic therapy was intensified. Despite additional corticosteroid therapy and antibiotics for concurrent bacteremia, respiratory failure progressed and the patient died on hospital day 37. Autopsy revealed papillary adenocarcinoma with extensive STAS, characterized by tumor cell clusters floating within the airspaces in a micropapillary pattern, spreading bilaterally. Mucin staining revealed no abundant mucin in the cytoplasm, and thyroid transcription factor-1 was positive. No evidence of amiodarone-induced pneumonitis or significant pulmonary edema was observed. CONCLUSIONS: To our knowledge, this is the first reported autopsy case of recurrent advanced lung adenocarcinoma with fatal respiratory failure in which extensive STAS was considered a major contributing factor. Clinicians should consider STAS as a potential mechanism of rapid deterioration in patients with known lung adenocarcinoma.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pathological complete response (pCR) and major pathological response (MPR) are early measures of treatment efficacy with prognostic relevance in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) receiving neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. Individual biomarkers such as programmed cell death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) and tumor mutational burden (TMB), and conventional imaging interpretation, incompletely characterize treatment sensitivity. Integrating clinical biomarkers with radiomics may improve prediction by combining information on host factors and tumor biology with quantitative imaging measures of tumor heterogeneity. We aimed to develop and validate a model predicting pathological response. METHODS: We retrospectively collected fluorine-18 fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (18F-FDG PET/CT) images and clinical data from 320 patients with NSCLC at Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital who received at least two cycles of chemoimmunotherapy followed by surgical resection and had postoperative pathological response assessments. Patients were randomly assigned to training (n=256) and validation (n=64) cohorts at an 8:2 ratio. A total of 1,834 CT and 179 PET radiomics features were extracted and integrated with demographic and tumor metabolic parameters, PD-L1 expression, TMB, and peripheral blood biomarkers. Following standardization and within-modality Pearson correlation filtering, features were selected using recursive feature elimination (RFE). A modality-aware attention model was developed to generate patient-specific scores for predicting MPR, including pCR. The model's performance was further validated in an external cohort of 31 patients from two independent hospitals. RESULTS: A total of 351 patients were included: 256 in the training cohort (160 responders and 96 non-responders), 64 in the internal testing cohort (35 responders and 29 non-responders), and 31 in the preliminary external test cohort. Our study proposes a modality-aware attention model, which was constructed upon RFE feature engineering technique. Our model integrates diverse data sources, including nine clinical characteristics, nine CT features, and nine PET features. Our model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.7467 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.6826 to 0.8159] in the training set. In the external independent validation cohort, the AUC was 0.7017 (95% CI: 0.5126 to 0.8715), with a sensitivity of 82% and a specificity of 86%. Compared to single-modality models based on clinical features (AUC =0.6931; 95% CI: 0.6232 to 0.7604), the modality-aware attention model significantly improved accuracy. CONCLUSIONS: The multimodal model showed potential for predicting MPR, including pCR, in patients with NSCLC receiving chemoimmunotherapy. Larger prospective multicenter studies are needed before clinical implementation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The relationship of triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and triglyceride-glucose body mass index (TyG-BMI) with the risk of lung cancer and survival of patients with lung cancer remains unclear. This meta-analysis aimed to clarify the association of TyG index and TyG-BMI with the risk of lung cancer and survival of lung cancer patients. METHODS: Several databases were searched up to July 2, 2026. Odds ratios (ORs) and hazard ratios (HRs) were combined to assess the association of TyG index and TyG-BMI with risk and prognosis of lung cancer, respectively. Pooled analyses demonstrated that higher TyG index [OR =2.42, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.54-3.81, P<0.001] and TyG-BMI (OR =1.01, 95% CI: 1.01-1.02, P<0.001) were significantly related to increased risk of lung cancer. Subgroup analyses based on the study design and tumor type manifested similar results. However, subgroup analysis based on the combination of DM indicated that the significant association of TyG index and TyG-BMI with lung cancer risk was only observed among the population without DM. Besides, a higher TyG index was associated with poorer overall survival (OS) (HR =2.24, 95% CI: 1.49-3.37, P<0.001) and progression-free survival (PFS) (HR =3.09, 95% CI: 1.78-5.37, P<0.001). TyG-BMI was also related to OS (HR =1.86, 95% CI: 1.36-2.56, P<0.001) and PFS (HR =2.34, 95% CI: 1.20-4.56, P=0.01). Subgroup analyses stratified by treatment and tumor type indicated consistent findings, but association of TyG-BMI with OS was only observed in non-diabetic patients. CONCLUSIONS: Elevated TyG index and TyG-BMI are significantly associated with increased risk of lung cancer and poorer survival outcomes, particularly among non-diabetic individuals.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Elderly patients with advanced lung cancer frequently experience declines in physical and cognitive function, which can complicate treatment decision-making. Although comprehensive geriatric assessment has been reported to support individualized dose adjustments and reduce treatment-related adverse events, its impact on prognosis remains unclear. The Geriatric-8 (G-8) is an eight-item geriatric screening tool, and we hypothesized that it may help detect vulnerabilities not captured by performance status (PS) alone and identify patients who may be unsuitable for chemotherapy. Therefore, we retrospectively investigated whether the G-8 score assessed prior to the initiation of chemotherapy could predict early mortality in elderly patients with advanced lung cancer who received chemotherapy. METHODS: A total of 22 patients aged 70 years or older with advanced non-small cell lung cancer without any actionable molecular-targeted therapies and good PS (0-1) who received treatment at our hospital between April 2024 and March 2026 were enrolled in this study. Early mortality was defined as death occurring within six months. A receiver operating characteristic curve was generated to identify the G-8 score that best discriminated between early- and non-early-death groups. Patients were subsequently divided into two groups according to this cutoff, and their median overall survival (OS) was compared. Univariate analyses were also performed to examine the association between the G-8 score and OS. RESULTS: Nineteen patients were categorized into Group A (G-8 score ≥12) and three into Group B (G-8 score <12). The median OS of Group B was significantly shorter than that of Group A [2.04 months (95% CI: 1.45-NR) vs. NR (95% CI: 8.28-NR); hazard ratio: 7.05; 95% CI: 1.53-32.3; P<0.05]. Univariate analysis of OS and the G-8 score showed a hazard ratio of 0.71 (95% CI: 0.55-0.91; P=0.007). CONCLUSIONS: The G-8 score may help identify the risk of early mortality in elderly patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer who otherwise appear clinically well, particularly when used in combination with PS, offering greater discriminatory ability than PS alone.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Complications following lung resection present complex clinical, ethical and interpersonal challenges that extend beyond technical management. Although substantial literature addresses the prevention and treatment of complications after lung resection, there is limited guidance regarding the ethical principles that should shape clinical decision-making as complications evolve. This review proposes a practical ethical framework for the management of complications following lung resection. METHODS: Recommendations were developed based on clinical expertise and relevant published sources. A narrative literature search was conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE and Embase, supplemented by targeted searches of relevant clinical resources and reference lists. English-language literature published within the last fifteen years was considered, with more recent evidence prioritized alongside foundational literature. Where lung resection-specific evidence was limited, related thoracic surgery, critical care, perioperative medicine, and surgical ethics literature was incorporated. KEY CONTENT AND FINDINGS: The developed framework is focused on six foundational ethical principles spanning patient-centered and provider-/systems-centered domains. Patient-centered principles include autonomy, shared decision-making and proportionate goal-concordant care, which help define patient values and integrate those values with clinical expertise to align treatment strategies with meaningful outcomes. Provider-/systems-centered principles include beneficence, nonmaleficence, justice, transparency and accountability, all of which guide professional responsibility, equitable care, honest communication and collaboration throughout recovery. The application of these principles is examined across the preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative phases of care. CONCLUSIONS: This framework emphasizes aligning treatment decisions with patient-defined goals, while balancing the potential benefits and burdens of intervention. Overall, these six ethical principles provide a structured and durable framework for navigating complications following lung resection.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Primary snoring is common in adults, but its definition, diagnostic boundaries, and management remain inconsistent. Misclassification between primary snoring and mild obstructive sleep apnea may expose patients to either unnecessary treatment or inadequate evaluation. This expert consensus aimed to develop an evidence-informed framework for adult primary snoring that emphasizes objective exclusion of obstructive sleep apnea and patient- and bed-partner-centered outcomes. METHODS: A modified Delphi study enrolled a purposive panel of 30 experts in otolaryngology-head and neck surgery and sleep medicine from five Chinese regions. A 25-source targeted evidence corpus, supplemented by question-driven searches and human-verified artificial intelligence-assisted extraction, informed 75 unique candidate items. Four anonymous online rounds used a 9-point scale; consensus was predefined as at least 80% agreement and strong consensus as at least 90%. A pragmatic three-level evidence-basis label distinguished direct evidence from indirect evidence and expert consensus. RESULTS: Round response rates were 93.3% (28/30), 96.7% (29/30), 96.7% (29/30), and 96.7% (29/30). Of 75 unique candidate items, 68 reached consensus; consolidation yielded 54 final statements and seven explicit non-consensus items. The framework separates clinically suspected from objectively confirmed primary snoring, addresses night-to-night diagnostic variability, and prioritizes patient- and bed-partner-centered outcomes. First-line care is proportional and phenotype-informed; custom titratable mandibular advancement devices are the preferred device-based option for suitable patients, while surgery is restricted to selected anatomical targets. CONCLUSIONS: This consensus provides a transparent, risk-stratified framework for adult primary snoring and identifies unresolved controversies. Multidisciplinary external validation, standardized outcome definitions, and prospective phenotype-stratified trials are required before broad international adoption.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Severe complications after radical esophagectomy remain a major clinical concern, highlighting the need for early postoperative risk stratification. Existing prediction models rely largely on preoperative factors, and models incorporating early postoperative inflammatory biomarkers to predict severe complications remain limited. This study aimed to develop and internally validate a nomogram integrating baseline characteristics and postoperative day (POD) 1 inflammatory biomarkers to predict severe postoperative complications after radical esophagectomy. METHODS: Clinical data from 606 consecutive patients (2019-2025) were analyzed. Severe complications were defined as Thoracic Morbidity and Mortality (TM&M) grade ≥ III within 30 days after surgery. Candidate predictors, measured at baseline and from venous blood collected at 06:00 AM on POD 1, included demographics, surgical variables, and inflammatory biomarkers. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression with 10-fold cross-validation was embedded within a 1,000-bootstrap internal validation framework to avoid data leakage, followed by multivariable logistic regression. RESULTS: Severe complications occurred in 178 patients (29.4%). Age [adjusted odds ratio (OR) =1.04], operative time (OR =1.04 per 10-min increase), and non-middle tumor location (OR =1.58) were independent predictors (all P<0.05). Female sex (OR =0.60), neoadjuvant therapy (OR =0.52), and POD 1 lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio (D1-LMR, OR =0.76) were protective factors. The nomogram yielded an apparent AUC of 0.685 (95% confidence interval: 0.635-0.735) and a bootstrap optimism-corrected AUC of 0.672. At the optimal cutoff of 0.28 determined by the Youden index, sensitivity was 68.5%, specificity 63.4%, positive predictive value 45.2%, and negative predictive value 82.1%. Calibration was excellent (calibration slope =0.942, intercept =0.018, Brier score =0.184). Adding D1-LMR significantly improved predictive performance over baseline clinical models (ΔAUC =0.034, net reclassification improvement =0.158, P=0.008). Decision curve analysis confirmed positive net clinical benefits across threshold probabilities of 2-45%. CONCLUSIONS: Integrating baseline features and D1-LMR, this nomogram provides an exploratory early risk-stratification tool on POD 1 to optimize perioperative management and intensive care unit resource allocation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: In recent years, neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy followed by radical resection has become a new treatment option for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, there remains a paucity of simple yet effective biomarkers for assessing pathological response and long-term prognosis. This study aimed to investigate the potential value of serum lactate dehydrogenase to albumin ratio (LAR) in this clinical setting. Baseline LAR, post-treatment LAR, and the ratio of baseline to post-treatment LAR were calculated and evaluated for their associations with pathologic response and event-free survival (EFS). RESULTS: Of the 81 patients, 48 (59.3%) achieved major pathological response (MPR). MPR patients had significantly lower post-treatment LAR and a higher baseline to post-treatment LAR ratio than non-MPR patients, whereas baseline LAR showed no significant difference. Post-treatment LAR and baseline to post-treatment LAR ratio discriminatedMPR with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.747 and 0.719, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression identified post-treatment LAR [odds ratio (OR) =0.498, P=0.02] and radiological response (OR =6.297, P=0.008) as independent factors associated with MPR. Multivariate Cox regression demonstrated that higher post-treatment LAR [hazard ratio (HR) =1.664, P=0.003] and non-MPR status (HR =3.498, P=0.004) were independent prognostic factors for poor EFS. Restricted cubic spline (RCS) analysis further revealed a positive association between post-treatment LAR and EFS risk, with higher LAR corresponding to increased HRs. A nomogram based on these two EFS prognostic factors demonstrated good calibration at 24 months with internal bootstrap validation (C-index =0.769). CONCLUSIONS: Post-treatment LAR could serve as a potential indicator for response assessment and long-term prognostication in NSCLC patients undergoing neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. Its simplicity, cost-effectiveness, and accessibility through routine laboratory testing render it a promising candidate for integration into clinical practice.

papers.title_zh: 皮下胸膜port治疗非恶性复发性胸腔积液：8例回顾性病例系列显示早期可行且患者耐受良好
papers.title_en: Fully implantable subcutaneous pleural port for patient-centered management of recurrent non-malignant pleural effusions.
papers.authors: Abia-Trujillo D, Murillo-Torres RM, Barrios-Ruiz A, Yu Lee-Mateus A, Rojas-Zapata TA, Vaca-Cartagena BF, Gutierrez-Gallegos P, Robertson KS et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Pulmonary, Allergy, Sleep, and Respiratory Medicine, Mayo Clinic Florida, Jacksonville, FL, USA.
papers.results: 置入部位：右侧4例（50%）、左侧3例（37.5%）、双侧1例（12.5%）；port使用中位时长204天[IQR 129–528天]；中位每位患者引流6次[IQR 4–20次]；每次中位引流体积790 mL[IQR 350–1,110 mL]；全部8例患者报告整体体验积极，表现为引流后症状缓解及port留置可耐受
papers.authors_conclusion: SPPC对于需要慢性胸腔引流的选定患者似乎是一种安全且可行的门诊选择，在本研究中显示出良好的早期操作结局与患者耐受性；可能尤其适用于需要每2–8周间歇引流的低蛋白、漏出性胸腔积液患者、且希望避免外置装置者，不论抗凝状态如何；需要更大的随机对照试验评估长期疗效、安全性与患者报告的生活质量结局，并明确其在非恶性胸腔积液管理中的地位
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：仅8例无对照的回顾性病例系列，称“安全”但摘要未报告任何并发症、再入院或不良事件数据；“不论抗凝状态”适用性主张无对应患者数据支撑；全部患者报告积极体验，缺乏对退出、失败病例或选择偏倚的说明；主要为可行性/耐受性描述，无疗效比较终点

pico.p: 2023年12月至2026年2月间以皮下胸膜port导管（SPPC）处理的非恶性胸腔积液（NMPE）患者，8例
pico.ic: SPPC置入联合皮下隧道化导管+门诊常规引流；无对照组

papers.reason: 为慢性非恶性胸腔积液的门诊引流策略提供初步可行性数据，可作为皮下port技术开展时的病例量与引流量参考基线，但不足以改变临床决策
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Non-malignant pleural effusions (NMPEs) significantly impact patients' quality of life and represent a growing healthcare burden. We describe an alternative, patient-centered approach for managing recurrent NMPEs: the subcutaneous pleural port catheter (SPPC) technique. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of patients with NMPEs managed with SPPC between December 2023 and February 2026. Demographic details, clinical presentation, fluid volume management, and patient-tolerability were recorded. The procedure involved placement of a pleural catheter with subcutaneous tunneling, followed by routine outpatient drainage. RESULTS: Eight patients met the inclusion criteria. Port placement was right-sided in four patients (50%), left-sided in three (37.5%), and bilateral in one (12.5%). The median duration of port use was 204 days [interquartile range (IQR) 129-528 days], with a median of six drainages per patient (IQR 4-20) and a median volume of 790 mL drained per session (IQR 350-1,110 mL). All patients reported a positive overall experience, characterized by symptom relief after drainage and tolerability of port in situ. CONCLUSIONS: SPPC appears to be a safe and feasible outpatient option for selected patients requiring chronic pleural drainage, demonstrating favorable early procedural outcomes and patient tolerability in this study. It may be particularly suitable for patients with low protein, transudative pleural effusions who require intermittent drainage every 2-8 weeks and wish to avoid an external device, irrespective of anticoagulation status. Larger randomized controlled trials are needed to assess long-term efficacy, safety, and patient reported quality of life outcomes, and to define its role in the management of nonmalignant pleural effusions.

papers.title_zh: 含黄芪中药复方联合常规治疗稳定期COPD（侧重40–60岁较年轻工作人群）的多中心随机双盲安慰剂对照试验方案
papers.title_en: Astragalus-containing compound formula for stable chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with a focus on relatively younger patients: a study protocol for a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
papers.authors: Hao L, Cui R, Wang Q, Liu D, Peng Q, He J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Tianjin Medical University, Tianjin, China.
papers.ai_note: 仅为研究方案，无任何疗效或安全性数据，信息不足；同时设定急性加重频率、肺功能（FEV1、FVC、FEV1/FVC）与体能（6MWD、肌力、柔韧、平衡）多组主要终点，摘要未说明多重性校正或主要终点层级；40–60岁亚组分析被明确标为探索性，但背景与讨论反复强调较年轻工作人群，存在以亚组叙事包装研究定位的倾向；人群限定于中医辨证（肺肾气虚）且须满足特定吸入方案≥3个月，外推至一般COPD人群有限

pico.p: 年龄40–75岁、GOLD 2–4级、过去12个月≥2次中度急性加重或≥1次加重相关住院、辨证为肺气虚/肾气虚（lung-kidney qi deficiency）的稳定期COPD患者；计划探索性分析限定40–60岁人群；摘要未报告样本量
pico.ic: 含黄芪的固定12味中药复方 + 协议规定的吸入维持基础治疗 vs 匹配安慰剂 + 同基础治疗，疗程48周，按中心分层1:1中央随机

papers.reason: 为中西医结合治疗稳定期COPD的试验设计与终点体系提供参考，但因尚无结果数据，暂不改变任何临床决策；关注其多主要终点与年轻亚组的方案设计问题
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) increasingly affects relatively younger, working-age adults, in whom impaired physical function can compromise work, family responsibilities, and quality of life. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of an Astragalus-containing compound formula as an adjunct to protocol-specified background Western maintenance therapy in patients with stable COPD, with particular interest in its effects among relatively younger, working-age patients. METHODS: This multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial includes patients aged 40-75 years with stable COPD, Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease grades 2-4, at least two moderate exacerbations or one exacerbation-related hospitalization during the previous 12 months, and the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) pattern of lung-kidney qi deficiency. An exploratory age-focused analysis will evaluate participants aged 40-60 years. The intervention is a fixed 12-herb Astragalus-containing compound formula. Eligible participants must have received one of the protocol-specified stable-dose inhaled maintenance regimens for at least 3 consecutive months before screening. Participants are centrally randomized 1:1 through an Interactive Web Response System (IWRS), with stratification by study center, to receive either a fixed 12-herb Astragalus-containing compound formula or matching placebo for 48 weeks in addition to background therapy. Primary outcomes are acute exacerbation frequency, lung function assessed by forced expiratory volume in one second, forced vital capacity, and their ratio, and physical fitness assessed by six-minute walk distance (6MWD), muscle strength, flexibility, and balance. Secondary outcomes include the modified Medical Research Council (mMRC) dyspnea scale, COPD Assessment Test (CAT), St. George's Respiratory Questionnaire (SGRQ), TCM syndrome score, and Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS). Assessments will be conducted at baseline and at weeks 4, 12, 24, 36, and 48. Primary efficacy analyses will be conducted in the full analysis set (FAS), following the intention-to-treat (ITT) principle, using prespecified negative binomial regression and linear mixed-effects models, with per-protocol (PP) analyses performed as sensitivity analyses. DISCUSSION: This trial is designed to evaluate whether the compound formula provides additional long-term benefits in reducing exacerbations and improving physical function in relatively younger and working-age patients with stable COPD. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Drug Clinical Trial Registration and Information Disclosure Platform of the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA), China, registration No. CTR20232692.

papers.title_zh: 中国结核分枝杆菌基因型与临床表型关联：北京谱系增加肺空洞风险、降低播散性结核风险，与治疗失败无显著关联
papers.title_en: The effects of Mycobacterium tuberculosis genotypes on clinical phenotypes revealed by whole-genome sequencing technology in China.
papers.authors: Huang W, Liang J, Guo M, Liu X, Yan B, Gao Q, Shen Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Tuberculosis, Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center, Fudan University, Shanghai, China.
papers.results: 有效分离株中80.8%为东亚北京谱系（lineage 2）、18.0%为欧-美谱系（lineage 4）、1.2%为 Indo-Oceanic 谱系（lineage 1）。与非北京菌株相比，北京菌株独立相关于肺空洞风险升高（aOR=4.76，95%CI：2.01-11.26，P=0.006），以及播散性结核风险降低（aOR=0.40，95%CI：0.17-0.95，P=0.04）。北京基因型与治疗失败无显著关联；空洞性疾病是治疗失败的独立预测因素。
papers.authors_conclusion: MTB遗传多样性在很大程度上促成结核临床表型的异质性。WGS可实现精确的亚谱系鉴定并促进稳健的基因型-表型分析。这些发现支持实施基因组监测，以优化个体化临床管理并为流行区有针对性的结核防控策略提供依据。
papers.ai_note: 横断面/观察性设计，仅172株有效分离株且非北京组占比约19%（约33株），组间样本量悬殊可能使aOR估计不稳；未见多重比较校正说明（同时检验空洞、播散、治疗失败等多个终点）。治疗失败为主要关注终点之一但摘要仅给'无显著关联'，未报告具体aOR/CI/P，信息不足。'空洞性疾病是治疗失败独立预测因素'同样缺少数值。北京谱系占80.8%，'基因组监测优化个体化管理'的结论超出本研究设计所能支持的因果与效用证据。

pico.p: 173例结核患者，213株临床MTB分离株经全基因组测序，排除混合感染后172株有效分离株
pico.ic: 北京谱系（lineage 2）菌株对比非北京谱系菌株（观察性比较，无干预）

papers.reason: 为结核临床表型异质性提供高分辨率基因型证据，影响对北京谱系患者空洞型/播散型表现差异的风险认知，但属非肿瘤呼吸感染领域，与胸部肿瘤核心业务关联有限，主要作为流行区结核防控与WGS方法学参考。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Findings related to the associations between Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) lineages and tuberculosis (TB) clinical phenotypes remain inconsistent across studies, primarily because conventional genotyping techniques lack the resolution to distinguish fine-scale sublineages. This study aimed to rigorously verify the clinical characteristics and prognostic significance of predominant Beijing-lineage strains circulating in China using high-resolution genomic evidence. METHODS: In total, 173 patients with TB were enrolled in the study, and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) was performed on 213 clinical MTB isolates; mixed-strain infections were excluded from subsequent analyses. Phylogenetic sublineage classification was performed based on single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) profiling. Multivariate logistic regression was used to independently assess the associations between MTB genotypes, clinical manifestations, and treatment outcomes, after adjusting for demographic and clinical confounding factors. RESULTS: Among the 172 valid isolates, 80.8% were classified as East Asian Beijing lineage (lineage 2), 18.0% as Euro-American lineage (lineage 4), and 1.2% as Indo-Oceanic lineage (lineage 1). Compared with the non-Beijing strains, the Beijing strains were independently associated with an increased risk of pulmonary cavitation [adjusted odds ratio (aOR) =4.76, 95% confidence interval (CI): 2.01-11.26, P=0.006], as well as a decreased risk of disseminated TB (aOR =0.40, 95% CI: 0.17-0.95, P=0.04). No significant association was observed between the Beijing genotype and treatment failure, whereas cavitary disease was an independent predictor of treatment failure. CONCLUSIONS: MTB genetic diversity contributes substantially to heterogeneity in TB clinical phenotypes. WGS enables precise sublineage identification and facilitates robust genotype-phenotype analysis. These findings support the implementation of genomic surveillance to optimize individualized clinical management and inform targeted TB prevention strategies in endemic regions.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述（narrative review），汇总SITT真实世界研究与生物制剂III期及早期真实世界证据
papers.title_zh: COPD个体化药物升级：单装置三联疗法真实世界证据与生物制剂时代进展的叙述性综述
papers.title_en: COPD: real-world evidence on single-inhaler triple therapy and the emergence of biologic therapy.
papers.authors: Da Re B, Reccardini N, Monteleone G, Capparelli E, Hughes M, Bandini G, Wang Y, Confalonieri P et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medical, Surgical and Health Sciences, University of Trieste, Trieste, Italy.
papers.authors_conclusion: SITT现为需要含ICS三联治疗患者的优选吸入策略；真实世界研究显示SITT与更好依从性、更低加重率和改善临床结局相关，但观察性发现需谨慎作因果解读；将这些进展整合于treatable-traits框架或有助于优化患者选择、弥合加重后治疗缺口，并使药物升级与共病管理、依从性、吸入技术和康复需求相匹配
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，摘要未报告检索方法与纳排标准，亦无任何效应量、CI或P值；真实世界关联为观察性证据（作者已承认需谨慎因果解读），且对dupilumab早期真实世界数据的"在关键试验未充分代表人群中的潜在有效性"表述存在外推倾向；对zilakopant/tozorakimab等仅有管线性提及，证据层级不明。具体效果数值信息不足

pico.ic: 单吸入器三联疗法（SITT）对比多装置三联疗法；dupilumab/mepolizumab等生物制剂用于三联治疗后持续加重的嗜酸性粒细胞表型COPD

papers.reason: 可作为COPD非肿瘤呼吸领域的临床综述参考，为单吸入器三联疗法选择及生物制剂（dupilumab/mepolizumab）适用人群的treatable-traits框架提供概览；对胸部肿瘤核心业务影响有限
papers.abstract_en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Despite major pharmacological advances, a substantial gap persists between guideline recommendations and routine clinical practice, particularly after exacerbations. This narrative review summarizes current evidence supporting personalized pharmacological escalation in COPD, focusing on single-inhaler triple therapy (SITT) and the emergence of biologic therapy. SITT, combining an inhaled corticosteroid, a long-acting β2-agonist and a long-acting muscarinic antagonist, is now the preferred inhaled strategy for patients requiring ICS-containing triple therapy. Real-world studies indicate that, compared with multiple-inhaler triple therapy, SITT is associated with better adherence and persistence, lower exacerbation rates and improved clinical outcomes, although observational findings require cautious causal interpretation. In parallel, COPD has entered the era of targeted biologic therapy. Dupilumab was the first biologic approved for COPD, following the BOREAS and NOTUS trials in patients with chronic bronchitis, blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/µL and persistent exacerbations despite triple therapy. Mepolizumab has more recently provided robust phase 3 evidence in eosinophilic COPD through the MATINEE trial. Early real-world dupilumab studies further suggest potential effectiveness in selected patients under-represented in pivotal trials, including those with advanced age, severe airflow limitation, oxygen dependence or high mucus burden. Beyond canonical type 2 pathways, IL-33 inhibition with tozorakimab may further broaden targeted treatment to COPD phenotypes without a clear eosinophilic signature. Integrating these advances within a treatable-traits framework may help optimize patient selection, close post-exacerbation therapeutic gaps, and align pharmacological escalation with comorbidity management, adherence, inhaler technique and rehabilitation needs.

papers.title_en: Single cell imaging mass spectrometry spatial immune profiling of brain metastasis from non-small-cell lung cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
papers.authors: Zhao D, Li H, Mambetsariev I, Mirzapoiazova T, Fricke J, Arias-Romero J, Arvanitis L, D'Apuzzo M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medical Oncology and Therapeutics Research, City of Hope, Duarte, CA, USA.
papers.results: PR患者样本富集CD4+FOXP3+ 27.6%、PanCK+CD68+PD-L1+CD33+ 22.7%、PanCK+PD-L1+CD33+ 15.6%，弱CD68+ 12.7%；PD患者样本富集PanCK+ 42.5%、弱PanCK+ 28.2%、Arginase+ 10.7%；PR患者较早标本富集neighborhood 2与3（PanCK+细胞簇混杂多标志物并重叠T细胞），较晚标本富集neighborhood 0（CD4+FOXP3+）与neighborhood 1（弱CD68+、CD4+FOXP3+），且neighborhood 1被neighborhood 0环绕；弱CD68+细胞在PR与PD患者中均存在，但98.7%出现在该单例PR患者中。摘要明确说明因标本数量少，未进行反应组间正式统计比较，所有分析均为描述性与探索性，无CI/P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: We investigated the spatial TME features of brain metastases from NSCLC patients and identified distinct IMC phenotypic profiles, and suggested the potential role for immunosuppressive macrophage and Tregs in ICI resistance mechanisms in brain metastasis. Given the small number of patients, the absence of orthogonal validation and the restricted marker panel, further studies of more samples with comprehensive analysis are required.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), alone or in combination with chemotherapy, are a primary therapy for patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) without targetable driver alterations, yet brain metastases remain a major clinical challenge and their immune microenvironment is poorly characterized. This study aimed to describe the single-cell spatial immune microenvironment of brain metastases from ICI-treated NSCLC patients using imaging mass cytometry (IMC) and to explore features associated with response and resistance. METHODS: Four brain metastasis tissues were available from three patients treated with ICIs, and an eleven-marker panel was stained on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) slides for IMC analysis. Spatial cell count analyses and cell neighborhood analyses were performed to describe the cell population, distribution, and spatial neighborhood in the brain metastasis tumor microenvironment (TME). Given the number of specimens available, no formal statistical comparison between response groups was performed with all analyses done with descriptive statistics and exploratory. RESULTS: In this study, we found enrichment of CD4+FOXP3+ (27.6%), PanCK+CD68+PD-L1+CD33+ (22.7%), and PanCK+PD-L1+CD33+ (15.6%), and weak CD68+ (12.7%) in samples from the patient who exhibited a partial response (PR) to ICIs. In samples from progressive disease (PD) patients, we observed enrichment of PanCK+ (42.5%), weak PanCK+ (28.2%) and Arginase+ (10.7%). In the PR patient with two timepoints, the earlier sample was enriched with neighborhoods 2 and 3, which consist of PanCK+ cell clusters mixed with multiple markers and overlapping T Cells. The later sample was enriched with neighborhood 0 (CD4+FOXP3+) and neighborhood 1 (weak CD68+, CD4+FOXP3+), with neighborhood 1 surrounded by neighborhood 0. Weak CD68+ cells were present in both PR and PD patients, but the majority (98.7%) were observed in the single PR patient. CONCLUSIONS: We investigated the spatial TME features of brain metastases from NSCLC patients and identified distinct IMC phenotypic profiles, and suggested the potential role for immunosuppressive macrophage and Tregs in ICI resistance mechanisms in brain metastasis. Given the small number of patients, the absence of orthogonal validation and the restricted marker panel, further studies of more samples with comprehensive analysis are required.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have revolutionized the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), while overlapping multi-system immune-related adverse events (irAEs) are life-threatening and pose great clinical challenges. CASE DESCRIPTION: A 74-year-old male patient with stage IIIA lung squamous cell carcinoma developed bilateral ptosis, blurred vision, abnormal thyroid function, elevated muscle enzymes and cardiac biomarkers after two cycles of toripalimab combined with chemotherapy. He was diagnosed with ICI-induced myositis, myocarditis and thyroiditis. ICIs were discontinued immediately. Glucocorticoids, methimazole and levothyroxine were administered sequentially according to disease progression. The patient recovered well and underwent lobectomy successfully. CONCLUSION: Elderly individuals complicated with pre-existing cardiovascular diseases are susceptible to severe immune-related adverse events. Early identification of overlapping multi-system irAEs, timely drug withdrawal and standardized immunosuppressive therapy are essential. Endocrine-immune-related adverse reactions exhibit dynamic evolution; for instance, thyroid toxicity may progress from a hyperthyroid phase to hypothyroidism, necessitating individualized monitoring and replacement therapy according to different stages of thyroid function.

papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality, highlighting the need for novel therapeutic strategies. Empagliflozin (EMPA), a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor, has demonstrated emerging anticancer activity; however, its effects on apoptosis-autophagy crosstalk in lung cancer remain incompletely understood. This study investigated the anticancer effects of EMPA and the influence of hydroxychloroquine (HCQ)-mediated autophagy inhibition in A549 and HOP-92 human lung cancer cells. Network pharmacology with explicit database association-score cutoffs, and molecular docking validated by redocking of a co-crystallized reference ligand, were used to identify potential EMPA-associated targets and pathways. Cytotoxicity of EMPA, HCQ, and their combination was evaluated by MTT assay, followed by combination index and Bliss analyses. Cell-cycle distribution and apoptosis were assessed by flow cytometry. Expression of apoptosis- and autophagy-related markers was evaluated by RT-qPCR, cleaved caspase-3 analysis, and Western blotting. Network analysis identified 239 overlapping EMPA-lung cancer targets, of which 46 were retained after applying an Open Targets association-score cutoff of 0.30. Docking, validated by reproducing the erlotinib crystal pose in the EGFR kinase domain (heavy-atom RMSD 1.30 ± 0.02 Å), indicated that EMPA can be accommodated at surface sites of ANXA8 (-7.6 kcal/mol) and the p62/SQSTM1 ZZ domain (-7.0 kcal/mol) and within the ligand-binding pocket of PPARγ (-7.5 kcal/mol; PDB 8BF1, the PPARγ-PGC-1α coactivator complex). EMPA reduced cell viability in both cell lines, with greater sensitivity in A549 cells. Combining EMPA with HCQ markedly reduced IC50 values and demonstrated synergistic interactions at IC50. EMPA altered cell-cycle progression and increased apoptotic cell death, accompanied by enhanced BAX and CASP3 expression and cleaved caspase-3 activation. EMPA increased LC3-II without p62 accumulation, consistent with increased autophagic activity, whereas HCQ-containing treatments induced LC3-II and p62 accumulation and enhanced apoptotic signaling. EMPA exerts antiproliferative and pro-apoptotic effects in lung cancer cells while modulating autophagy. Inhibition of lysosomal autophagic degradation by HCQ enhances EMPA-mediated cytotoxicity and apoptosis, supporting further investigation of this combination as an anticancer strategy.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Myosin light chain 9 (MYL9), a regulatory light chain of myosin II, plays a crucial role in cytoskeletal dynamics and has been associated with tumor progression in multiple malignancies. However, its role in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains poorly characterized. Despite recent advances in treatment, the prognosis of LUAD patients remains poor, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic targets. METHODS: Here, we systematically assessed MYL9 expression and its clinical relevance in LUAD by integrating transcriptomic data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and protein-level validation from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA) via immunohistochemistry. Functional investigations in H1299 cells indicated that silencing MYL9 significantly impeded cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, as corroborated by colony formation and Transwell assays. In vivo xenograft models further verified that MYL9 knockdown inhibited tumor growth and triggered apoptosis. Bioinformatic analyses, including the ESTIMATE algorithm, single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), and drug sensitivity profiling, were also performed. RESULTS: In addition to its oncogenic impacts, bioinformatic analyses demonstrated that elevated MYL9 expression is correlated with distinct immune infiltration patterns and diminished chemosensitivity, possibly through the modulation of the tumor microenvironment. These findings suggest that MYL9 may link cytoskeletal regulation with tumor progression, immune remodeling, and treatment response in LUAD. CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, these findings recognize MYL9 as a novel prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in LUAD, providing insights into its multifaceted role in tumor biology and treatment response. Further studies are warranted to validate these findings in larger clinical cohorts and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease (RA-ILD) is a major extra-articular complication of rheumatoid arthritis and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality. Unlike idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), RA-ILD develops in the context of systemic immune activation, but the cellular basis linking inflammation to fibroblast-state changes remains incompletely understood. METHODS: We performed single-cell RNA sequencing on lung tissues from healthy donors, patients with RA-ILD, and patients with IPF, complemented by spatial validation and in vitro experiments. RESULTS: In this cohort, RA-ILD lungs showed an increased proportion of FCN1⁺ inflammatory macrophages within the macrophage compartment, whereas IPF lungs were dominated by SPP1⁺ macrophages. Trajectory and cell-cell communication analyses identified an RA-ILD-enriched matrix-fibroblast-to-CXCR4⁺ lipofibroblast program and a predicted SEMA3C-NRP1 interaction between inflammatory macrophage populations and fibroblasts; these patterns were not detected in the IPF or healthy-control samples analyzed here. Multiplex immunofluorescence showed macrophage-associated SEMA3C signal in spatial proximity to NRP1⁺ fibroblasts within fibrotic regions. A flow-sorted inflammatory monocyte/macrophage-enriched population from RA-ILD lungs had higher supernatant SEMA3C levels and was associated with shifts in MRC-5 fibroblast markers from EBF1/PDGFRA toward APOE/CXCR4. Recombinant SEMA3C reproduced this marker-defined shift, whereas pharmacological NRP1 inhibition attenuated it; an orthogonal THP-1 overexpression model produced concordant results. DISCUSSION: These data support an association between an inflammatory macrophage-SEMA3C-NRP1 axis and fibroblast-state remodeling in the studied RA-ILD samples. Because the RA-ILD cohort was small and did not include other CTD-ILD subtypes, the findings should not be interpreted as establishing RA-ILD specificity or a fully profibrotic functional phenotype.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Preserved ratio impaired spirometry (PRISm), as a novel heterogeneous pulmonary function pattern, is associated with the early stage of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, whether human exposure to environmental toxicants is associated with PRISm has not been comprehensively studied, particularly with respect to combined exposure to multiple toxicants. The objective of the study was to investigate the effects of single and combined environmental toxicants on PRISm. METHODS: We analyzed data from 1,754 adult participants in an American population study. We employed multivariable logistic regression, weighted quantile sum (WQS) regression, quantile g-computation (Qgcomp), Bayesian kernel machine regression (BKMR), and machine learning models to examine associations between 21 environmental toxicants and PRISm. We additionally conducted subgroup analyses stratified by smoking status. We also explored the potential mediating roles of the lipid indicator non-high-density lipoprotein to high-density lipoprotein ratio (NHHR) and lipid-related inflammatory markers. RESULTS: In the single-exposure model, eight environmental toxicants were found to be positively associated with PRISm, with lead (Pb) exhibiting the strongest association estimate. The results of WQS regression, Qgcomp, and BKMR consistently indicated that mixtures of environmental toxicants showed a stable positive association with PRISm in both the overall population and smokers. Pb and cadmium (Cd) were identified as the most contributory environmental toxicants, respectively. The mediation analysis indicated that NHHR statistically accounted for 12.5% of this relationship, while the mediation proportion of lipid-related inflammatory markers ranged from 8.51% to 11.1%. Gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) emerged as the top-performing machine-learning model, with the highest area under the curve (AUC) of 0.865. Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) interpretability analysis further revealed that Pb was the most influential environmental toxicant. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings provide exploratory evidence of individual and combined associations between environmental toxicant exposure and PRISm in the selected National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) analytic sample.

papers.abstract_en: Mice nasally vaccinated with the Brucella melitensis (BM) double-mutant (ΔznuA ΔnorD B. melitensis-mCherry [znBM-mC]) showed increased numbers of B cells residing in the lungs 5 days post-vaccination and contributing to antigen-presentation. Studies were pursued to determine the relevance of B cells in protection conferred by mucosal znBM-mC vaccination of BALB/c compared to B cell null (µMT) mice. Two vaccination regimens were applied: oral prime, nasal boost versus a single nasal vaccination. Both methods have proven efficacious in immunocompetent mice. BALB/c mice, but not µMT mice, vaccinated with znBM-mC showed the expected efficacy. Robust T cell recruitment and differentiation were observed in the lungs in both mouse strains with no significant differences in total CD4+ and CD8+ T cells post-vaccination, although some subset phenotypic differences were noted in µMT mice. Specifically, more proinflammatory T cells were present in µMT lungs 4 weeks post-boost evident by increased numbers of TNF-α+ CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, polyfunctional CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, and IFN-γ+ CD8+ T cells. Examination of lung memory T cells showed no differences between vaccinated mouse groups in numbers of resident memory T cells (TRMs), central memory T cells (TCMs), and CD8+ effector memory T cells (TEMs); the CD4+ TEMs were slightly reduced in µMT lungs. Adoptive transfer of naive or immune B cells prior to wild-type (wt) BM 16M challenge in vaccinated µMT mice enabled protection. In the context of a vaccine-induced response, adoptive transfer of immune B cells into unvaccinated µMT mice failed to protect against wt BM 16M challenge demonstrating that znBM-induced protection involves both B and T cell contributions. In addition to triggering recruitment and expansion of proinflammatory and memory T cell subsets, mucosal vaccination recruits a population of B cells, which enhance protection to challenge.

papers.results: 共识阈值为≥80%（12位专家中至少10位选择同一答案）；定义、负担、管理三大主题及多数诊断问题均达成共识。专家将长新冠定义为SARS-CoV-2感染后持续>3个月的无法解释症状，区别于急性期后COVID-19，不要求最低疾病严重程度；长新冠影响约6%-10%的SARS-CoV-2感染者（与WHO及KSID估计一致）；急性期住院被识别为发生长新冠的危险因素。未达成共识的问题：诊断所需既往病史；加强针状态、缺少早期抗病毒治疗、感染前健康评估和标准化患者报告结局工具仅获'中等认可'（moderate endorsement）。

papers.ai_note: 纯专家意见共识，无患者数据或疗效证据，结论强度受12人小样本与地域限定制约；'6%-10%负担'为引用既往WHO/KSID估计而非本研究测得，易被误读为本研究结果；末轮对未达共识的Likert问题事后新增'moderate endorsement'类别，属事后定义的宽松口径，可能稀释未达成共识的事实；部分数值（加强针、早期抗病毒）为定性认可而非定量终点，信息不足于判断效应大小。

papers.reason: 为东南亚地区长新冠临床识别与随访框架提供参考，属呼吸慢病/感染后疾病管理范畴，与胸部肿瘤核心业务关联有限。
papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Long COVID is a heterogeneous post-infectious condition following acute severe acute respiratory syndrome-coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Ongoing uncertainty around its definition, burden, diagnosis and management complicates clinical recognition and care in Southeast Asia. METHODS: A modified Delphi consensus study was conducted with twelve experts from six Southeast Asian countries to develop regional guidance on long COVID. Consensus was predefined as ≥ 80% agreement, corresponding to at least 10 of 12 experts selecting the same response in multiple-choice questions or indicating agreement on Likert-scale questions (e.g. agree/strongly agree, most important/more important, relevant/highly relevant). Questions that reached consensus were removed from the subsequent round, while unresolved questions were revised, consolidated, or expanded. In the final round, a post hoc descriptive category, 'moderate endorsement', was applied to Likert-scale questions that had not reached consensus, with 'important' as the midpoint category of the five-point importance scale ('most important' to 'least important'), to capture responses judged important but falling short of the consensus threshold. RESULTS: Consensus was reached for all 'definition', 'burden' and 'management' theme questions and most 'diagnosis' questions. Experts defined long COVID as unexplained symptoms persisting for > 3 months after SARS-CoV-2 infection, distinct from post-acute COVID-19, with no minimum severity threshold requirement. Long COVID was recognised as affecting approximately 6%-10% of individuals after SARS-CoV-2 infection, consistent with published WHO and KSID estimates; clinical evaluation and symptom-guided testing were recommended for its diagnosis. Hospitalisation during acute COVID-19 was identified as a risk factor for developing long COVID. The experts recommended multidisciplinary, symptom-directed care, rehabilitation, pacing and follow-up. Vaccination and reinfection prevention were supported as important long COVID risk-reduction strategies, and early antiviral treatment should be considered to prevent severe acute illness and hospitalisation in high-risk individuals. Consensus was not reached on the past medical history required for diagnosis; moderate endorsement was observed for booster status, absence of early antiviral treatment, pre-COVID health assessment and standardised patient-reported outcome tools. CONCLUSION: This Delphi study provides a practical regional consensus framework for long COVID in Southeast Asia.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Published data on cystic fibrosis (CF) among Egyptian people with cystic fibrosis (pwCF) are limited, and most previous reports have been from single centers. This study describes the demographic, clinical, and CFTR variant characteristics of a large multicenter cohort of Egyptian pwCF. METHODS: We conducted a multicenter retrospective descriptive cohort study including pwCF treated at seven Egyptian university children's hospitals from 2020 through 2024. Eligible participants had clinical features consistent with CF and positive sweat chloride testing. Demographic, clinical, sweat chloride, and genetic testing data were collected from medical records. All participants underwent limited CFTR variant testing; participants with one or no identified variants were eligible for additional CFTR sequencing when available. RESULTS: A total of 475 Egyptian pwCF were included. Participants were recruited from Cairo University, Ain Shams University, Zagazig University, Mansoura University, Tanta University, Alexandria University, and Assiut University. Among the cohort, 175 participants had two identified CFTR variants, 32 had one identified variant, and 268 had no variant identified on available testing. F508del was the most frequent variant, followed by N1303K. Nine novel CFTR variants were identified. CONCLUSION: This multicenter retrospective cohort study represents one of the largest reported cohorts of Egyptian pwCF. The findings highlight the genetic heterogeneity of CF in Egypt and support the development of an Egyptian CFTR variant panel, expanded access to comprehensive genetic testing, and broader implementation of newborn screening.

papers.abstract_en: The ESX-5 secretion system is critical for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) viability and pathogenesis. However, a functional understanding of its impact on the host is unknown. ESX-5 is encoded at a single site with small putative virulence paralogs (ESX-5a, ESX-5b, and ESX-5c) spaced throughout the genome. To examine host-pathogen interactions of these putative virulence clusters, we made deletion mutants lacking these paralogs and infected primary human macrophages. Independent infection with any deletion mutant led to reduced cytokine secretion. This defect was dependent on viable bacteria and is mediated by an unresolved post-transcriptional mechanism. In bacterial transcriptomic analyses, each mutant downregulated heavy metal response genes compared with the wild type. Treatment of wild-type Mtb with heavy metals led to increased ESX-5a and ESX-5c expression, driving concurrent TNF and IL-6 secretion in macrophages compared with untreated bacilli, indicating a putative link between ESX-5 cargo export and cellular cytokine levels.

papers.results: 靶向冠状病毒刺突蛋白特定表位的抗体在FcγR表达细胞中诱导SARS-CoV-2和MERS-CoV假病毒的ADE；阻断Fc-FcR相互作用可消除ADE；ADE诱导呈浓度与病毒载量依赖模式；药理抑制揭示ADE与经典受体介导进入通路存在显著重叠（涉及Fyn信号、NRP1、内体酸化、组织蛋白酶和PIKfyve）；临床血清样本分析显示抗体水平与ADE显著相关，ADE发生率在2023年达峰并在此后保持高位；诱导ADE的血清样本TNF-α和IL-12p70水平改变，提示Th1激活增强和促炎反应增强。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值
papers.ai_note: 摘要无独立结论段，末句关于Th1激活/促炎反应的表述为推断性语言（'may be enhanced'），依据的是细胞因子水平改变而非临床结局；血清学部分为回顾性关联分析，无临床终点，无法建立ADE与疾病严重程度的因果关系；'2019至2026年'采集时间跨度含未来年份，时间窗定义存疑；全文无可量化的主要终点效应量与统计学检验值，信息不足；数值未经四元组核验

papers.reason: 为呼吸道冠状病毒疫苗与抗体治疗的ADE风险提供机制层面的通路重叠证据（Fyn/NRP1/内体酸化等），对疫苗免疫原性设计有参考价值；但属基础免疫学研究，不直接影响胸科临床实践或肿瘤相关决策
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) is an important concern in viral infection, vaccine development, and antibody-based therapeutics. Although extensively studied in flaviviruses, the molecular mechanisms and epidemiological relevance of ADE in respiratory coronaviruses remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to investigate the epitope-specific mechanisms, cellular pathways, and population characteristics of ADE mediated by SARS-CoV-2 and MERS-CoV antibodies. METHODS: SARS-CoV-2 and MERS-CoV pseudovirus ADE models were established using Fcγ receptor-expressing cells. The effects of epitope-specific antibodies, Fc-FcR interaction blockade, and inhibitors targeting Fyn, neuropilin-1 (NRP1), endosomal acidification, cathepsins, and PIKfyve were evaluated. A CD32B-based ADE model was developed for retrospective analysis of 530 human serum samples collected from 2019 to 2026. Cytokine profiles were analyzed in 175 serum samples. Correlations between antibody levels, ADE and inflammatory markers were statistically evaluated. RESULTS: Antibodies targeting specific epitopes within coronavirus spike proteins induced ADE of both SARS-CoV-2 and MERS-CoV pseudoviruses in FcγR-expressing cells. ADE was abolished by blocking Fc-FcR interactions, confirming Fc receptor dependence. ADE induction showed a concentration- and viral load-dependent pattern, with higher viral loads requiring increased antibody concentrations for maximal enhancement. Pharmacological inhibition revealed substantial overlap between ADE and classical receptor-mediated viral entry pathways, involving Fyn signaling, NRP1, endosomal acidification, cathepsins, and PIKfyve. Analysis of clinical serum samples demonstrated a significant association between antibody levels and ADE, with ADE incidence peaking during 2023 and remaining elevated thereafter. Serum samples capable of inducing ADE exhibited altered levels of TNF-α and IL-12p70, indicating that there may be enhanced activation of Th1 and increased pro-inflammatory responses.
